messages.raw_format: An elven cloak is useful against magic.
messages.full_text: An elven cloak is useful against magic.
messages.translation: エルフのクロークは魔法に対して有効だ。
messages.dict_source: An elven cloak is useful against magic.

messages.raw_format: An umber hulk can be a confusing sight.
messages.full_text: An umber hulk can be a confusing sight.
messages.translation: アンバー・ハルクは混乱を招く光景だ。
messages.dict_source: An umber hulk can be a confusing sight.

messages.raw_format: As Crom is my witness, I'll never go hungry again!
messages.full_text: As Crom is my witness, I'll never go hungry again!
messages.translation: クロムを証人として誓う、二度と飢えることはない！
messages.dict_source: As Crom is my witness, I'll never go hungry again!

messages.raw_format: Asking about monsters may be very useful.
messages.full_text: Asking about monsters may be very useful.
messages.translation: モンスターについて尋ねることは、非常に役立つかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Asking about monsters may be very useful.

messages.raw_format: Attack long worms from the rear -- that is so much safer!
messages.full_text: Attack long worms from the rear -- that is so much safer!
messages.translation: ロングワームは後ろから攻撃しろ。そっちの方がずっと安全だ！
messages.dict_source: Attack long worms from the rear -- that is so much safer!

messages.raw_format: Attacking an eel where there is none is usually a fatal mistake!
messages.full_text: Attacking an eel where there is none is usually a fatal mistake!
messages.translation: いない場所にイールを攻撃しにいくのは、大抵致命的なミスだ！
messages.dict_source: Attacking an eel where there is none is usually a fatal mistake!

messages.raw_format: Bandaging wounds helps keep up appearances.
messages.full_text: Bandaging wounds helps keep up appearances.
messages.translation: 傷口に包帯を巻くことは、外見を保つのに役立つ。
messages.dict_source: Bandaging wounds helps keep up appearances.

messages.raw_format: Bashing monsters with a bow is not such a good idea.
messages.full_text: Bashing monsters with a bow is not such a good idea.
messages.translation: 弓でモンスターを叩くのはあまり良い考えではない。
messages.dict_source: Bashing monsters with a bow is not such a good idea.

messages.raw_format: Be careful!  The Wizard may plan an ambush!
messages.full_text: Be careful!  The Wizard may plan an ambush!
messages.translation: 気をつけろ！ 魔法使いが待ち伏せを計画しているかもしれない！
messages.dict_source: Be careful!  The Wizard may plan an ambush!

messages.raw_format: Be nice to a nurse:  Put away your weapon and take off your clothes.
messages.full_text: Be nice to a nurse:  Put away your weapon and take off your clothes.
messages.translation: ナースには親切にしろ：武器をしまい、服を脱ぐんだ。
messages.dict_source: Be nice to a nurse:  Put away your weapon and take off your clothes.

messages.raw_format: Blank scrolls make more interesting reading.
messages.full_text: Blank scrolls make more interesting reading.
messages.translation: 白紙のスクロールは、より興味深い読み物になる。
messages.dict_source: Blank scrolls make more interesting reading.

messages.raw_format: Blind?  Catch a floating eye!
messages.full_text: Blind?  Catch a floating eye!
messages.translation: 盲目？ 浮かぶ目を捕まえろ！

messages.raw_format: Booksellers never read scrolls; they might get carried away.
messages.full_text: Booksellers never read scrolls; they might get carried away.
messages.translation: 本屋は決してスクロールを読まない。どこかへ連れ去られてしまうかもしれないからだ。
messages.dict_source: Booksellers never read scrolls; they might get carried away.

messages.raw_format: Chemistry 101: Never pour water into acid.
messages.full_text: Chemistry 101: Never pour water into acid.
messages.translation: 化学入門：絶対に酸に水を注いではならない。
messages.dict_source: Chemistry 101: Never pour water into acid.

messages.raw_format: Concise conquest:  Control, confuse, conjure, condemn.
messages.full_text: Concise conquest:  Control, confuse, conjure, condemn.
messages.translation: 簡潔な征服：制御、混乱、召喚、非難。
messages.dict_source: Concise conquest:  Control, confuse, conjure, condemn.

messages.raw_format: Conserve energy, turn off the lights.
messages.full_text: Conserve energy, turn off the lights.
messages.translation: 省エネのために、電気を消しましょう。
messages.dict_source: Conserve energy, turn off the lights.

messages.raw_format: Digging up a grave could be a bad idea...
messages.full_text: Digging up a grave could be a bad idea...
messages.translation: 墓を掘り返すのは良くないかもしれない...
messages.dict_source: Digging up a grave could be a bad idea...

messages.raw_format: Dilithium crystals are rare indeed.
messages.full_text: Dilithium crystals are rare indeed.
messages.translation: ジリチウムの結晶は本当に希少だ。

messages.raw_format: Dogs are attracted by the smell of tripe.
messages.full_text: Dogs are attracted by the smell of tripe.
messages.translation: 犬はトリッパの匂いに引き寄せられる。
messages.dict_source: Dogs are attracted by the smell of tripe.

messages.raw_format: Dogs are superstitious; they never step on cursed items.
messages.full_text: Dogs are superstitious; they never step on cursed items.
messages.translation: 犬は迷信深い。決して呪われたアイテムを踏まない。
messages.dict_source: Dogs are superstitious; they never step on cursed items.

messages.raw_format: Dogs of ghosts aren't angry, just hungry.
messages.full_text: Dogs of ghosts aren't angry, just hungry.
messages.translation: 幽霊の犬は怒っているわけではない。ただ腹を空かせているだけだ。
messages.dict_source: Dogs of ghosts aren't angry, just hungry.

messages.raw_format: Don't forget!  Large dogs are MUCH harder to kill than little dogs.
messages.full_text: Don't forget!  Large dogs are MUCH harder to kill than little dogs.
messages.translation: 忘れるな！ 大型犬は小型犬よりずっと倒しにくい。
messages.dict_source: Don't forget!  Large dogs are MUCH harder to kill than little dogs.

messages.raw_format: Don't lash out at people while blinded.
messages.full_text: Don't lash out at people while blinded.
messages.translation: 盲目状態の時に、あたりかまわず攻撃してはならない。
messages.dict_source: Don't lash out at people while blinded.

messages.raw_format: Don't mess with shopkeepers, or you'll get the Guild after you.
messages.full_text: Don't mess with shopkeepers, or you'll get the Guild after you.
messages.translation: 店主を怒らせるとギルドに追われるぞ。
messages.dict_source: Don't mess with shopkeepers, or you'll get the Guild after you.

messages.raw_format: Dragons never whip their children; they wouldn't feel it!
messages.full_text: Dragons never whip their children; they wouldn't feel it!
messages.translation: ドラゴンは決して子供を鞭打たない。子供たちは何も感じないからだ！
messages.dict_source: Dragons never whip their children; they wouldn't feel it!

messages.raw_format: Dwarves use their cloaks to keep their drinks cool.
messages.full_text: Dwarves use their cloaks to keep their drinks cool.
messages.translation: ドワーフは飲み物を冷やすのにクロークを使う。
messages.dict_source: Dwarves use their cloaks to keep their drinks cool.

messages.raw_format: Eat your carrots.  They're good for your eyes.
messages.full_text: Eat your carrots.  They're good for your eyes.
messages.translation: 人参を食べなさい。目に良いから。
messages.dict_source: Eat your carrots.  They're good for your eyes.

messages.raw_format: Eating a freezing sphere is like eating a yeti.
messages.full_text: Eating a freezing sphere is like eating a yeti.
messages.translation: フリーズ・スフィアを食べるのは、イエティを食べるようなものだ。
messages.dict_source: Eating a freezing sphere is like eating a yeti.

messages.raw_format: Eating a killer bee is like eating a scorpion.
messages.full_text: Eating a killer bee is like eating a scorpion.
messages.translation: キラー・ビーを食べるのは、サソリを食べるようなものだ。
messages.dict_source: Eating a killer bee is like eating a scorpion.

messages.raw_format: Eating a tengu is like eating a nymph.
messages.full_text: Eating a tengu is like eating a nymph.
messages.translation: 天狗を食べるのは、精霊を食べるようなものだ。
messages.dict_source: Eating a tengu is like eating a nymph.

messages.raw_format: Eating a wraith is a rewarding experience!
messages.full_text: Eating a wraith is a rewarding experience!
messages.translation: レイスを食べるのはやりがいのある体験だ！
messages.dict_source: Eating a wraith is a rewarding experience!

messages.raw_format: Eating unpaid leprechauns may be advantageous.
messages.full_text: Eating unpaid leprechauns may be advantageous.
messages.translation: 代金を払っていないレプラコーンを食べるのは、有利に働くかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Eating unpaid leprechauns may be advantageous.

messages.raw_format: Elbereth has quite a reputation around these parts.
messages.full_text: Elbereth has quite a reputation around these parts.
messages.translation: エルベレスはこの辺りでかなりの評判だ。
messages.dict_source: Elbereth has quite a reputation around these parts.

messages.raw_format: Elf corpses are incompatible with the sandman, and at times the gods as well.
messages.full_text: Elf corpses are incompatible with the sandman, and at times the gods as well.
messages.translation: エルフの死体は眠りの精（サンドマン）と相性が悪く、時には神々とも相性が悪い。
messages.dict_source: Elf corpses are incompatible with the sandman, and at times the gods as well.

messages.raw_format: Elven cloaks cannot rust.
messages.full_text: Elven cloaks cannot rust.
messages.translation: エルフのクロークは決して錆びない。

messages.raw_format: Elves can help you feel less tired.
messages.full_text: Elves can help you feel less tired.
messages.translation: エルフは君が疲れを感じにくくなるように助けてくれる。
messages.dict_source: Elves can help you feel less tired.

messages.raw_format: Even evil players have a guardian angel.
messages.full_text: Even evil players have a guardian angel.
messages.translation: 邪悪なプレイヤーにさえ、守護天使がついている。
messages.dict_source: Even evil players have a guardian angel.

messages.raw_format: Even the most powerful heroes sometimes need to quaff away their injuries.
messages.full_text: Even the most powerful heroes sometimes need to quaff away their injuries.
messages.translation: どれほど強い英雄でも、時には薬をあおって傷を癒やす必要がある。
messages.dict_source: Even the most powerful heroes sometimes need to quaff away their injuries.

messages.raw_format: Ever fought with an enchanted tooth?
messages.full_text: Ever fought with an enchanted tooth?
messages.translation: 魔法の歯と戦ったことはあるか？
messages.dict_source: Ever fought with an enchanted tooth?

messages.raw_format: Ever tried reading while confused?
messages.full_text: Ever tried reading while confused?
messages.translation: 混乱しながら読書したことはあるか？

messages.raw_format: Ever tried to lock a troll inside a large box?
messages.full_text: Ever tried to lock a troll inside a large box?
messages.translation: 巨大な箱の中にトロール閉じ込めてみたことある？
messages.dict_source: Ever tried to lock a troll inside a large box?

messages.raw_format: Ever wondered why one would want to dip something in a potion?
messages.full_text: Ever wondered why one would want to dip something in a potion?
messages.translation: なぜ何かを薬に浸そうとするのか、不思議に思ったことはあるか？
messages.dict_source: Ever wondered why one would want to dip something in a potion?

messages.raw_format: Expensive cameras have penetrating flash lights.
messages.full_text: Expensive cameras have penetrating flash lights.
messages.translation: 高価なカメラは、貫通するフラッシュライトを備えている。
messages.dict_source: Expensive cameras have penetrating flash lights.

messages.raw_format: Extra staircases lead to extra levels.
messages.full_text: Extra staircases lead to extra levels.
messages.translation: 余分な階段は、予備の階層へと通じている。
messages.dict_source: Extra staircases lead to extra levels.

messages.raw_format: Fiery letters might deter monsters.
messages.full_text: Fiery letters might deter monsters.
messages.translation: 炎の文字はモンスターを阻止するかもしれない。

messages.raw_format: For a good time engrave `Elbereth'.
messages.full_text: For a good time engrave `Elbereth'.
messages.translation: 楽しい時間を過ごすには「エルベレス(Elbereth)」と刻め

messages.raw_format: Gems are too precious to be thrown away carelessly.
messages.full_text: Gems are too precious to be thrown away carelessly.
messages.translation: 宝石はあまりにも貴重なので、軽々しく捨てることはできない。
messages.dict_source: Gems are too precious to be thrown away carelessly.

messages.raw_format: Getting hungry?  Stop wearing rings!
messages.full_text: Getting hungry?  Stop wearing rings!
messages.translation: お腹空いた？指輪を外せ！

messages.raw_format: Getting too warm?  Take off that Amulet of Yendor and stay away from the exit!
messages.full_text: Getting too warm?  Take off that Amulet of Yendor and stay away from the exit!
messages.translation: 暑くなってきた？ それならイェンドールのお守りを外し、出口から離れろ！
messages.dict_source: Getting too warm?  Take off that Amulet of Yendor and stay away from the exit!

messages.raw_format: Gods expect the best from their priesthood.
messages.full_text: Gods expect the best from their priesthood.
messages.translation: 神々は、自らの聖職者たちに最善を期待している。
messages.dict_source: Gods expect the best from their priesthood.

messages.raw_format: Gods look down their noses at demigods.
messages.full_text: Gods look down their noses at demigods.
messages.translation: 神々は半神たちを鼻であしらっている。
messages.dict_source: Gods look down their noses at demigods.

messages.raw_format: Gods love cats and dogs.
messages.full_text: Gods love cats and dogs.
messages.translation: 神々は猫と犬を愛している。

messages.raw_format: Got a question?  Try rec.games.roguelike.nethack.
messages.full_text: Got a question?  Try rec.games.roguelike.nethack.
messages.translation: 質問があるか？ rec.games.roguelike.nethack を試せ。

messages.raw_format: Grave robbers sometimes get rich.
messages.full_text: Grave robbers sometimes get rich.
messages.translation: 墓荒らしが金持ちになることもある。

messages.raw_format: Guy Montag keeps his scrolls in a bag.
messages.full_text: Guy Montag keeps his scrolls in a bag.
messages.translation: ガイ・モンターグはスクロールをバッグの中に入れている。
messages.dict_source: Guy Montag keeps his scrolls in a bag.

messages.raw_format: Handle your flasks carefully -- there might be a ghost inside!
messages.full_text: Handle your flasks carefully -- there might be a ghost inside!
messages.translation: フラスコは慎重に扱え。中に幽霊がいるかもしれないぞ！
messages.dict_source: Handle your flasks carefully -- there might be a ghost inside!

messages.raw_format: Heavy-duty boots can protect more than just your feet.
messages.full_text: Heavy-duty boots can protect more than just your feet.
messages.translation: 頑丈なブーツは足以外も守ってくれる。
messages.dict_source: Heavy-duty boots can protect more than just your feet.

messages.raw_format: Holy water has many uses.
messages.full_text: Holy water has many uses.
messages.translation: 聖水には多くの使い道がある。

messages.raw_format: Horses trust their riders, even when not so deserved.
messages.full_text: Horses trust their riders, even when not so deserved.
messages.translation: 馬は乗り手を信頼している、たとえそれに値しない場合でも。
messages.dict_source: Horses trust their riders, even when not so deserved.

messages.raw_format: Hunger is a confusing experience for a dog!
messages.full_text: Hunger is a confusing experience for a dog!
messages.translation: 空腹は犬にとっては混乱を招く経験だ！
messages.dict_source: Hunger is a confusing experience for a dog!

messages.raw_format: I once knew a hacker who ate too fast and choked to death.
messages.full_text: I once knew a hacker who ate too fast and choked to death.
messages.translation: あまりに速く食べすぎて、喉を詰まらせて死んだハッカーを私は知っている。
messages.dict_source: I once knew a hacker who ate too fast and choked to death.

messages.raw_format: I smell a maze of twisty little passages.
messages.full_text: I smell a maze of twisty little passages.
messages.translation: 入り組んだ小さな通路の迷宮の匂いがする。
messages.dict_source: I smell a maze of twisty little passages.

messages.raw_format: I wish I never wished a wand of wishing.  (Wishful thinking.)
messages.full_text: I wish I never wished a wand of wishing.  (Wishful thinking.)
messages.translation: 願いの杖なんて願わなければよかった。（それはただの「願い」にすぎないが。）
messages.dict_source: I wish I never wished a wand of wishing.  (Wishful thinking.)

messages.raw_format: I wouldn't advise playing catch with a giant.
messages.full_text: I wouldn't advise playing catch with a giant.
messages.translation: 巨人とはキャッチボールをするのはお勧めしません。
messages.dict_source: I wouldn't advise playing catch with a giant.

messages.raw_format: I'm watching you.  -- The Wizard of Yendor
messages.full_text: I'm watching you.  -- The Wizard of Yendor
messages.translation: おまえを見ているぞ。 -- イェンドールの魔法使い
messages.dict_source: I'm watching you.  -- The Wizard of Yendor

messages.raw_format: Ice boxes keep your food fresh.
messages.full_text: Ice boxes keep your food fresh.
messages.translation: アイスボックスは食べ物を新鮮に保つ。
messages.dict_source: Ice boxes keep your food fresh.

messages.raw_format: If you are being punished, it's done with a deadly weapon.
messages.full_text: If you are being punished, it's done with a deadly weapon.
messages.translation: 罰を受けているのなら、それは致命的な武器によるものだ。
messages.dict_source: If you are being punished, it's done with a deadly weapon.

messages.raw_format: If you kill the Wizard, you get promoted to demi-god.
messages.full_text: If you kill the Wizard, you get promoted to demi-god.
messages.translation: ウィザードを倒せば、半神(demi-god)に昇格する。
messages.dict_source: If you kill the Wizard, you get promoted to demi-god.

messages.raw_format: If you need a wand of digging, kindly ask the minotaur.
messages.full_text: If you need a wand of digging, kindly ask the minotaur.
messages.translation: 穴掘りの杖が必要なら、ミノタウロスに親切に頼んでみろ。
messages.dict_source: If you need a wand of digging, kindly ask the minotaur.

messages.raw_format: If you want to hit, use a dagger.
messages.full_text: If you want to hit, use a dagger.
messages.translation: 命中させたいなら、短剣を使え。
messages.dict_source: If you want to hit, use a dagger.

messages.raw_format: If you want to rob a shop, train your dog.
messages.full_text: If you want to rob a shop, train your dog.
messages.translation: 店を強盗したいなら、犬を訓練しろ。
messages.dict_source: If you want to rob a shop, train your dog.

messages.raw_format: If you're lost, try buying a map next time you're in a shop.
messages.full_text: If you're lost, try buying a map next time you're in a shop.
messages.translation: 道に迷ったのなら、今度店に行った時に地図を買うことだ。
messages.dict_source: If you're lost, try buying a map next time you're in a shop.

messages.raw_format: If your hands are greasy, why not wash them?
messages.full_text: If your hands are greasy, why not wash them?
messages.translation: 手が脂ぎっているなら、洗えばいいだろう?
messages.dict_source: If your hands are greasy, why not wash them?

messages.raw_format: If your items get destroyed, you weren't wearing the right ring.
messages.full_text: If your items get destroyed, you weren't wearing the right ring.
messages.translation: 持ち物が壊されるなら、正しい指輪を着けていなかったのだ。
messages.dict_source: If your items get destroyed, you weren't wearing the right ring.

messages.raw_format: Inside a shop you better take a look at the price tags before buying anything.
messages.full_text: Inside a shop you better take a look at the price tags before buying anything.
messages.translation: 店内で何かを買う前に、値札をよく確認したほうがいい。
messages.dict_source: Inside a shop you better take a look at the price tags before buying anything.

messages.raw_format: It is bad manners to use a wand in a shop.
messages.full_text: It is bad manners to use a wand in a shop.
messages.translation: 店内で杖を使うのは無作法だ。
messages.dict_source: It is bad manners to use a wand in a shop.

messages.raw_format: It is dangerous to visit a graveyard at midnight.
messages.full_text: It is dangerous to visit a graveyard at midnight.
messages.translation: 真夜中に墓地を訪れるのは危険だ。
messages.dict_source: It is dangerous to visit a graveyard at midnight.

messages.raw_format: It is not always a good idea to whistle for your dog.
messages.full_text: It is not always a good idea to whistle for your dog.
messages.translation: 犬を口笛で呼ぶのが常に良い考えとは限らない。
messages.dict_source: It is not always a good idea to whistle for your dog.

messages.raw_format: It is rumored that the Wizard has hired some help.
messages.full_text: It is rumored that the Wizard has hired some help.
messages.translation: 噂によると、魔法使いは何人かの助っ人を雇ったらしい。
messages.dict_source: It is rumored that the Wizard has hired some help.

messages.raw_format: It is the letter 'c' and not 'e' that changes status to statue.
messages.full_text: It is the letter 'c' and not 'e' that changes status to statue.
messages.translation: 『c』という文字が『e』ではなく、状態を像に変えるのだ。
messages.dict_source: It is the letter 'c' and not 'e' that changes status to statue.

messages.raw_format: It might be a good idea to offer the unicorn a ruby.
messages.full_text: It might be a good idea to offer the unicorn a ruby.
messages.translation: ユニコーンにルビーを捧げるのは良い考えかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: It might be a good idea to offer the unicorn a ruby.

messages.raw_format: It would be peculiarly sad were your dog turned to stone.
messages.full_text: It would be peculiarly sad were your dog turned to stone.
messages.translation: 君の犬が石にされたとしたら、それは格別に悲しいことだ。
messages.dict_source: It would be peculiarly sad were your dog turned to stone.

messages.raw_format: It's a 'd' eats 'd' world.
messages.full_text: It's a 'd' eats 'd' world.
messages.translation: これは「d が d を食う」世界だ。

messages.raw_format: Just because it says READ ME doesn't mean you should.
messages.full_text: Just because it says READ ME doesn't mean you should.
messages.translation: 「私を読め」と書いてあるからといって、読むべきだとは限らない。
messages.dict_source: Just because it says READ ME doesn't mean you should.

messages.raw_format: Keep your armors away from rust.
messages.full_text: Keep your armors away from rust.
messages.translation: 防具を錆から遠ざけろ。
messages.dict_source: Keep your armors away from rust.

messages.raw_format: Keep your weaponry away from acids.
messages.full_text: Keep your weaponry away from acids.
messages.translation: 武器を酸から遠ざけろ。
messages.dict_source: Keep your weaponry away from acids.

messages.raw_format: Kill a unicorn of your color and you kill your luck.
messages.full_text: Kill a unicorn of your color and you kill your luck.
messages.translation: 自分の色のユニコーンを倒せば、運も失う。
messages.dict_source: Kill a unicorn of your color and you kill your luck.

messages.raw_format: Leather is waterproof.  Ever see a cow with an umbrella?
messages.full_text: Leather is waterproof.  Ever see a cow with an umbrella?
messages.translation: 革は防水だ。傘をさした牛を見たことがあるか？
messages.dict_source: Leather is waterproof.  Ever see a cow with an umbrella?

messages.raw_format: Leprechauns are the most skilled cutpurses in this dungeon.
messages.full_text: Leprechauns are the most skilled cutpurses in this dungeon.
messages.translation: レプラコーンはこのダンジョンで最も熟練したスリだ。
messages.dict_source: Leprechauns are the most skilled cutpurses in this dungeon.

messages.raw_format: Lizard corpses protect against cockatrices.
messages.full_text: Lizard corpses protect against cockatrices.
messages.translation: トカゲの死骸はコカトリスから身を守ってくれる。

messages.raw_format: Money lost, little lost; honor lost, much lost; pluck lost, all lost.
messages.full_text: Money lost, little lost; honor lost, much lost; pluck lost, all lost.
messages.translation: 金を失うのは一部を失うこと、名誉を失うのは多くを失うこと、勇気を失うのはすべてを失うことだ。
messages.dict_source: Money lost, little lost; honor lost, much lost; pluck lost, all lost.

messages.raw_format: Most monsters can't swim.
messages.full_text: Most monsters can't swim.
messages.translation: ほとんどのモンスターは泳げない。

messages.raw_format: Music hath charms to affect the stubborn drawbridge.
messages.full_text: Music hath charms to affect the stubborn drawbridge.
messages.translation: 音楽には頑固な跳ね橋を動かす魅力がある。
messages.dict_source: Music hath charms to affect the stubborn drawbridge.

messages.raw_format: Music hath charms to soothe the savage beast.
messages.full_text: Music hath charms to soothe the savage beast.
messages.translation: 音楽には猛獣をなだめる魅力がある。
messages.dict_source: Music hath charms to soothe the savage beast.

messages.raw_format: Never attack a guard.
messages.full_text: Never attack a guard.
messages.translation: 決して衛兵を攻撃してはならない。

messages.raw_format: Never ride a long worm.
messages.full_text: Never ride a long worm.
messages.translation: 決してロングワームに乗ってはならない。

messages.raw_format: Never use your best weapon to engrave a curse.
messages.full_text: Never use your best weapon to engrave a curse.
messages.translation: 決して最良の武器で呪いの言葉を刻んではならない。
messages.dict_source: Never use your best weapon to engrave a curse.

messages.raw_format: No easy fighting with a heavy load!
messages.full_text: No easy fighting with a heavy load!
messages.translation: 重い荷物を背負っての戦いは楽じゃない！
messages.dict_source: No easy fighting with a heavy load!

messages.raw_format: Not all boots were made for walking.
messages.full_text: Not all boots were made for walking.
messages.translation: すべての靴が歩くために作られているわけではない。
messages.dict_source: Not all boots were made for walking.

messages.raw_format: Nurses are trained to touch naked persons:  they don't harm them.
messages.full_text: Nurses are trained to touch naked persons:  they don't harm them.
messages.translation: ナースは裸の人に触れる訓練を受けている。彼らは危害を加えない。
messages.dict_source: Nurses are trained to touch naked persons:  they don't harm them.

messages.raw_format: Nymphs can unlink more than your chain mail.
messages.full_text: Nymphs can unlink more than your chain mail.
messages.translation: ニンフは鎖帷子以上のものを解き放つ
messages.dict_source: Nymphs can unlink more than your chain mail.

messages.raw_format: Once your little dog will be a big dog, and you will be proud of it.
messages.full_text: Once your little dog will be a big dog, and you will be proud of it.
messages.translation: やがて君の小さな犬は大きな犬になり、君はそれを誇りに思うだろう。
messages.dict_source: Once your little dog will be a big dog, and you will be proud of it.

messages.raw_format: Only female monsters can lay eggs.
messages.full_text: Only female monsters can lay eggs.
messages.translation: 卵を産めるのはメスのモンスターだけだ。
messages.dict_source: Only female monsters can lay eggs.

messages.raw_format: Only the most confused adventurers would read cursed destroy armor scrolls.
messages.full_text: Only the most confused adventurers would read cursed destroy armor scrolls.
messages.translation: 呪われた防具破壊の巻物を読むのは、よほど混乱した冒険者だけだ。
messages.dict_source: Only the most confused adventurers would read cursed destroy armor scrolls.

messages.raw_format: Opening a tin is difficult, especially when you attempt it bare handed!
messages.full_text: Opening a tin is difficult, especially when you attempt it bare handed!
messages.translation: 缶を開けるのは難しい。特に素手でやろうとする時は！
messages.dict_source: Opening a tin is difficult, especially when you attempt it bare handed!

messages.raw_format: Orcs and killer bees share their lifestyle.
messages.full_text: Orcs and killer bees share their lifestyle.
messages.translation: オークとキラー・ビーのライフスタイルは似通っている。
messages.dict_source: Orcs and killer bees share their lifestyle.

messages.raw_format: Orcs do not procreate in dark rooms.
messages.full_text: Orcs do not procreate in dark rooms.
messages.translation: オークは暗い部屋では繁殖しない。
messages.dict_source: Orcs do not procreate in dark rooms.

messages.raw_format: Plain nymphs are harmless.
messages.full_text: Plain nymphs are harmless.
messages.translation: 普通のニンフは無害だ。

messages.raw_format: Playing AD&D may be helpful.
messages.full_text: Playing AD&D may be helpful.
messages.translation: AD&D（アドバンスド・ダンジョンズ＆ドラゴンズ）をプレイすることは役立つかもしれない。

messages.raw_format: Playing Gauntlet might be enlightening in some situations.
messages.full_text: Playing Gauntlet might be enlightening in some situations.
messages.translation: ガントレットをプレイすると、ある状況では啓発されるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Playing Gauntlet might be enlightening in some situations.

messages.raw_format: Playing billiards pays when you are in a shop.
messages.full_text: Playing billiards pays when you are in a shop.
messages.translation: 店にいる時にビリヤードをするのは得策だ。
messages.dict_source: Playing billiards pays when you are in a shop.

messages.raw_format: Polymorphing a shopkeeper might make you safer.
messages.full_text: Polymorphing a shopkeeper might make you safer.
messages.translation: 店主を変化（ポリモーフ）させることで、より安全になれるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Polymorphing a shopkeeper might make you safer.

messages.raw_format: Polymorphing your dog probably makes you safer.
messages.full_text: Polymorphing your dog probably makes you safer.
messages.translation: 飼い犬を変化（ポリモーフ）させることは、おそらく君をより安全にする。
messages.dict_source: Polymorphing your dog probably makes you safer.

messages.raw_format: Potions don't usually mix, but sometimes...
messages.full_text: Potions don't usually mix, but sometimes...
messages.translation: ポーションは通常混ざらないが、時には....
messages.dict_source: Potions don't usually mix, but sometimes...

messages.raw_format: Psst!  It's done with mirrors!
messages.full_text: Psst!  It's done with mirrors!
messages.translation: シーッ！ 鏡のトリックだよ！

messages.raw_format: Put on a ring of teleportation:  it will take you away from onslaught.
messages.full_text: Put on a ring of teleportation:  it will take you away from onslaught.
messages.translation: テレポートの指輪をはめろ。猛攻撃から君を遠ざけてくれるだろう。
messages.dict_source: Put on a ring of teleportation:  it will take you away from onslaught.

messages.raw_format: Rays aren't boomerangs, of course, but still...
messages.full_text: Rays aren't boomerangs, of course, but still...
messages.translation: 光線はブーメランではないが、それでも....
messages.dict_source: Rays aren't boomerangs, of course, but still...

messages.raw_format: Read the manual before entering the cave -- you might get killed otherwise.
messages.full_text: Read the manual before entering the cave -- you might get killed otherwise.
messages.translation: 洞窟に入る前に説明書を読めーさもないと命を落とすかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Read the manual before entering the cave -- you might get killed otherwise.

messages.raw_format: Reading Herbert might be enlightening in one case.
messages.full_text: Reading Herbert might be enlightening in one case.
messages.translation: ハバート（デューン）を読むことは、ある場合には啓発的かもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Reading Herbert might be enlightening in one case.

messages.raw_format: Reading Tolkien might help you.
messages.full_text: Reading Tolkien might help you.
messages.translation: トールキンを読むことは助けになるかもしれない。

messages.raw_format: Reading scrolls after drinking booze can give confusing results.
messages.full_text: Reading scrolls after drinking booze can give confusing results.
messages.translation: 酒を飲んだ後にスクロールを読むと、混乱した結果を招くことがある。
messages.dict_source: Reading scrolls after drinking booze can give confusing results.

messages.raw_format: Riding a dragon can be an uplifting experience.
messages.full_text: Riding a dragon can be an uplifting experience.
messages.translation: ドラゴンに乗るのは気分が高揚する（物理的にも）経験だ。
messages.dict_source: Riding a dragon can be an uplifting experience.

messages.raw_format: Rust monsters love water.  There are potions they hate, however.
messages.full_text: Rust monsters love water.  There are potions they hate, however.
messages.translation: ラスト・モンスターは水を好む。しかし、彼らが嫌うポーションもある。
messages.dict_source: Rust monsters love water.  There are potions they hate, however.

messages.raw_format: Sacks protect contents from temperatures up to 452 degrees fahrenheit.
messages.full_text: Sacks protect contents from temperatures up to 452 degrees fahrenheit.
messages.translation: 袋は中身を華氏452度までの温度から保護する。
messages.dict_source: Sacks protect contents from temperatures up to 452 degrees fahrenheit.

messages.raw_format: Scrolls fading?  It's not the heat, it's the humidity.
messages.full_text: Scrolls fading?  It's not the heat, it's the humidity.
messages.translation: スクロールが薄れてる？ それは暑さのせいじゃなく、湿度のせいだ。
messages.dict_source: Scrolls fading?  It's not the heat, it's the humidity.

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers accept credit cards, as long as you pay cash.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers accept credit cards, as long as you pay cash.
messages.translation: 店主はクレジットカードを受け付けている。現金で払う限りはな。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers accept credit cards, as long as you pay cash.

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers can spot a tourist a mile away with those Hawaiian shirts.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers can spot a tourist a mile away with those Hawaiian shirts.
messages.translation: 店主たちは、ハワイアンシャツ姿の観光客なら、遠くから見てもすぐに見分けがつく。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers can spot a tourist a mile away with those Hawaiian shirts.

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers can't tell identical twins apart.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers can't tell identical twins apart.
messages.translation: 店主は一卵性双生児を見分けることができない。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers can't tell identical twins apart.

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers don't read, so what use is engraving in a shop?
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers don't read, so what use is engraving in a shop?
messages.translation: 店主は読み物をしない。店内で刻銘することに何の意味がある？
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers don't read, so what use is engraving in a shop?

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers have incredible patience.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers have incredible patience.
messages.translation: 店主は驚くべき忍耐力を持っている。

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers might raise their prices for tourists.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers might raise their prices for tourists.
messages.translation: 店主は観光客に対して価格を吊り上げることがある。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers might raise their prices for tourists.

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers value money more than revenge.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers value money more than revenge.
messages.translation: 店主は復讐より金を重んじる。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers value money more than revenge.

messages.raw_format: Some monsters can be tamed.  I once saw a hacker with a tame dragon!
messages.full_text: Some monsters can be tamed.  I once saw a hacker with a tame dragon!
messages.translation: 一部のモンスターは飼いならせる。かつてハッカーが飼いならしたドラゴンを目撃したことがある！
messages.dict_source: Some monsters can be tamed.  I once saw a hacker with a tame dragon!

messages.raw_format: Some remain flexible, while others can't seem to change their tune.
messages.full_text: Some remain flexible, while others can't seem to change their tune.
messages.translation: 柔軟なままの者もいれば、どうしても調子を変えられない者もいる。
messages.dict_source: Some remain flexible, while others can't seem to change their tune.

messages.raw_format: Someone once said that what goes up < might come down >.
messages.full_text: Someone once said that what goes up < might come down >.
messages.translation: 上がったものは、いつか下がるかもしれないと言った者がいる。
messages.dict_source: Someone once said that what goes up < might come down >.

messages.raw_format: Someone's been spiking the pits!
messages.full_text: Someone's been spiking the pits!
messages.translation: 誰かが穴に毒を盛っている！

messages.raw_format: Sometimes monsters are more likely to fight each other than attack you.
messages.full_text: Sometimes monsters are more likely to fight each other than attack you.
messages.translation: 時にはモンスターが君を攻撃するよりも、お互いに戦い合う可能性の方が高いことがある。
messages.dict_source: Sometimes monsters are more likely to fight each other than attack you.

messages.raw_format: Spinach, carrot, and jelly -- a meal fit for a nurse!
messages.full_text: Spinach, carrot, and jelly -- a meal fit for a nurse!
messages.translation: ほうれん草、にんじん、ゼリー--看護師にぴったりの食事だ！
messages.dict_source: Spinach, carrot, and jelly -- a meal fit for a nurse!

messages.raw_format: Surviving the full extent of the mines could mean that your luck is changing.
messages.full_text: Surviving the full extent of the mines could mean that your luck is changing.
messages.translation: 地雷原を完全に突破したということは、君の運が変わりつつあることを意味するかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Surviving the full extent of the mines could mean that your luck is changing.

messages.raw_format: Tainted meat is even more sickening than poison!
messages.full_text: Tainted meat is even more sickening than poison!
messages.translation: 汚染された肉は毒よりもさらに気分を悪くさせる！
messages.dict_source: Tainted meat is even more sickening than poison!

messages.raw_format: Take your healing potions to the next level!
messages.full_text: Take your healing potions to the next level!
messages.translation: 回復薬を次の段階へ持っていけ!
messages.dict_source: Take your healing potions to the next level!

messages.raw_format: Telepathy is just a trick:  once you know how to do it, it's easy.
messages.full_text: Telepathy is just a trick:  once you know how to do it, it's easy.
messages.translation: テレパシーはただのコツだ。やり方さえわかれば簡単だ。
messages.dict_source: Telepathy is just a trick:  once you know how to do it, it's easy.

messages.raw_format: The Leprechaun Gold Tru$t is no division of the Magic Memory Vault.
messages.full_text: The Leprechaun Gold Tru$t is no division of the Magic Memory Vault.
messages.translation: レプラコーン・ゴールド信託は魔法の記憶保管庫（Vault）の部局ではない。
messages.dict_source: The Leprechaun Gold Tru$t is no division of the Magic Memory Vault.

messages.raw_format: The Wizard finds death to be quite an experience.
messages.full_text: The Wizard finds death to be quite an experience.
messages.translation: 魔法使いは死ぬことを、なかなかの経験だと考えている。
messages.dict_source: The Wizard finds death to be quite an experience.

messages.raw_format: The best equipment for your work is, of course, the most expensive.
messages.full_text: The best equipment for your work is, of course, the most expensive.
messages.translation: 仕事に最適な装備は、もちろん最も高価なものだ。
messages.dict_source: The best equipment for your work is, of course, the most expensive.

messages.raw_format: The gods don't appreciate pesky priesthood.
messages.full_text: The gods don't appreciate pesky priesthood.
messages.translation: 神々は厄介な聖職者どもを快く思っていない。
messages.dict_source: The gods don't appreciate pesky priesthood.

messages.raw_format: The gods will get angry if you kill your dog.
messages.full_text: The gods will get angry if you kill your dog.
messages.translation: 飼い犬を殺すと神々の怒りを買うぞ。
messages.dict_source: The gods will get angry if you kill your dog.

messages.raw_format: The less magic in your armor, the more you can add.
messages.full_text: The less magic in your armor, the more you can add.
messages.translation: 防具の魔力が少ないほど、あとから付け足せる。
messages.dict_source: The less magic in your armor, the more you can add.

messages.raw_format: The magic marker is mightier than the sword.
messages.full_text: The magic marker is mightier than the sword.
messages.translation: 魔法のマーカーは剣よりも強し。
messages.dict_source: The magic marker is mightier than the sword.

messages.raw_format: The moon is not the only heavenly body to influence this game.
messages.full_text: The moon is not the only heavenly body to influence this game.
messages.translation: このゲームに影響を与える天体は月だけではない。
messages.dict_source: The moon is not the only heavenly body to influence this game.

messages.raw_format: The orc swings his orcish broadsword named Elfrist at you.  You die...
messages.full_text: The orc swings his orcish broadsword named Elfrist at you.  You die...
messages.translation: オークはエルフ殺し（Elfrist）という名のオークのブロードソードを振り下ろした。君は死んだ....
messages.dict_source: The orc swings his orcish broadsword named Elfrist at you.  You die...

messages.raw_format: The secret of wands of Nothing Happens:  try again!
messages.full_text: The secret of wands of Nothing Happens:  try again!
messages.translation: 「何も起きない」杖の秘密：もう一度試せ！
messages.dict_source: The secret of wands of Nothing Happens:  try again!

messages.raw_format: There has always been something mystical about mirrors.
messages.full_text: There has always been something mystical about mirrors.
messages.translation: 鏡には常に何か神秘的なものが宿っている。
messages.dict_source: There has always been something mystical about mirrors.

messages.raw_format: There is a Mastermind deep in the dungeon.
messages.full_text: There is a Mastermind deep in the dungeon.
messages.translation: ダンジョンの奥深くに首謀者が潜んでいる。
messages.dict_source: There is a Mastermind deep in the dungeon.

messages.raw_format: There is a big treasure hidden in the zoo!
messages.full_text: There is a big treasure hidden in the zoo!
messages.translation: 動物園に大きな宝物が隠されている！
messages.dict_source: There is a big treasure hidden in the zoo!

messages.raw_format: There is more magic in this cave than meets the eye.
messages.full_text: There is more magic in this cave than meets the eye.
messages.translation: この洞窟には目に見える以上の魔法が満ちている。
messages.dict_source: There is more magic in this cave than meets the eye.

messages.raw_format: There is no harm in praising a large dog.
messages.full_text: There is no harm in praising a large dog.
messages.translation: 大きな犬を褒めても害はない。
messages.dict_source: There is no harm in praising a large dog.

messages.raw_format: There is nothing like eating a mimic.
messages.full_text: There is nothing like eating a mimic.
messages.translation: ミミックを食べることに勝るものはない（いい意味でも悪い意味でも）。
messages.dict_source: There is nothing like eating a mimic.

messages.raw_format: There once was a Knight named Lancelot who liked to ride with his lance a lot.
messages.full_text: There once was a Knight named Lancelot who liked to ride with his lance a lot.
messages.translation: 昔々、ランスロットという名の騎士がいた。彼は槍（ランス）を持って乗り回すのが大好きだった。
messages.dict_source: There once was a Knight named Lancelot who liked to ride with his lance a lot.

messages.raw_format: They say a gelatinous cube can paralyze you...
messages.full_text: They say a gelatinous cube can paralyze you...
messages.translation: ゼラチン状の立方体は麻痺させると言われている...
messages.dict_source: They say a gelatinous cube can paralyze you...

messages.raw_format: They say that Juiblex is somewhat afraid of a wand of digging.
messages.full_text: They say that Juiblex is somewhat afraid of a wand of digging.
messages.translation: ジョウビレックスは、穴掘りの杖をやや恐れているらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that Juiblex is somewhat afraid of a wand of digging.

messages.raw_format: They say that Medusa would like to put you on a pedestal.
messages.full_text: They say that Medusa would like to put you on a pedestal.
messages.translation: メデューサは君を台座（石像として）に飾りたがっているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that Medusa would like to put you on a pedestal.

messages.raw_format: They say that Vlad lives!!! ... near the mazes.
messages.full_text: They say that Vlad lives!!! ... near the mazes.
messages.translation: ヴラドは生きているらしい!!! ....迷路の近くで。
messages.dict_source: They say that Vlad lives!!! ... near the mazes.

messages.raw_format: They say that 'Elbereth' is often written about.
messages.full_text: They say that 'Elbereth' is often written about.
messages.translation: Elbereth はよく書き記されるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that 'Elbereth' is often written about.

messages.raw_format: They say that a bag of holding can't hold everything.
messages.full_text: They say that a bag of holding can't hold everything.
messages.translation: 軽量化の袋でも、あらゆるものを入れられるわけではないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a bag of holding can't hold everything.

messages.raw_format: They say that a blessed tin of quasit meat is a quick meal.
messages.full_text: They say that a blessed tin of quasit meat is a quick meal.
messages.translation: 祝福されたクアジットの肉の缶詰は、手早い食事になるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a blessed tin of quasit meat is a quick meal.

messages.raw_format: They say that a cat avoids traps.
messages.full_text: They say that a cat avoids traps.
messages.translation: 猫は罠を避けると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a cat avoids traps.

messages.raw_format: They say that a cave spider will occasionally eat cave spider eggs.
messages.full_text: They say that a cave spider will occasionally eat cave spider eggs.
messages.translation: 洞窟蜘蛛は時折、自らの卵を食べると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a cave spider will occasionally eat cave spider eggs.

messages.raw_format: They say that a clever wizard can have stats:  18/** 24 18 24 24 24.
messages.full_text: They say that a clever wizard can have stats:  18/** 24 18 24 24 24.
messages.translation: 賢い魔法使いはステータス値がこうなるという：18/** 24 18 24 24 24。
messages.dict_source: They say that a clever wizard can have stats:  18/** 24 18 24 24 24.

messages.raw_format: They say that a clove of garlic makes a good talisman if handled right.
messages.full_text: They say that a clove of garlic makes a good talisman if handled right.
messages.translation: ニンニクの欠片は、正しく扱えば良い魔除けになるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a clove of garlic makes a good talisman if handled right.

messages.raw_format: They say that a cursed scroll of teleportation could land you in trouble.
messages.full_text: They say that a cursed scroll of teleportation could land you in trouble.
messages.translation: 呪われた転移の巻物はトラブルの元になると言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that a cursed scroll of teleportation could land you in trouble.

messages.raw_format: They say that a diamond is another kind of luck stone.
messages.full_text: They say that a diamond is another kind of luck stone.
messages.translation: ダイヤモンドもまた一種の幸運の石だと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that a diamond is another kind of luck stone.

messages.raw_format: They say that a dog can be trained to fetch objects.
messages.full_text: They say that a dog can be trained to fetch objects.
messages.translation: 犬は物を取ってくるよう訓練できると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a dog can be trained to fetch objects.

messages.raw_format: They say that a gelatinous cube makes a healthy breakfast.
messages.full_text: They say that a gelatinous cube makes a healthy breakfast.
messages.translation: ゼラチン質キューブは健康的な朝食だと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a gelatinous cube makes a healthy breakfast.

messages.raw_format: They say that a giant gets strong by eating right, try it!
messages.full_text: They say that a giant gets strong by eating right, try it!
messages.translation: 巨人は正しい食事で強くなるという噂だ。君も試してみろ！
messages.dict_source: They say that a giant gets strong by eating right, try it!

messages.raw_format: They say that a grid bug won't hit you when you cross it.
messages.full_text: They say that a grid bug won't hit you when you cross it.
messages.translation: グリッド・バグは、君がそれを横切る時には攻撃してこないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a grid bug won't hit you when you cross it.

messages.raw_format: They say that a lembas wafer is a very light snack.
messages.full_text: They say that a lembas wafer is a very light snack.
messages.translation: レンバスのウェハーは、非常に軽い軽食だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a lembas wafer is a very light snack.

messages.raw_format: They say that a loadstone has a strange attraction and is not bad luck.
messages.full_text: They say that a loadstone has a strange attraction and is not bad luck.
messages.translation: 磁石には不思議な引力があり、不運をもたらすものではないと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that a loadstone has a strange attraction and is not bad luck.

messages.raw_format: They say that a lock pick by any other name is still a lock pick.
messages.full_text: They say that a lock pick by any other name is still a lock pick.
messages.translation: ピッキングツールは名前を変えようがピッキングツールだという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a lock pick by any other name is still a lock pick.

messages.raw_format: They say that a lucky amulet will block poisoned arrows.
messages.full_text: They say that a lucky amulet will block poisoned arrows.
messages.translation: 幸運の護符は毒矢を防いでくれるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a lucky amulet will block poisoned arrows.

messages.raw_format: They say that a mirror will freeze a floating eye but you can still see it.
messages.full_text: They say that a mirror will freeze a floating eye but you can still see it.
messages.translation: 鏡は浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）を凍りつかせ（麻痺させ）るが、それでも見えるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a mirror will freeze a floating eye but you can still see it.

messages.raw_format: They say that a neutral character might get Giantslayer.
messages.full_text: They say that a neutral character might get Giantslayer.
messages.translation: 中立のキャラクターは「ジャイアントスレイヤー」を手に入れるかもしれないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a neutral character might get Giantslayer.

messages.raw_format: They say that a polymorph trap is magic and magic protection prevents it.
messages.full_text: They say that a polymorph trap is magic and magic protection prevents it.
messages.translation: 変身魔法の罠は魔法であり、魔法防御で防げるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a polymorph trap is magic and magic protection prevents it.

messages.raw_format: They say that a potion of healing can cancel a potion of sickness.
messages.full_text: They say that a potion of healing can cancel a potion of sickness.
messages.translation: 回復の薬は病気の薬（の効果）を打ち消すことができるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a potion of healing can cancel a potion of sickness.

messages.raw_format: They say that a potion of monster detection sometimes works both ways.
messages.full_text: They say that a potion of monster detection sometimes works both ways.
messages.translation: モンスター探知の薬は時として逆効果になるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a potion of monster detection sometimes works both ways.

messages.raw_format: They say that a sink looks different from high above the floor.
messages.full_text: They say that a sink looks different from high above the floor.
messages.translation: シンク（流し）は床のはるか上方から見ると違って見えるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a sink looks different from high above the floor.

messages.raw_format: They say that a summoned demon could improve your game.
messages.full_text: They say that a summoned demon could improve your game.
messages.translation: 召喚された悪魔は戦力を向上させると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a summoned demon could improve your game.

messages.raw_format: They say that a tin of wraith meat is a rare dining experience.
messages.full_text: They say that a tin of wraith meat is a rare dining experience.
messages.translation: レイスの肉の缶詰は、稀有な食事体験になるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a tin of wraith meat is a rare dining experience.

messages.raw_format: They say that a unicorn might bring you luck.
messages.full_text: They say that a unicorn might bring you luck.
messages.translation: ユニコーンは幸運をもたらすかもしれないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a unicorn might bring you luck.

messages.raw_format: They say that a wand of cancellation is like a wand of polymorph.
messages.full_text: They say that a wand of cancellation is like a wand of polymorph.
messages.translation: 消去の杖は、変化（ポリモーフ）の杖のようなものだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a wand of cancellation is like a wand of polymorph.

messages.raw_format: They say that a wand of locking can close more than just doors.
messages.full_text: They say that a wand of locking can close more than just doors.
messages.translation: 施錠の杖は、ドア以外のものも閉じることができるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a wand of locking can close more than just doors.

messages.raw_format: They say that a wand of polymorph can change your game.
messages.full_text: They say that a wand of polymorph can change your game.
messages.translation: 変化（ポリモーフ）の杖は、君のゲーム展開を変えることができるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a wand of polymorph can change your game.

messages.raw_format: They say that a wise choice of donations lets you choose your blessings.
messages.full_text: They say that a wise choice of donations lets you choose your blessings.
messages.translation: 寄付先を賢く選べば、授かる祝福を選べるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that a wise choice of donations lets you choose your blessings.

messages.raw_format: They say that a wizard is even more powerful the second time around.
messages.full_text: They say that a wizard is even more powerful the second time around.
messages.translation: 魔法使いは、二度目の挑戦（あるいは二周目）ではさらに強力になるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a wizard is even more powerful the second time around.

messages.raw_format: They say that a xorn knows of no obstacles when pursuing you.
messages.full_text: They say that a xorn knows of no obstacles when pursuing you.
messages.translation: ゾーンは追跡に際し障害を知らないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a xorn knows of no obstacles when pursuing you.

messages.raw_format: They say that abusing a credit card could shock you sooner or later.
messages.full_text: They say that abusing a credit card could shock you sooner or later.
messages.translation: クレジットカードを乱用すれば、遅かれ早かれショックを受けると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that abusing a credit card could shock you sooner or later.

messages.raw_format: They say that amulets, like most things, can be deadly or life saving.
messages.full_text: They say that amulets, like most things, can be deadly or life saving.
messages.translation: 護符は他の多くのものと同様、致命的にもなれば命を救うこともあるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that amulets, like most things, can be deadly or life saving.

messages.raw_format: They say that an altar can identify blessings.
messages.full_text: They say that an altar can identify blessings.
messages.translation: 祭壇は祝福を識別できると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that an altar can identify blessings.

messages.raw_format: They say that an ooze will bite your boots and a rock mole might eat them.
messages.full_text: They say that an ooze will bite your boots and a rock mole might eat them.
messages.translation: スライムはブーツを噛みつき、岩モグラはそれを食べるかもしれないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that an ooze will bite your boots and a rock mole might eat them.

messages.raw_format: They say that an unlucky hacker was once killed by an exploding tin.
messages.full_text: They say that an unlucky hacker was once killed by an exploding tin.
messages.translation: 不運なハッカーが缶詰の爆発で死んだことがあるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that an unlucky hacker was once killed by an exploding tin.

messages.raw_format: They say that antique dealers are always interested in precious stones.
messages.full_text: They say that antique dealers are always interested in precious stones.
messages.translation: 骨董品店主は常に宝石に興味を持っているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that antique dealers are always interested in precious stones.

messages.raw_format: They say that bandaging one's wounds helps to keep up one's appearance.
messages.full_text: They say that bandaging one's wounds helps to keep up one's appearance.
messages.translation: 傷口に包帯を巻くことは、外見を保つのに役立つという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that bandaging one's wounds helps to keep up one's appearance.

messages.raw_format: They say that booze can be diluted but not cancelled.
messages.full_text: They say that booze can be diluted but not cancelled.
messages.translation: 酒は薄めることはできるが、無効化（消去）はできないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that booze can be diluted but not cancelled.

messages.raw_format: They say that by listening carefully, you can hear a secret door!
messages.full_text: They say that by listening carefully, you can hear a secret door!
messages.translation: 注意深く耳を澄ませば、隠し扉の音が聞こえるという噂だ！
messages.dict_source: They say that by listening carefully, you can hear a secret door!

messages.raw_format: They say that carrots and carrot juice may improve your vision.
messages.full_text: They say that carrots and carrot juice may improve your vision.
messages.translation: ニンジンとニンジンジュースは視力を良くすると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that carrots and carrot juice may improve your vision.

messages.raw_format: They say that cave spiders are not considered expensive health food.
messages.full_text: They say that cave spiders are not considered expensive health food.
messages.translation: 洞窟のクモは高価な健康食品とはみなされていないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that cave spiders are not considered expensive health food.

messages.raw_format: They say that demigods must leave behind their prized earthly possessions.
messages.full_text: They say that demigods must leave behind their prized earthly possessions.
messages.translation: 半神(demigods)は、この世で最も大切な所有物を残して去らねばならないと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that demigods must leave behind their prized earthly possessions.

messages.raw_format: They say that disturbing a djinni can be a costly mistake.
messages.full_text: They say that disturbing a djinni can be a costly mistake.
messages.translation: 魔神（ジン）を邪魔することは、高くつく間違いになる可能性があるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that disturbing a djinni can be a costly mistake.

messages.raw_format: They say that dragon scales can be quite enchanting.
messages.full_text: They say that dragon scales can be quite enchanting.
messages.translation: ドラゴンの鱗はかなり魅惑的だと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that dragon scales can be quite enchanting.

messages.raw_format: They say that dropping coins into a fountain will not grant you a wish.
messages.full_text: They say that dropping coins into a fountain will not grant you a wish.
messages.translation: 泉にコインを投げ入れても、願いは叶わないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that dropping coins into a fountain will not grant you a wish.

messages.raw_format: They say that dwarves lawfully mind their own business.
messages.full_text: They say that dwarves lawfully mind their own business.
messages.translation: ドワーフは秩序（ローフル）に従い、自分の仕事に専念しているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that dwarves lawfully mind their own business.

messages.raw_format: They say that eating a bat corpse will make you batty, for a while.
messages.full_text: They say that eating a bat corpse will make you batty, for a while.
messages.translation: コウモリの死骸を食べると一時的に頭がおかしくなるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that eating a bat corpse will make you batty, for a while.

messages.raw_format: They say that eating a cram ration is a smart move.
messages.full_text: They say that eating a cram ration is a smart move.
messages.translation: 携帯食糧（cram ration）を食べるのは賢い選択だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that eating a cram ration is a smart move.

messages.raw_format: They say that eating blue jelly is cool if you don't fight the feeling.
messages.full_text: They say that eating blue jelly is cool if you don't fight the feeling.
messages.translation: 青いゼリーを食べるのは、その感覚に逆らわなければクールだと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that eating blue jelly is cool if you don't fight the feeling.

messages.raw_format: They say that elven armor can hold the most magic.
messages.full_text: They say that elven armor can hold the most magic.
messages.translation: エルフの防具は最も多くの魔力を宿せるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that elven armor can hold the most magic.

messages.raw_format: They say that escaping a dungeon is only the beginning of the end.
messages.full_text: They say that escaping a dungeon is only the beginning of the end.
messages.translation: ダンジョンからの脱出は、終わりのはじまりに過ぎないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that escaping a dungeon is only the beginning of the end.

messages.raw_format: They say that feeling an unexpected draft of air is sort of a breakthrough.
messages.full_text: They say that feeling an unexpected draft of air is sort of a breakthrough.
messages.translation: 予期せぬ隙間風を感じることは、一種の突破口（隠し扉の発見）だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that feeling an unexpected draft of air is sort of a breakthrough.

messages.raw_format: They say that finding a cursed gray stone is always bad luck.
messages.full_text: They say that finding a cursed gray stone is always bad luck.
messages.translation: 呪われた灰色の石を見つけると必ず不運が訪れると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that finding a cursed gray stone is always bad luck.

messages.raw_format: They say that gaining a level is an experience that can raise your sights.
messages.full_text: They say that gaining a level is an experience that can raise your sights.
messages.translation: レベルアップは視野を広げる経験だと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that gaining a level is an experience that can raise your sights.

messages.raw_format: They say that garter snake meat may not taste good but it's still healthy.
messages.full_text: They say that garter snake meat may not taste good but it's still healthy.
messages.translation: ガータースネークの肉はうまくないかもしれないが、それでも健康には良いらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that garter snake meat may not taste good but it's still healthy.

messages.raw_format: They say that gauntlets of dexterity have a hidden enchanted touch.
messages.full_text: They say that gauntlets of dexterity have a hidden enchanted touch.
messages.translation: 器用さの小手には、隠された魔法の感触があるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that gauntlets of dexterity have a hidden enchanted touch.

messages.raw_format: They say that going to heaven is just another way of escaping the dungeon.
messages.full_text: They say that going to heaven is just another way of escaping the dungeon.
messages.translation: 天国へ行くことは、ダンジョンから脱出するもう一つの方法にすぎないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that going to heaven is just another way of escaping the dungeon.

messages.raw_format: They say that golden nagas are law-abiding denizens as long as you are too.
messages.full_text: They say that golden nagas are law-abiding denizens as long as you are too.
messages.translation: 黄金のナーガは、あなたもそうである限り、法を遵守する住人だと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that golden nagas are law-abiding denizens as long as you are too.

messages.raw_format: They say that gremlins can make you feel cooler than you are now.
messages.full_text: They say that gremlins can make you feel cooler than you are now.
messages.translation: グレムリンは君を今よりずっと涼しく（凍えさせて）くれるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that gremlins can make you feel cooler than you are now.

messages.raw_format: They say that grid bugs only exist in a strictly Cartesian sense.
messages.full_text: They say that grid bugs only exist in a strictly Cartesian sense.
messages.translation: グリッド・バグは厳密にデカルト的（格子状）な意味でしか存在しないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that grid bugs only exist in a strictly Cartesian sense.

messages.raw_format: They say that hackers often feel jumpy about eating nymphs.
messages.full_text: They say that hackers often feel jumpy about eating nymphs.
messages.translation: ハッカーはニンフを食べることに、しばしば不安を感じるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that hackers often feel jumpy about eating nymphs.

messages.raw_format: They say that having polymorph control won't shock you.
messages.full_text: They say that having polymorph control won't shock you.
messages.translation: 変化制御（ポリモーフ・コントロール）を持っていても、ショックは受けないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that having polymorph control won't shock you.

messages.raw_format: They say that healing potions often come in pairs.
messages.full_text: They say that healing potions often come in pairs.
messages.translation: 回復の薬はよく対で見つかるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that healing potions often come in pairs.

messages.raw_format: They say that if it's hard getting your food down another bite could kill.
messages.full_text: They say that if it's hard getting your food down another bite could kill.
messages.translation: 食べ物を飲み込むのが難しい（満腹）なら、もう一口で死ぬかもしれないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that if it's hard getting your food down another bite could kill.

messages.raw_format: They say that if you don't wear glasses why bother with carrots?
messages.full_text: They say that if you don't wear glasses why bother with carrots?
messages.translation: メガネをかけていないなら、なぜニンジンを気にする必要がある？（ニンジンは目に良いという噂だ）
messages.dict_source: They say that if you don't wear glasses why bother with carrots?

messages.raw_format: They say that if you notice a loose board beneath you, don't step on it.
messages.full_text: They say that if you notice a loose board beneath you, don't step on it.
messages.translation: 足元の板が緩んでいることに気づいたら、踏んではいけないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that if you notice a loose board beneath you, don't step on it.

messages.raw_format: They say that if you start at the bottom the only place to go is up.
messages.full_text: They say that if you start at the bottom the only place to go is up.
messages.translation: どん底（最下層）から始めたなら、あとは上がるしかないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that if you start at the bottom the only place to go is up.

messages.raw_format: They say that if you teleport to heaven you're presumed to be dead already.
messages.full_text: They say that if you teleport to heaven you're presumed to be dead already.
messages.translation: 天国にテレポートしたなら、すでに死んでいるとみなされるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that if you teleport to heaven you're presumed to be dead already.

messages.raw_format: They say that in a shop you can be charged for old charges.
messages.full_text: They say that in a shop you can be charged for old charges.
messages.translation: 店では、古い（魔法の杖の）使用回数分まで請求される可能性があるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that in a shop you can be charged for old charges.

messages.raw_format: They say that in lighter moments you could think of ways to pass a stone.
messages.full_text: They say that in lighter moments you could think of ways to pass a stone.
messages.translation: 体が軽い時（浮遊中など）には、石を通り抜ける方法を思いつくかもしれないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that in lighter moments you could think of ways to pass a stone.

messages.raw_format: They say that in the dungeon breaking a mirror can be seven years bad luck.
messages.full_text: They say that in the dungeon breaking a mirror can be seven years bad luck.
messages.translation: ダンジョンで鏡を割ることは、7年間の不運を招くという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that in the dungeon breaking a mirror can be seven years bad luck.

messages.raw_format: They say that in the dungeon you don't usually have any luck at all.
messages.full_text: They say that in the dungeon you don't usually have any luck at all.
messages.translation: ダンジョンでは通常、運など全く持ち合わせていないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that in the dungeon you don't usually have any luck at all.

messages.raw_format: They say that in time a blessed luckstone can make your god happy.
messages.full_text: They say that in time a blessed luckstone can make your god happy.
messages.translation: 時が経てば、祝福された幸運石は神を喜ばせると言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that in time a blessed luckstone can make your god happy.

messages.raw_format: They say that it is easier to kill the Wizard than to make him stand still.
messages.full_text: They say that it is easier to kill the Wizard than to make him stand still.
messages.translation: 魔法使いを殺す方が、彼をじっとしておくより簡単だと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that it is easier to kill the Wizard than to make him stand still.

messages.raw_format: They say that it only takes 1 zorkmid to meet the Kops.
messages.full_text: They say that it only takes 1 zorkmid to meet the Kops.
messages.translation: たった1ゾークミドで、コップスに会うことができると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that it only takes 1 zorkmid to meet the Kops.

messages.raw_format: They say that it's a blast when you mix the right potions together.
messages.full_text: They say that it's a blast when you mix the right potions together.
messages.translation: 適切なポーションを混ぜ合わせると、爆発（素晴らしい効果、あるいは本当の爆発）が起きるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that it's a blast when you mix the right potions together.

messages.raw_format: They say that it's not blind luck if you catch a glimpse of Medusa.
messages.full_text: They say that it's not blind luck if you catch a glimpse of Medusa.
messages.translation: メデューサを一瞥できても、それはまぐれではないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that it's not blind luck if you catch a glimpse of Medusa.

messages.raw_format: They say that killing a shopkeeper brings bad luck.
messages.full_text: They say that killing a shopkeeper brings bad luck.
messages.translation: 店主を殺すと不運を招くという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that killing a shopkeeper brings bad luck.

messages.raw_format: They say that monsters never step on a scare monster scroll.
messages.full_text: They say that monsters never step on a scare monster scroll.
messages.translation: モンスターは決して怪物の巻物の上を歩かないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that monsters never step on a scare monster scroll.

messages.raw_format: They say that most monsters find flute recitals extremely boring.
messages.full_text: They say that most monsters find flute recitals extremely boring.
messages.translation: ほとんどのモンスターは、フルートの独奏会をこの上なく退屈だと感じているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that most monsters find flute recitals extremely boring.

messages.raw_format: They say that mummy corpses are not well preserved.
messages.full_text: They say that mummy corpses are not well preserved.
messages.translation: ミイラの死体は保存状態が悪いという。
messages.dict_source: They say that mummy corpses are not well preserved.

messages.raw_format: They say that naturally a wand of wishing would be heavily guarded.
messages.full_text: They say that naturally a wand of wishing would be heavily guarded.
messages.translation: 願いの杖は当然厳重に守られていると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that naturally a wand of wishing would be heavily guarded.

messages.raw_format: They say that no one notices the junk underneath a boulder.
messages.full_text: They say that no one notices the junk underneath a boulder.
messages.translation: 岩の下に隠されたガラクタに誰も気づかないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that no one notices the junk underneath a boulder.

messages.raw_format: They say that nobody expects a unicorn horn to rust.
messages.full_text: They say that nobody expects a unicorn horn to rust.
messages.translation: 誰もユニコーンの角が錆びるとは思わないものだと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that nobody expects a unicorn horn to rust.

messages.raw_format: They say that nobody knows if an explorer can live forever.  Do you?
messages.full_text: They say that nobody knows if an explorer can live forever.  Do you?
messages.translation: 冒険家が永遠に生きられるかどうかは誰も知らないという噂だ。君はどう思う？
messages.dict_source: They say that nobody knows if an explorer can live forever.  Do you?

messages.raw_format: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a djinni.
messages.full_text: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a djinni.
messages.translation: 一部のポーションが精霊を閉じ込めているという事実を、何ものも変えられないと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a djinni.

messages.raw_format: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a ghost.
messages.full_text: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a ghost.
messages.translation: いくつかのポーションに幽霊が入っているという事実は、何をもってしても変えられないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that nothing can change the fact that some potions contain a ghost.

messages.raw_format: They say that nymphs always fall for rock'n'roll, try it!
messages.full_text: They say that nymphs always fall for rock'n'roll, try it!
messages.translation: ニンフは常にロックンロール（楽器の演奏）に夢中になるという噂だ。試してみろ！
messages.dict_source: They say that nymphs always fall for rock'n'roll, try it!

messages.raw_format: They say that once an Olog-Hai is canned it never shows its face again.
messages.full_text: They say that once an Olog-Hai is canned it never shows its face again.
messages.translation: オログ＝ハイ（トロール）は一度缶詰にされると、二度とその姿を現さないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that once an Olog-Hai is canned it never shows its face again.

messages.raw_format: They say that once upon a time xans would never scratch your boots.
messages.full_text: They say that once upon a time xans would never scratch your boots.
messages.translation: 昔々、ザン（Xan）は決して靴をひっかかなかったという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that once upon a time xans would never scratch your boots.

messages.raw_format: They say that only an experienced wizard can do the tengu shuffle.
messages.full_text: They say that only an experienced wizard can do the tengu shuffle.
messages.translation: 熟練した魔法使いだけが「天狗のシャッフル（テレポート）」をこなせるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that only an experienced wizard can do the tengu shuffle.

messages.raw_format: They say that only chaotics can kill shopkeepers and get away with it.
messages.full_text: They say that only chaotics can kill shopkeepers and get away with it.
messages.translation: 店主を殺して何事もなく逃げおおせるのは、混沌（カオティック）の者だけだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that only chaotics can kill shopkeepers and get away with it.

messages.raw_format: They say that only female monsters can lay eggs.
messages.full_text: They say that only female monsters can lay eggs.
messages.translation: 卵を産めるのは雌の怪物だけだと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that only female monsters can lay eggs.

messages.raw_format: They say that playing a horn really bad is really good.
messages.full_text: They say that playing a horn really bad is really good.
messages.translation: ホルンをこの上なく下手に吹くことは、実はこの上なく良いことだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that playing a horn really bad is really good.

messages.raw_format: They say that prayer at an altar can sometimes make the water there holy.
messages.full_text: They say that prayer at an altar can sometimes make the water there holy.
messages.translation: 祭壇での祈りは、そこに流れる水を聖なるものに変えることがあるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that prayer at an altar can sometimes make the water there holy.

messages.raw_format: They say that the right wand may help you chase a nymph.
messages.full_text: They say that the right wand may help you chase a nymph.
messages.translation: 正しい杖があれば、ニンフを追い払う助けになるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that the right wand may help you chase a nymph.

messages.raw_format: They say that rubbing a glowing potion does not make it a magic lamp.
messages.full_text: They say that rubbing a glowing potion does not make it a magic lamp.
messages.translation: 光る薬をこすっても魔法のランプにはならないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that rubbing a glowing potion does not make it a magic lamp.

messages.raw_format: They say that scalpels become dull because they're not athames.
messages.full_text: They say that scalpels become dull because they're not athames.
messages.translation: メスが鈍るのは、それがアターム（魔術用短剣）ではないからだと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that scalpels become dull because they're not athames.

messages.raw_format: They say that shopkeepers don't like pick-axes.
messages.full_text: They say that shopkeepers don't like pick-axes.
messages.translation: 店主はつるはしを嫌うと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that shopkeepers don't like pick-axes.

messages.raw_format: They say that shopkeepers don't mind you bringing your pets in the shop.
messages.full_text: They say that shopkeepers don't mind you bringing your pets in the shop.
messages.translation: 店主は、君がペットを店内に連れ込むのを気にしないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that shopkeepers don't mind you bringing your pets in the shop.

messages.raw_format: They say that shopkeepers don't usually mind if you sneak into a shop.
messages.full_text: They say that shopkeepers don't usually mind if you sneak into a shop.
messages.translation: 店主に黙ってこっそり店に入っても大抵は気にしないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that shopkeepers don't usually mind if you sneak into a shop.

messages.raw_format: They say that shopkeepers often have a large amount of money in their purses.
messages.full_text: They say that shopkeepers often have a large amount of money in their purses.
messages.translation: 店主は財布に多額の金を持っていることが多いと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that shopkeepers often have a large amount of money in their purses.

messages.raw_format: They say that shopkeepers often remember things that you might forget.
messages.full_text: They say that shopkeepers often remember things that you might forget.
messages.translation: 店主は、君が忘れているようなことをよく覚えているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that shopkeepers often remember things that you might forget.

messages.raw_format: They say that sinks and armor don't mix, take your cloak off now!
messages.full_text: They say that sinks and armor don't mix, take your cloak off now!
messages.translation: 罪と鎧は相容れないと言う、今すぐマントを脱げ！
messages.dict_source: They say that sinks and armor don't mix, take your cloak off now!

messages.raw_format: They say that sinks run hot and cold and many flavors in between.
messages.full_text: They say that sinks run hot and cold and many flavors in between.
messages.translation: シンク（流し）からはお湯や水、そしてその中間のさまざまな「味」が流れ出るという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that sinks run hot and cold and many flavors in between.

messages.raw_format: They say that sitting on a vampire's throne is worth the danger.
messages.full_text: They say that sitting on a vampire's throne is worth the danger.
messages.translation: 吸血鬼の玉座に座るのは、危険を冒す価値があるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that sitting on a vampire's throne is worth the danger.

messages.raw_format: They say that snake charmers aren't charismatic, just musical.
messages.full_text: They say that snake charmers aren't charismatic, just musical.
messages.translation: 蛇使いにはカリスマ性があるのではなく、ただ音楽の才能があるだけだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that snake charmers aren't charismatic, just musical.

messages.raw_format: They say that soldiers are always prepared and usually protected.
messages.full_text: They say that soldiers are always prepared and usually protected.
messages.translation: 兵士は常に準備ができており、通常は身を守っていると言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that soldiers are always prepared and usually protected.

messages.raw_format: They say that some eggs could hatch in your pack, lucky or not.
messages.full_text: They say that some eggs could hatch in your pack, lucky or not.
messages.translation: 運が良くても悪くても、卵がバックパックの中で孵化することがあるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that some eggs could hatch in your pack, lucky or not.

messages.raw_format: They say that some fire ants will make you a hot meal.
messages.full_text: They say that some fire ants will make you a hot meal.
messages.translation: 火蟻の中には、あなたを温かい食事にしてしまうものもいると言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that some fire ants will make you a hot meal.

messages.raw_format: They say that some horns play hot music and others are too cool for words.
messages.full_text: They say that some horns play hot music and others are too cool for words.
messages.translation: あるホルンは熱い音楽を奏で、あるものは言葉にできないほどクール（凍えるよう）だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that some horns play hot music and others are too cool for words.

messages.raw_format: They say that some humanoids are nonetheless quite human.
messages.full_text: They say that some humanoids are nonetheless quite human.
messages.translation: ある人型生物（ヒューマノイド）は、それにもかかわらず極めて人間的だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that some humanoids are nonetheless quite human.

messages.raw_format: They say that some shopkeepers consider gems to be family heirlooms.
messages.full_text: They say that some shopkeepers consider gems to be family heirlooms.
messages.translation: 宝石を家宝と見なす店主もいるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that some shopkeepers consider gems to be family heirlooms.

messages.raw_format: They say that some shopkeepers recognize gems but they won't tell you.
messages.full_text: They say that some shopkeepers recognize gems but they won't tell you.
messages.translation: 宝石を見分けられる店主もいるが、教えてくれないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that some shopkeepers recognize gems but they won't tell you.

messages.raw_format: They say that some stones are much much heavier than others.
messages.full_text: They say that some stones are much much heavier than others.
messages.translation: ある種の石は他のものよりはるかに重いという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that some stones are much much heavier than others.

messages.raw_format: They say that some yetis are full of hot air.
messages.full_text: They say that some yetis are full of hot air.
messages.translation: ある種のイエティは、熱気（またはデタラメ）に満ちているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that some yetis are full of hot air.

messages.raw_format: They say that something very special would be in a well-protected place.
messages.full_text: They say that something very special would be in a well-protected place.
messages.translation: 何か特別なものが厳重に守られた場所にあるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that something very special would be in a well-protected place.

messages.raw_format: They say that speed boots aren't fast enough to let you walk on water.
messages.full_text: They say that speed boots aren't fast enough to let you walk on water.
messages.translation: スピードブーツでは水の上を歩けないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that speed boots aren't fast enough to let you walk on water.

messages.raw_format: They say that teleport traps are the devil's work.
messages.full_text: They say that teleport traps are the devil's work.
messages.translation: テレポートの罠は悪魔の仕業だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that teleport traps are the devil's work.

messages.raw_format: They say that tengu don't wear rings, why should you?
messages.full_text: They say that tengu don't wear rings, why should you?
messages.translation: 天狗は指輪を嵌めないと言うが、お前が嵌める必要があるか？
messages.dict_source: They say that tengu don't wear rings, why should you?

messages.raw_format: They say that tengu never steal gold although they would be good at it.
messages.full_text: They say that tengu never steal gold although they would be good at it.
messages.translation: 天狗は金貨を盗むのが得意だが決して盗まないと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that tengu never steal gold although they would be good at it.

messages.raw_format: They say that that which was stolen once can be stolen again, ask any nymph.
messages.full_text: They say that that which was stolen once can be stolen again, ask any nymph.
messages.translation: 一度盗まれたものは再び盗まれうる。ニンフに聞いてみるがいい、という噂だ。
