messages.dict_source: They say that that which was stolen once can be stolen again, ask any nymph.

messages.raw_format: They say that the best way to fix your injuries is a potion.
messages.full_text: They say that the best way to fix your injuries is a potion.
messages.translation: 傷を治す最善の方法は薬らしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that the best way to fix your injuries is a potion.

messages.raw_format: They say that the Delphic Oracle knows that lizard corpses aren't confusing.
messages.full_text: They say that the Delphic Oracle knows that lizard corpses aren't confusing.
messages.translation: デルポイの神託は、トカゲの死体が混乱（を治すこと）に役立つことを知っているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the Delphic Oracle knows that lizard corpses aren't confusing.

messages.raw_format: They say that the Hand of Elbereth can hold up your prayers.
messages.full_text: They say that the Hand of Elbereth can hold up your prayers.
messages.translation: エルベレスの手は祈りを支えると伝えられている。
messages.dict_source: They say that the Hand of Elbereth can hold up your prayers.

messages.raw_format: They say that the Leprechaun King is rich as Croesus.
messages.full_text: They say that the Leprechaun King is rich as Croesus.
messages.translation: レプラコーンの王はクロイソスのように裕福だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the Leprechaun King is rich as Croesus.

messages.raw_format: They say that the Wizard of Yendor is schizophrenic and suicidal.
messages.full_text: They say that the Wizard of Yendor is schizophrenic and suicidal.
messages.translation: イェンドールの魔法使いは、精神が不安定で自滅的だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the Wizard of Yendor is schizophrenic and suicidal.

messages.raw_format: They say that the experienced character knows how to convert an altar.
messages.full_text: They say that the experienced character knows how to convert an altar.
messages.translation: 経験豊富なキャラクターは祭壇の転換法を知っているという。
messages.dict_source: They say that the experienced character knows how to convert an altar.

messages.raw_format: They say that the gods are happy when they drop objects at your feet.
messages.full_text: They say that the gods are happy when they drop objects at your feet.
messages.translation: 神々が君の足元にアイテムを落とす時、彼らは機嫌が良いのだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the gods are happy when they drop objects at your feet.

messages.raw_format: They say that the idea of invisible Nazgul has a certain ring to it.
messages.full_text: They say that the idea of invisible Nazgul has a certain ring to it.
messages.translation: 見えないナズグルという発想には、どこか響きがあると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that the idea of invisible Nazgul has a certain ring to it.

messages.raw_format: They say that the lady of the lake now lives in a fountain somewhere.
messages.full_text: They say that the lady of the lake now lives in a fountain somewhere.
messages.translation: 湖の貴婦人は今、どこかの泉に住んでいるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the lady of the lake now lives in a fountain somewhere.

messages.raw_format: They say that the local shopkeeper frowns upon the rude tourist.
messages.full_text: They say that the local shopkeeper frowns upon the rude tourist.
messages.translation: 地元の店主は、無礼な観光客に眉をひそめるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the local shopkeeper frowns upon the rude tourist.

messages.raw_format: They say that the only door to the vampire's tower is on its lowest level.
messages.full_text: They say that the only door to the vampire's tower is on its lowest level.
messages.translation: 吸血鬼の塔への唯一の入り口は、最下層にあるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the only door to the vampire's tower is on its lowest level.

messages.raw_format: They say that the only good djinni is a grateful djinni.
messages.full_text: They say that the only good djinni is a grateful djinni.
messages.translation: 唯一の良い魔神（ジン）とは、感謝している魔神のことだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the only good djinni is a grateful djinni.

messages.raw_format: They say that the thing about genocide is that it works both ways.
messages.full_text: They say that the thing about genocide is that it works both ways.
messages.translation: 皆殺し（ジェノサイド）は、敵味方の両方に作用する可能性があるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the thing about genocide is that it works both ways.

messages.raw_format: They say that the unicorn horn rule is if it ain't broke then don't fix it.
messages.full_text: They say that the unicorn horn rule is if it ain't broke then don't fix it.
messages.translation: ユニコーンの角のルールは「壊れていないなら直すな（使わなくていい）」だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the unicorn horn rule is if it ain't broke then don't fix it.

messages.raw_format: They say that the view from a fog cloud is really very moving.
messages.full_text: They say that the view from a fog cloud is really very moving.
messages.translation: 霧雲から見る景色は実に感動的だと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that the view from a fog cloud is really very moving.

messages.raw_format: They say that the walls in shops are made of extra hard material.
messages.full_text: They say that the walls in shops are made of extra hard material.
messages.translation: 店の壁は特別に硬い素材で作られているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that the walls in shops are made of extra hard material.

messages.raw_format: They say that there are at least 15 ways to lose a pair of levitation boots.
messages.full_text: They say that there are at least 15 ways to lose a pair of levitation boots.
messages.translation: 浮遊の靴を失う方法は、少なくとも15通りあるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that there are at least 15 ways to lose a pair of levitation boots.

messages.raw_format: They say that throwing glass gems is the same as throwing rocks.
messages.full_text: They say that throwing glass gems is the same as throwing rocks.
messages.translation: ガラスの宝石を投げるのは、石を投げるのと同じだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that throwing glass gems is the same as throwing rocks.

messages.raw_format: They say that to block a shocking sphere, you need the right shield.
messages.full_text: They say that to block a shocking sphere, you need the right shield.
messages.translation: 電撃の球体を防ぐには、適切な盾が必要らしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that to block a shocking sphere, you need the right shield.

messages.raw_format: They say that trespassing a boulder is probably beneath you.
messages.full_text: They say that trespassing a boulder is probably beneath you.
messages.translation: 岩を乗り越える（trespassing）のは、おそらく君の「下（beneath）」にある（つまらない、または文字通り岩をまたぐ）ことだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that trespassing a boulder is probably beneath you.

messages.raw_format: They say that true power comes from within...except when it doesn't.
messages.full_text: They say that true power comes from within...except when it doesn't.
messages.translation: 真の力は内側から来るらしい....そうでないときを除いて。
messages.dict_source: They say that true power comes from within...except when it doesn't.

messages.raw_format: They say that unicorns are fond of precious gems.
messages.full_text: They say that unicorns are fond of precious gems.
messages.translation: ユニコーンは貴重な宝石を好むという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that unicorns are fond of precious gems.

messages.raw_format: They say that what goes down the drain might come back up.
messages.full_text: They say that what goes down the drain might come back up.
messages.translation: 排水口に流れたものは戻ってくるかもしれないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that what goes down the drain might come back up.

messages.raw_format: They say that wielded, a long sword named Fire Brand makes you feel cooler.
messages.full_text: They say that wielded, a long sword named Fire Brand makes you feel cooler.
messages.translation: 「ファイアブランド」という名のロングソードを振るうと、よりクール（涼しく、または格好良く）になれるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that wielded, a long sword named Fire Brand makes you feel cooler.

messages.raw_format: They say that wielded, a long sword named Frost Brand makes you hot stuff.
messages.full_text: They say that wielded, a long sword named Frost Brand makes you hot stuff.
messages.translation: 「フロストブランド」という名のロングソードを振るうと、君は熱い存在（hot stuff）になれるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that wielded, a long sword named Frost Brand makes you hot stuff.

messages.raw_format: They say that wiping its face is impossible for a floating eye.
messages.full_text: They say that wiping its face is impossible for a floating eye.
messages.translation: 浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）にとって、自分の顔を拭くのは不可能だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that wiping its face is impossible for a floating eye.

messages.raw_format: They say that with a floating eye you could see in the dark.
messages.full_text: They say that with a floating eye you could see in the dark.
messages.translation: 浮遊眼があれば暗闇でも見えると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that with a floating eye you could see in the dark.

messages.raw_format: They say that you are lucky if you can get a unicorn to catch a ruby.
messages.full_text: They say that you are lucky if you can get a unicorn to catch a ruby.
messages.translation: ユニコーンにルビーを受け取ってもらえたなら、君は幸運だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you are lucky if you can get a unicorn to catch a ruby.

messages.raw_format: They say that you are what you eat.
messages.full_text: They say that you are what you eat.
messages.translation: 人は食べたものでできているという。
messages.dict_source: They say that you are what you eat.

messages.raw_format: They say that you can find named weapons at an altar if you're lucky.
messages.full_text: They say that you can find named weapons at an altar if you're lucky.
messages.translation: 運が良ければ、祭壇で銘入りの武器（アーティファクト）を見つけることができるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you can find named weapons at an altar if you're lucky.

messages.raw_format: They say that you can give potions of extra healing new energy.
messages.full_text: They say that you can give potions of extra healing new energy.
messages.translation: 追加回復の薬に新しい活力を与えることもできるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say that you can give potions of extra healing new energy.

messages.raw_format: They say that you can safely touch cockatrice eggs but why bother?
messages.full_text: They say that you can safely touch cockatrice eggs but why bother?
messages.translation: コカトリスの卵には安全に触れることができるが、あえてそうする必要があるか？ という噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you can safely touch cockatrice eggs but why bother?

messages.raw_format: They say that you can't break an amulet of reflection.
messages.full_text: They say that you can't break an amulet of reflection.
messages.translation: 反射のお守り（護符）は決して壊せないと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that you can't break an amulet of reflection.

messages.raw_format: They say that you don't always get what you wish for.
messages.full_text: They say that you don't always get what you wish for.
messages.translation: 望んだものが常に手に入るとは限らないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you don't always get what you wish for.

messages.raw_format: They say that you should always be prepared for a final challenge.
messages.full_text: They say that you should always be prepared for a final challenge.
messages.translation: 最後の試練には常に備えるべきだという。
messages.dict_source: They say that you should always be prepared for a final challenge.

messages.raw_format: They say that you should ask a dwarf to let you into a locked shop.
messages.full_text: They say that you should ask a dwarf to let you into a locked shop.
messages.translation: 施錠された店に入りたいなら、ドワーフに頼んでみるべきだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you should ask a dwarf to let you into a locked shop.

messages.raw_format: They say that you should pray for divine inspiration.
messages.full_text: They say that you should pray for divine inspiration.
messages.translation: 神からの啓示を祈るべきだと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that you should pray for divine inspiration.

messages.raw_format: They say that you should religiously give your gold away.
messages.full_text: They say that you should religiously give your gold away.
messages.translation: 金は（神に捧げるなどして）信心深く手放すべきだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you should religiously give your gold away.

messages.raw_format: They say that you will never get healthy by eating geckos.
messages.full_text: They say that you will never get healthy by eating geckos.
messages.translation: ヤモリを食べて健康になることは決してない、という噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that you will never get healthy by eating geckos.

messages.raw_format: They say that zapping yourself with a wand of undead turning is stupid.
messages.full_text: They say that zapping yourself with a wand of undead turning is stupid.
messages.translation: 不死身化（アンデッド・ターニング）の杖を自分に振るうのは愚かだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that zapping yourself with a wand of undead turning is stupid.

messages.raw_format: They say the Furies are more furious if you've been sinning.
messages.full_text: They say the Furies are more furious if you've been sinning.
messages.translation: 罪を重ねていると、フューリーたちはさらに凶暴になるらしい。
messages.dict_source: They say the Furies are more furious if you've been sinning.

messages.raw_format: They say the Wizard's castle is booby-trapped!
messages.full_text: They say the Wizard's castle is booby-trapped!
messages.translation: 魔法使いの城には罠が仕掛けられていると言う！
messages.dict_source: They say the Wizard's castle is booby-trapped!

messages.raw_format: They say the gods get angry if you kill your dog.
messages.full_text: They say the gods get angry if you kill your dog.
messages.translation: 飼い犬を殺すと神々が怒るという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say the gods get angry if you kill your dog.

messages.raw_format: They say the gods get angry if you pray too much.
messages.full_text: They say the gods get angry if you pray too much.
messages.translation: 祈りすぎると神々が怒るという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say the gods get angry if you pray too much.

messages.raw_format: They say there is a powerful magic item hidden in a castle deep down!
messages.full_text: They say there is a powerful magic item hidden in a castle deep down!
messages.translation: 深い城に強力な魔法のアイテムが隠されていると言われている！
messages.dict_source: They say there is a powerful magic item hidden in a castle deep down!

messages.raw_format: Those who wield a cockatrice corpse have a rocky road ahead of them.
messages.full_text: Those who wield a cockatrice corpse have a rocky road ahead of them.
messages.translation: コカトリスの死体を扱う者は、険しい道が待ち受けている。
messages.dict_source: Those who wield a cockatrice corpse have a rocky road ahead of them.

messages.raw_format: Throwing food at a wild dog might tame him.
messages.full_text: Throwing food at a wild dog might tame him.
messages.translation: 野良犬に食べ物を投げると、懐かせることができるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Throwing food at a wild dog might tame him.

messages.raw_format: To a full belly all food is bad.
messages.full_text: To a full belly all food is bad.
messages.translation: 満腹の腹には、どんな食べ物も悪（毒）になる。
messages.dict_source: To a full belly all food is bad.

messages.raw_format: Trolls are described as rubbery:  they keep bouncing back.
messages.full_text: Trolls are described as rubbery:  they keep bouncing back.
messages.translation: トロールはゴムのような性質だと言われている。彼らは何度も立ち直って（復活して）くる。
messages.dict_source: Trolls are described as rubbery:  they keep bouncing back.

messages.raw_format: Try the fall-back end-run play against ghosts.
messages.full_text: Try the fall-back end-run play against ghosts.
messages.translation: ゴーストに対しては、後退して回り込むプレイを試せ。
messages.dict_source: Try the fall-back end-run play against ghosts.

messages.raw_format: Try using your magic marker on wet scrolls.
messages.full_text: Try using your magic marker on wet scrolls.
messages.translation: 濡れたスクロールに魔法のマーカーを使ってみろ。
messages.dict_source: Try using your magic marker on wet scrolls.

messages.raw_format: Two wrongs don't make a right, but three lefts do.
messages.full_text: Two wrongs don't make a right, but three lefts do.
messages.translation: 過ちを二度重ねても正解にはならないが、左折を三度重ねれば（右折と同じで）正解に辿り着く....こともある。
messages.dict_source: Two wrongs don't make a right, but three lefts do.

messages.raw_format: Unicorn horns can cleanse things other than yourself.
messages.full_text: Unicorn horns can cleanse things other than yourself.
messages.translation: ユニコーンの角は君自身以外のものも浄化できる。
messages.dict_source: Unicorn horns can cleanse things other than yourself.

messages.raw_format: Valkyries come from the north, and have commensurate abilities.
messages.full_text: Valkyries come from the north, and have commensurate abilities.
messages.translation: ヴァルキリーは北から現れ、それに相応しい能力を持つ。
messages.dict_source: Valkyries come from the north, and have commensurate abilities.

messages.raw_format: Vampires hate garlic.
messages.full_text: Vampires hate garlic.
messages.translation: 吸血鬼はニンニクを嫌う。

messages.raw_format: Vault guards never disturb their Lords.
messages.full_text: Vault guards never disturb their Lords.
messages.translation: 金庫の警備員は決して主君を邪魔しない。
messages.dict_source: Vault guards never disturb their Lords.

messages.raw_format: Vegetarians enjoy lichen and seaweed.
messages.full_text: Vegetarians enjoy lichen and seaweed.
messages.translation: ベジタリアンは地衣類や海藻を好む。

messages.raw_format: Visitors are requested not to apply genocide to shopkeepers.
messages.full_text: Visitors are requested not to apply genocide to shopkeepers.
messages.translation: 来客は店主に皆殺し（ジェノサイド）を適用しないよう要請されている。
messages.dict_source: Visitors are requested not to apply genocide to shopkeepers.

messages.raw_format: Want to heal faster?  Dip your potions of healing in a potion of speed!
messages.full_text: Want to heal faster?  Dip your potions of healing in a potion of speed!
messages.translation: もっと早く回復したいか? 回復の薬をスピードの薬に浸せ!
messages.dict_source: Want to heal faster?  Dip your potions of healing in a potion of speed!

messages.raw_format: Watch out, the Wizard might come back.
messages.full_text: Watch out, the Wizard might come back.
messages.translation: 気をつけろ、魔法使いが戻ってくるかもしれないぞ。
messages.dict_source: Watch out, the Wizard might come back.

messages.raw_format: Water traps have no effect on dragons.
messages.full_text: Water traps have no effect on dragons.
messages.translation: 水の罠はドラゴンには効果がない。
messages.dict_source: Water traps have no effect on dragons.

messages.raw_format: What is a cockatrice going to eat when it gets hungry?
messages.full_text: What is a cockatrice going to eat when it gets hungry?
messages.translation: コカトリスは空腹になると何を食べるのか？
messages.dict_source: What is a cockatrice going to eat when it gets hungry?

messages.raw_format: Who needs an apron if they're made of glass?
messages.full_text: Who needs an apron if they're made of glass?
messages.translation: ガラスでできているなら（何も隠せないのに）、誰がエプロンを必要とする？
messages.dict_source: Who needs an apron if they're made of glass?

messages.raw_format: Why do you suppose they call them MAGIC markers?
messages.full_text: Why do you suppose they call them MAGIC markers?
messages.translation: なぜ「魔法の」マーカーと呼ばれていると思う？
messages.dict_source: Why do you suppose they call them MAGIC markers?

messages.raw_format: Why do you think they call them mercenaries?
messages.full_text: Why do you think they call them mercenaries?
messages.translation: なぜ「傭兵（金目当ての者）」と呼ばれていると思う？
messages.dict_source: Why do you think they call them mercenaries?

messages.raw_format: Why would anybody in his sane mind engrave "Elbereth"?
messages.full_text: Why would anybody in his sane mind engrave "Elbereth"?
messages.translation: 正気な人間がなぜ「エルベレス（Elbereth）」と刻むのか？（それは生き残るためだ！）
messages.dict_source: Why would anybody in his sane mind engrave "Elbereth"?

messages.raw_format: Wishing too much may bring you too little.
messages.full_text: Wishing too much may bring you too little.
messages.translation: 欲張りすぎると何も得られない。
messages.dict_source: Wishing too much may bring you too little.

messages.raw_format: You can't bribe soldier ants.
messages.full_text: You can't bribe soldier ants.
messages.translation: ソルジャー・アントを賄賂で買収することはできない。

messages.raw_format: You can't leave a shop through the back door:  there isn't one!
messages.full_text: You can't leave a shop through the back door:  there isn't one!
messages.translation: 店の裏口から出ることはできない。そんなものは存在しないからだ！
messages.dict_source: You can't leave a shop through the back door:  there isn't one!

messages.raw_format: You can't reflect explosions.  But you might resist them.
messages.full_text: You can't reflect explosions.  But you might resist them.
messages.translation: 爆発は反射できない。だが耐えることはできるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: You can't reflect explosions.  But you might resist them.

messages.raw_format: You may discover a fine spirit inside a potion bottle.
messages.full_text: You may discover a fine spirit inside a potion bottle.
messages.translation: 薬瓶の中に、素晴らしい魂が宿っていることに気づくかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: You may discover a fine spirit inside a potion bottle.

messages.raw_format: You may want to dip into a potion of bottled blessings.
messages.full_text: You may want to dip into a potion of bottled blessings.
messages.translation: 瓶詰め祝福のポーションに浸すのも一興だ。
messages.dict_source: You may want to dip into a potion of bottled blessings.

messages.raw_format: You might be able to bribe a demon lord.
messages.full_text: You might be able to bribe a demon lord.
messages.translation: 魔王（デーモン・ロード）なら賄賂で買収できるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: You might be able to bribe a demon lord.

messages.raw_format: You might trick a shopkeeper if you're invisible.
messages.full_text: You might trick a shopkeeper if you're invisible.
messages.translation: 透明なら店主を騙せるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: You might trick a shopkeeper if you're invisible.

messages.raw_format: You should certainly learn about quantum mechanics.
messages.full_text: You should certainly learn about quantum mechanics.
messages.translation: 量子力学は必ず学ぶべきだ。
messages.dict_source: You should certainly learn about quantum mechanics.

messages.raw_format: You won't always get a second chance, even with life saving.
messages.full_text: You won't always get a second chance, even with life saving.
messages.translation: お守り（ライフ・セービング）を持っていても、常に二度目のチャンス（復活）があるとは限らない。
messages.dict_source: You won't always get a second chance, even with life saving.

messages.raw_format: You're going into the morgue at midnight???
messages.full_text: You're going into the morgue at midnight???
messages.translation: 真夜中に遺体安置所に入るの？？？
messages.dict_source: You're going into the morgue at midnight???

messages.raw_format: Your dog knows what to eat; maybe you should take lessons.
messages.full_text: Your dog knows what to eat; maybe you should take lessons.
messages.translation: 飼い犬は何を食べるべきかを知っている。君も手本にするべきかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Your dog knows what to eat; maybe you should take lessons.

messages.raw_format: Your game may go down the drain if you have extra potions or rings.
messages.full_text: Your game may go down the drain if you have extra potions or rings.
messages.translation: 余分な薬や指輪を持っていると、ゲーム展開が水の泡になるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Your game may go down the drain if you have extra potions or rings.

messages.raw_format: Zap yourself and see what happens...
messages.full_text: Zap yourself and see what happens...
messages.translation: 自分を（杖で）撃ってみろ。何が起きるか見てみるんだ....
messages.dict_source: Zap yourself and see what happens...

messages.raw_format: Zapping a wand of undead turning might bring your dog back to life.
messages.full_text: Zapping a wand of undead turning might bring your dog back to life.
messages.translation: 不死身化（アンデッド・ターニング）の杖を振るえば、飼い犬が生き返るかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Zapping a wand of undead turning might bring your dog back to life.

messages.raw_format: "So when I die, the first thing I will see in heaven is a score list?"
messages.full_text: "So when I die, the first thing I will see in heaven is a score list?"
messages.translation: 「じゃあ俺が死んだら、天国で最初に目にするのはスコアリストか？」
messages.dict_source: "So when I die, the first thing I will see in heaven is a score list?"

messages.raw_format: 1st Law of Hacking:  leaving is much more difficult than entering.
messages.full_text: 1st Law of Hacking:  leaving is much more difficult than entering.
messages.translation: ハッキングの第一法則：脱出は侵入よりも遥かに難しい。
messages.dict_source: 1st Law of Hacking:  leaving is much more difficult than entering.

messages.raw_format: 2nd Law of Hacking:  first in, first out.
messages.full_text: 2nd Law of Hacking:  first in, first out.
messages.translation: ハッキングの第二法則：先入れ先出し。
messages.dict_source: 2nd Law of Hacking:  first in, first out.

messages.raw_format: 3rd Law of Hacking:  the last blow counts most.
messages.full_text: 3rd Law of Hacking:  the last blow counts most.
messages.translation: ハッキングの第3法則：最後の一撃が最も重要だ。
messages.dict_source: 3rd Law of Hacking:  the last blow counts most.

messages.raw_format: 4th Law of Hacking:  you will find the exit at the entrance.
messages.full_text: 4th Law of Hacking:  you will find the exit at the entrance.
messages.translation: ハッキングの第4法則：入り口に出口を見つけるだろう。
messages.dict_source: 4th Law of Hacking:  you will find the exit at the entrance.

messages.raw_format: A chameleon imitating a mail daemon often delivers scrolls of fire.
messages.full_text: A chameleon imitating a mail daemon often delivers scrolls of fire.
messages.translation: メール・デーモンに化けたカメレオンは、しばしば火のスクロールを届けてくる。
messages.dict_source: A chameleon imitating a mail daemon often delivers scrolls of fire.

messages.raw_format: A cockatrice corpse is guaranteed to be untainted!
messages.full_text: A cockatrice corpse is guaranteed to be untainted!
messages.translation: コカトリスの死体が汚染されていないことは保証されている（冗談だ、触るな）！
messages.dict_source: A cockatrice corpse is guaranteed to be untainted!

messages.raw_format: A dead cockatrice is just a dead lizard.
messages.full_text: A dead cockatrice is just a dead lizard.
messages.translation: 死んだコカトリスは、ただの死んだトカゲだ（石化の危険がないわけではないが）。
messages.dict_source: A dead cockatrice is just a dead lizard.

messages.raw_format: A dragon is just a snake that ate a scroll of fire.
messages.full_text: A dragon is just a snake that ate a scroll of fire.
messages.translation: ドラゴンとは、火のスクロールを食べたただの蛇のことだ。
messages.dict_source: A dragon is just a snake that ate a scroll of fire.

messages.raw_format: A fading corridor enlightens your insight.
messages.full_text: A fading corridor enlightens your insight.
messages.translation: 薄れゆく通路があなたの洞察を照らす。
messages.dict_source: A fading corridor enlightens your insight.

messages.raw_format: A glowing potion is too hot to drink.
messages.full_text: A glowing potion is too hot to drink.
messages.translation: 光り輝くポーションは、飲むには熱すぎる。
messages.dict_source: A glowing potion is too hot to drink.

messages.raw_format: A good amulet may protect you against guards.
messages.full_text: A good amulet may protect you against guards.
messages.translation: 良い護符があれば、警備員から身を守れるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: A good amulet may protect you against guards.

messages.raw_format: A lizard corpse is a good thing to turn undead.
messages.full_text: A lizard corpse is a good thing to turn undead.
messages.translation: トカゲの死体は、不死身化（ターン・アンデッド）させるのに適している。
messages.dict_source: A lizard corpse is a good thing to turn undead.

messages.raw_format: A long worm can be defined recursively.  So how should you attack it?
messages.full_text: A long worm can be defined recursively.  So how should you attack it?
messages.translation: ロングワームは再帰的に定義できる。なら、どうやって攻撃すべきだと思う？
messages.dict_source: A long worm can be defined recursively.  So how should you attack it?

messages.raw_format: A monstrous mind is a toy forever.
messages.full_text: A monstrous mind is a toy forever.
messages.translation: 怪物の心は永遠の玩具だ。
messages.dict_source: A monstrous mind is a toy forever.

messages.raw_format: A nymph will be very pleased if you call her by her real name:  Lorelei.
messages.full_text: A nymph will be very pleased if you call her by her real name:  Lorelei.
messages.translation: ニンフを本名「ローレライ」で呼んであげると、彼女はとても喜ぶだろう（そして君は身ぐるみ剥がされるだろうが）。
messages.dict_source: A nymph will be very pleased if you call her by her real name:  Lorelei.

messages.raw_format: A ring of dungeon master control is a great find.
messages.full_text: A ring of dungeon master control is a great find.
messages.translation: ダンジョンマスター制御の指輪は素晴らしい発見だ。
messages.dict_source: A ring of dungeon master control is a great find.

messages.raw_format: A ring of extra ring finger is useless if not enchanted.
messages.full_text: A ring of extra ring finger is useless if not enchanted.
messages.translation: 「余分な薬指」の指輪は、魔法がかかっていない限り役に立たない。
messages.dict_source: A ring of extra ring finger is useless if not enchanted.

messages.raw_format: A rope may form a trail in a maze.
messages.full_text: A rope may form a trail in a maze.
messages.translation: 迷路ではロープが道筋を作るかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: A rope may form a trail in a maze.

messages.raw_format: A staff may recharge if you drop it for awhile.
messages.full_text: A staff may recharge if you drop it for awhile.
messages.translation: 杖はしばらく落とせば再充電されるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: A staff may recharge if you drop it for awhile.

messages.raw_format: A visit to the Zoo is very educational; you meet interesting animals.
messages.full_text: A visit to the Zoo is very educational; you meet interesting animals.
messages.translation: 動物園への訪問はとても教育的です。興味深い動物たちに会えます。
messages.dict_source: A visit to the Zoo is very educational; you meet interesting animals.

messages.raw_format: A wand of deaf is a more dangerous weapon than a wand of sheep.
messages.full_text: A wand of deaf is a more dangerous weapon than a wand of sheep.
messages.translation: 「失聴」の杖は、「羊」の杖よりも危険な武器だ（いずれもジョークアイテムだが）。
messages.dict_source: A wand of deaf is a more dangerous weapon than a wand of sheep.

messages.raw_format: A wand of vibration might bring the whole cave crashing about your ears.
messages.full_text: A wand of vibration might bring the whole cave crashing about your ears.
messages.translation: 振動の杖を使えば、洞窟全体が君の頭上に崩れ落ちてくるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: A wand of vibration might bring the whole cave crashing about your ears.

messages.raw_format: A winner never quits.  A quitter never wins.
messages.full_text: A winner never quits.  A quitter never wins.
messages.translation: 勝者は決して諦めず、諦める者は決して勝てない。
messages.dict_source: A winner never quits.  A quitter never wins.

messages.raw_format: [cookie] A wish?  Okay, make me a fortune cookie!
messages.full_text: [cookie] A wish?  Okay, make me a fortune cookie!

messages.raw_format: Afraid of mimics?  Try to wear a ring of true seeing.
messages.full_text: Afraid of mimics?  Try to wear a ring of true seeing.
messages.translation: ミミックが怖い？ 真実の視界（トゥルー・シーイング）の指輪をはめてみろ。
messages.dict_source: Afraid of mimics?  Try to wear a ring of true seeing.

messages.raw_format: All monsters are created evil, but some are more evil than others.
messages.full_text: All monsters are created evil, but some are more evil than others.
messages.translation: すべてのモンスターは邪悪に作られているが、中には他よりさらに邪悪なものもいる。
messages.dict_source: All monsters are created evil, but some are more evil than others.

messages.raw_format: Always attack a floating eye from behind!
messages.full_text: Always attack a floating eye from behind!
messages.translation: 浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）は常に後ろから攻撃しろ！
messages.dict_source: Always attack a floating eye from behind!

messages.raw_format: An elven cloak is always the height of fashion.
messages.full_text: An elven cloak is always the height of fashion.
messages.translation: エルフのクロークは、常に流行の最先端だ。
messages.dict_source: An elven cloak is always the height of fashion.

messages.raw_format: Any small object that is accidentally dropped will hide under a larger object.
messages.full_text: Any small object that is accidentally dropped will hide under a larger object.
messages.translation: 誤って落とした小さな物は、必ず大きな物の下に隠れてしまう。
messages.dict_source: Any small object that is accidentally dropped will hide under a larger object.

messages.raw_format: Archeologists are very squishy, often found under boulders.
messages.full_text: Archeologists are very squishy, often found under boulders.
messages.translation: 考古学者はとても潰れやすく、しばしば岩の下で見つかる。
messages.dict_source: Archeologists are very squishy, often found under boulders.

messages.raw_format: Archeologists find more bones piles.
messages.full_text: Archeologists find more bones piles.
messages.translation: 考古学者はより多くの骨の山を見つける。

messages.raw_format: Austin Powers says: My Mojo is back!  Yeah, baby!
messages.full_text: Austin Powers says: My Mojo is back!  Yeah, baby!
messages.translation: オースティン・パワーズ曰く：俺のモジョ（魔力・魅力）が戻ってきたぜ！ イェーイ、ベイビー！
messages.dict_source: Austin Powers says: My Mojo is back!  Yeah, baby!

messages.raw_format: Balrogs do not appear above level 20.
messages.full_text: Balrogs do not appear above level 20.
messages.translation: バルログはレベル20以上では出現しない。
messages.dict_source: Balrogs do not appear above level 20.

messages.raw_format: Banana peels work especially well against Keystone Kops.
messages.full_text: Banana peels work especially well against Keystone Kops.
messages.translation: バナナの皮は、キーストン・コップに対して特によく効く。
messages.dict_source: Banana peels work especially well against Keystone Kops.

messages.raw_format: Be careful when eating bananas.  Monsters might slip on the peels.
messages.full_text: Be careful when eating bananas.  Monsters might slip on the peels.
messages.translation: バナナを食べる時は気をつけて。モンスターが皮で滑るかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Be careful when eating bananas.  Monsters might slip on the peels.

messages.raw_format: Better leave the dungeon; otherwise you might get hurt badly.
messages.full_text: Better leave the dungeon; otherwise you might get hurt badly.
messages.translation: 地下牢から出た方がいい。さもないとひどい目に遭うかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Better leave the dungeon; otherwise you might get hurt badly.

messages.raw_format: Beware of the potion of nitroglycerin -- it's not for the weak of heart.
messages.full_text: Beware of the potion of nitroglycerin -- it's not for the weak of heart.
messages.translation: ニトログリセリンの薬液に気をつけろー心臓の弱い者には向かない。
messages.dict_source: Beware of the potion of nitroglycerin -- it's not for the weak of heart.

messages.raw_format: Beware:  there's always a chance that your wand explodes as you try to zap it!
messages.full_text: Beware:  there's always a chance that your wand explodes as you try to zap it!
messages.translation: 用心しろ：杖を振るおうとした拍子に爆発する可能性は常にある！
messages.dict_source: Beware:  there's always a chance that your wand explodes as you try to zap it!

messages.raw_format: Beyond the 23rd level lies a happy retirement in a room of your own.
messages.full_text: Beyond the 23rd level lies a happy retirement in a room of your own.
messages.translation: 23階の先には、君専用の部屋での幸せな隠居生活が待っている（かもしれない）。
messages.dict_source: Beyond the 23rd level lies a happy retirement in a room of your own.

messages.raw_format: Changing your suit without dropping your sword?  You must be kidding!
messages.full_text: Changing your suit without dropping your sword?  You must be kidding!
messages.translation: 剣を置かずに鎧を着替えるだって？ 冗談だろう！
messages.dict_source: Changing your suit without dropping your sword?  You must be kidding!

messages.raw_format: Close the door!  You're letting the heat out!
messages.full_text: Close the door!  You're letting the heat out!
messages.translation: 扉を閉めろ！熱が逃げるぞ！
messages.dict_source: Close the door!  You're letting the heat out!

messages.raw_format: Cockatrices might turn themselves to stone faced with a mirror.
messages.full_text: Cockatrices might turn themselves to stone faced with a mirror.
messages.translation: コカトリスは鏡を向けられると、自分自身を石にしてしまうかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: Cockatrices might turn themselves to stone faced with a mirror.

messages.raw_format: Consumption of home-made food is strictly forbidden in this dungeon.
messages.full_text: Consumption of home-made food is strictly forbidden in this dungeon.
messages.translation: このダンジョン内では、自家製の食べ物の摂取は厳禁だ。
messages.dict_source: Consumption of home-made food is strictly forbidden in this dungeon.

messages.raw_format: Dark room?  Your chance to develop your photographs!
messages.full_text: Dark room?  Your chance to develop your photographs!
messages.translation: 暗い部屋だって？ 写真を現像するチャンスだな！
messages.dict_source: Dark room?  Your chance to develop your photographs!

messages.raw_format: Dark rooms are not *completely* dark:  just wait and let your eyes adjust...
messages.full_text: Dark rooms are not *completely* dark:  just wait and let your eyes adjust...
messages.translation: 暗い部屋は「完全に」暗いわけではない。大人しく目の慣れるのを待て....
messages.dict_source: Dark rooms are not *completely* dark:  just wait and let your eyes adjust...

messages.raw_format: David London sez, "Hey guys, *WIELD* a lizard corpse against a cockatrice!"
messages.full_text: David London sez, "Hey guys, *WIELD* a lizard corpse against a cockatrice!"
messages.translation: デビッド・ロンドン曰く「おい、コカトリス相手にはトカゲの死体を『振るえ』！」
messages.dict_source: David London sez, "Hey guys, *WIELD* a lizard corpse against a cockatrice!"

messages.raw_format: Death is just life's way of telling you you've been fired.
messages.full_text: Death is just life's way of telling you you've been fired.
messages.translation: 死とは、君がクビになったと人生が告げる単なる方法だ。
messages.dict_source: Death is just life's way of telling you you've been fired.

messages.raw_format: Demi-gods don't need any help from the gods.
messages.full_text: Demi-gods don't need any help from the gods.
messages.translation: 半神（デミ・ゴッド）は神々の助けなど必要としない。
messages.dict_source: Demi-gods don't need any help from the gods.

messages.raw_format: Demons *HATE* Priests and Priestesses.
messages.full_text: Demons *HATE* Priests and Priestesses.
messages.translation: 悪魔は僧侶（Priests/Priestesses）を「大嫌い」だ。

messages.raw_format: Didn't you forget to pay?
messages.full_text: Didn't you forget to pay?
messages.translation: 支払いを忘れていないか？

messages.raw_format: Didn't your mother tell you not to eat food off the floor?
messages.full_text: Didn't your mother tell you not to eat food off the floor?
messages.translation: 床に落ちているものを食べてはいけないと、お母さんに教わらなかったか？
messages.dict_source: Didn't your mother tell you not to eat food off the floor?

messages.raw_format: Direct a direct hit on your direct opponent, directing in the right direction.
messages.full_text: Direct a direct hit on your direct opponent, directing in the right direction.
messages.translation: 直接的な相手に直接的な打撃を叩き込め。正しい方向を見定めてな。
messages.dict_source: Direct a direct hit on your direct opponent, directing in the right direction.

messages.raw_format: Do you want to make more money?  Sure, we all do!  Join the Fort Ludios guard!
messages.full_text: Do you want to make more money?  Sure, we all do!  Join the Fort Ludios guard!
messages.translation: もっと稼ぎたいか？ もちろん、皆そうだろう！ ルディオス要塞警備隊へ加入せよ！
messages.dict_source: Do you want to make more money?  Sure, we all do!  Join the Fort Ludios guard!

messages.raw_format: Does your boss know what you're doing right now?
messages.full_text: Does your boss know what you're doing right now?
messages.translation: 君の上司は、君が今何をしているか知っているかな？
messages.dict_source: Does your boss know what you're doing right now?

messages.raw_format: Don't bother wishing for things.  You'll probably find one on the next level.
messages.full_text: Don't bother wishing for things.  You'll probably find one on the next level.
messages.translation: 願い事をしても無駄だ。次の階層できっと見つかる。
messages.dict_source: Don't bother wishing for things.  You'll probably find one on the next level.

messages.raw_format: Don't eat too much:  you might start hiccoughing!
messages.full_text: Don't eat too much:  you might start hiccoughing!
messages.translation: 食べすぎるな。しゃっくりが出始めるぞ！
messages.dict_source: Don't eat too much:  you might start hiccoughing!

messages.raw_format: Don't play NetHack at your work; your boss might hit you!
messages.full_text: Don't play NetHack at your work; your boss might hit you!
messages.translation: 仕事中にNetHackをするな。上司にぶん殴られるぞ！
messages.dict_source: Don't play NetHack at your work; your boss might hit you!

messages.raw_format: Don't tell a soul you found a secret door, otherwise it isn't a secret anymore.
messages.full_text: Don't tell a soul you found a secret door, otherwise it isn't a secret anymore.
messages.translation: 隠し扉を見つけたことは誰にも言うな。さもないと、それはもう「隠し」ではなくなってしまう。
messages.dict_source: Don't tell a soul you found a secret door, otherwise it isn't a secret anymore.

messages.raw_format: Drinking potions of booze may land you in jail if you are under 21.
messages.full_text: Drinking potions of booze may land you in jail if you are under 21.
messages.translation: 酒のポーションを飲むと、21歳未満なら牢屋行きだ。
messages.dict_source: Drinking potions of booze may land you in jail if you are under 21.

messages.raw_format: Drop your vanity and get rid of your jewels!  Pickpockets about!
messages.full_text: Drop your vanity and get rid of your jewels!  Pickpockets about!
messages.translation: 虚栄心を捨て、宝石を手放せ！ スリがそこら中にいるぞ！
messages.dict_source: Drop your vanity and get rid of your jewels!  Pickpockets about!

messages.raw_format: Eat 10 cloves of garlic and keep all humans at a two-square distance.
messages.full_text: Eat 10 cloves of garlic and keep all humans at a two-square distance.
messages.translation: ニンニクを10片食べろ。そうすれば人間を皆2マスの距離に遠ざけておける。
messages.dict_source: Eat 10 cloves of garlic and keep all humans at a two-square distance.

messages.raw_format: Eels hide under mud.  Use a unicorn to clear the water and make them visible.
messages.full_text: Eels hide under mud.  Use a unicorn to clear the water and make them visible.
messages.translation: ウナギ（イール）は泥の下に隠れている。ユニコーンを使って水を浄化し、姿を暴き出せ。
messages.dict_source: Eels hide under mud.  Use a unicorn to clear the water and make them visible.

messages.raw_format: Eels will help you tie your shoes.
messages.full_text: Eels will help you tie your shoes.
messages.translation: ウナギは靴ひもを結ぶのを手伝ってくれる。
messages.dict_source: Eels will help you tie your shoes.

messages.raw_format: Elf has extra speed.
messages.full_text: Elf has extra speed.
messages.translation: エルフは追加の移動速度を持つ。

messages.raw_format: Engrave your wishes with a wand of wishing.
messages.full_text: Engrave your wishes with a wand of wishing.
messages.translation: 願いの杖を使って、自分の願いを地面に刻め（それはできないがね）。
messages.dict_source: Engrave your wishes with a wand of wishing.

messages.raw_format: Eventually you will come to admire the swift elegance of a retreating nymph.
messages.full_text: Eventually you will come to admire the swift elegance of a retreating nymph.
messages.translation: いずれ君も、立ち去っていくニンフの素早く優雅な後ろ姿を賞賛するようになるだろう。
messages.dict_source: Eventually you will come to admire the swift elegance of a retreating nymph.

messages.raw_format: Ever heard hissing outside?  I *knew* you hadn't!
messages.full_text: Ever heard hissing outside?  I *knew* you hadn't!
messages.translation: 外でシューッって音聞いたことある？　きっとないだろ！
messages.dict_source: Ever heard hissing outside?  I *knew* you hadn't!

messages.raw_format: Ever lifted a dragon corpse?
messages.full_text: Ever lifted a dragon corpse?
messages.translation: 竜の死骸を運んだことあるか？

messages.raw_format: Ever seen a leocrotta dancing the tengu?
messages.full_text: Ever seen a leocrotta dancing the tengu?
messages.translation: レオクロッタが天狗踊りを踊るのを見たことあるか？
messages.dict_source: Ever seen a leocrotta dancing the tengu?

messages.raw_format: Ever seen your weapon glow plaid?
messages.full_text: Ever seen your weapon glow plaid?
messages.translation: 武器が格子模様（plaid）に輝くのを見たことがあるか？
messages.dict_source: Ever seen your weapon glow plaid?

messages.raw_format: Ever tamed a shopkeeper?
messages.full_text: Ever tamed a shopkeeper?
messages.translation: 店主を飼いならしたことはあるか？

messages.raw_format: Ever tried digging through a Vault Guard?
messages.full_text: Ever tried digging through a Vault Guard?
messages.translation: 金庫室（Vault）の守衛を掘り通そうとしたことはあるか？
messages.dict_source: Ever tried digging through a Vault Guard?

messages.raw_format: Ever tried enchanting a rope?
messages.full_text: Ever tried enchanting a rope?
messages.translation: 紐（rope）を強化しようとしたことはあるか？

messages.raw_format: Floating eyes can't stand Hawaiian shirts.
messages.full_text: Floating eyes can't stand Hawaiian shirts.
messages.translation: 浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）はアロハシャツには耐えられない。
messages.dict_source: Floating eyes can't stand Hawaiian shirts.

messages.raw_format: For any remedy there is a misery.
messages.full_text: For any remedy there is a misery.
messages.translation: どんな治療法（remedy）にも、それに伴う苦しみ（misery）がある。
messages.dict_source: For any remedy there is a misery.

messages.raw_format: Giant bats turn into giant vampires.
messages.full_text: Giant bats turn into giant vampires.
messages.translation: 巨大コウモリは巨大吸血鬼に変身する。
messages.dict_source: Giant bats turn into giant vampires.

messages.raw_format: Good day for overcoming obstacles.  Try a steeplechase.
messages.full_text: Good day for overcoming obstacles.  Try a steeplechase.
messages.translation: 障害を乗り越えるには良い日だ。障害物競走（ステープルチェイス）でも試してみろ。
messages.dict_source: Good day for overcoming obstacles.  Try a steeplechase.

messages.raw_format: Half Moon tonight.  (At least it's better than no Moon at all.)
messages.full_text: Half Moon tonight.  (At least it's better than no Moon at all.)
messages.translation: 今夜は半月だ。（少なくとも全く月がないよりはマシだ。）
messages.dict_source: Half Moon tonight.  (At least it's better than no Moon at all.)

messages.raw_format: [cookie] Help!  I'm being held prisoner in a fortune cookie factory!
messages.full_text: [cookie] Help!  I'm being held prisoner in a fortune cookie factory!

messages.raw_format: Housecats have nine lives, kittens only one.
messages.full_text: Housecats have nine lives, kittens only one.
messages.translation: 飼い猫（Housecat）には九つの命があるが、子猫（kitten）には一つしかない。
messages.dict_source: Housecats have nine lives, kittens only one.

messages.raw_format: How long can you tread water?
messages.full_text: How long can you tread water?
messages.translation: どれくらいの時間、立ち泳ぎ（tread water）をしていられるかな？
messages.dict_source: How long can you tread water?

messages.raw_format: Hungry?  There is an abundance of food on the next level.
messages.full_text: Hungry?  There is an abundance of food on the next level.
messages.translation: お腹が空いた？ 次の階には食べ物が溢れているぞ。
messages.dict_source: Hungry?  There is an abundance of food on the next level.

messages.raw_format: I guess you've never hit a mail daemon with the Amulet of Yendor...
messages.full_text: I guess you've never hit a mail daemon with the Amulet of Yendor...
messages.translation: 君はまだメル友（mail daemon）をイェンドールの魔除けで殴ったことはないようだな....
messages.dict_source: I guess you've never hit a mail daemon with the Amulet of Yendor...

messages.raw_format: If there's a spot of blood on your hands, why not wash them?
messages.full_text: If there's a spot of blood on your hands, why not wash them?
messages.translation: 手に血のしみがあるなら、洗えばいいじゃないか?
messages.dict_source: If there's a spot of blood on your hands, why not wash them?

messages.raw_format: If you are the shopkeeper, you can take things for free.
messages.full_text: If you are the shopkeeper, you can take things for free.
messages.translation: もし君が店主なら、品物をタダで持っていけるだろう。
messages.dict_source: If you are the shopkeeper, you can take things for free.

messages.raw_format: If you ask really nicely, the Wizard will give you the Amulet.
messages.full_text: If you ask really nicely, the Wizard will give you the Amulet.
messages.translation: 丁寧にお願いすれば、魔法使いは魔除けを譲ってくれるかもしれない。
messages.dict_source: If you ask really nicely, the Wizard will give you the Amulet.

messages.raw_format: If you can't learn to do it well, learn to enjoy doing it badly.
messages.full_text: If you can't learn to do it well, learn to enjoy doing it badly.
messages.translation: 上手くやる方法を学べないなら、下手にやることを楽しむ方法を学べ。
messages.dict_source: If you can't learn to do it well, learn to enjoy doing it badly.

messages.raw_format: If you thought the Wizard was bad, just wait till you meet the Warlord!
messages.full_text: If you thought the Wizard was bad, just wait till you meet the Warlord!
messages.translation: 魔法使いが最悪だと思った？  warlord（軍閥、または強力な敵）に出会うまで待ってみるんだな！
messages.dict_source: If you thought the Wizard was bad, just wait till you meet the Warlord!

messages.raw_format: If you turn blind, don't expect your dog to be turned into a seeing-eye dog.
messages.full_text: If you turn blind, don't expect your dog to be turned into a seeing-eye dog.
messages.translation: 君が盲目になったからといって、飼い犬が盲導犬に変わるなんて期待するな。
messages.dict_source: If you turn blind, don't expect your dog to be turned into a seeing-eye dog.

messages.raw_format: If you want to feel great, you must eat something real big.
messages.full_text: If you want to feel great, you must eat something real big.
messages.translation: 最高の気分になりたいなら、本当に大きなものを食べるんだ。
messages.dict_source: If you want to feel great, you must eat something real big.

messages.raw_format: If you want to float, you'd better eat a floating eye.
messages.full_text: If you want to float, you'd better eat a floating eye.
messages.translation: 浮かびたい（float）なら、浮遊する眼（floating eye）を食べるのが一番だ。
messages.dict_source: If you want to float, you'd better eat a floating eye.

messages.raw_format: If your ghost kills a player, it increases your score.
messages.full_text: If your ghost kills a player, it increases your score.
messages.translation: 君の幽霊が（別の）プレイヤーを殺せば、君のスコアが加算される。
messages.dict_source: If your ghost kills a player, it increases your score.

messages.raw_format: Increase mindpower:  Tame your own ghost!
messages.full_text: Increase mindpower:  Tame your own ghost!
messages.translation: 精神力を高めろ：自分自身の幽霊を飼い慣らすんだ！
messages.dict_source: Increase mindpower:  Tame your own ghost!

messages.raw_format: It furthers one to see the great man.
messages.full_text: It furthers one to see the great man.
messages.translation: 偉大な人物（神など）にまみえることは、一助となる。
messages.dict_source: It furthers one to see the great man.

messages.raw_format: It's easy to overlook a monster in a wood.
messages.full_text: It's easy to overlook a monster in a wood.
messages.translation: 森の中でモンスターを見落とすのは簡単だ。
messages.dict_source: It's easy to overlook a monster in a wood.

messages.raw_format: Just below any trap door there may be another one.  Just keep falling!
messages.full_text: Just below any trap door there may be another one.  Just keep falling!
messages.translation: 落とし穴のすぐ下には別の落とし穴があるかもしれない。落ち続けろ！
messages.dict_source: Just below any trap door there may be another one.  Just keep falling!

messages.raw_format: Katanas are very sharp; watch you don't cut yourself.
messages.full_text: Katanas are very sharp; watch you don't cut yourself.
messages.translation: 刀（Katana）は非常に鋭い。自分を斬らないように気をつけろ。
messages.dict_source: Katanas are very sharp; watch you don't cut yourself.

messages.raw_format: Keep a clear mind:  quaff clear potions.
messages.full_text: Keep a clear mind:  quaff clear potions.
messages.translation: 心を澄ませよ：澄んだ薬を飲み干せ。
messages.dict_source: Keep a clear mind:  quaff clear potions.

messages.raw_format: Kicking the terminal doesn't hurt the monsters.
messages.full_text: Kicking the terminal doesn't hurt the monsters.
messages.translation: 端末（キーボード等）を蹴ってもモンスターにダメージは与えられない。
messages.dict_source: Kicking the terminal doesn't hurt the monsters.

messages.raw_format: Killer bees keep appearing till you kill their queen.
messages.full_text: Killer bees keep appearing till you kill their queen.
messages.translation: 女王蜂を殺さない限り、殺人蜂は現れ続けます。
messages.dict_source: Killer bees keep appearing till you kill their queen.

messages.raw_format: Killer bunnies can be tamed with carrots only.
messages.full_text: Killer bunnies can be tamed with carrots only.
messages.translation: 殺人ウサギ（Killer bunny）は人参でしか手なずけられない。
messages.dict_source: Killer bunnies can be tamed with carrots only.

messages.raw_format: Latest news?  Put `rec.games.roguelike.nethack' in your .newsrc!
messages.full_text: Latest news?  Put `rec.games.roguelike.nethack' in your .newsrc!
messages.translation: 最新ニュースだって？ `rec.games.roguelike.nethack` を .newsrc に登録しろ！

messages.raw_format: Learn how to spell.  Play NetHack!
messages.full_text: Learn how to spell.  Play NetHack!
messages.translation: 呪文（綴り）の書き方を学べ。NetHackをプレイするんだ！
messages.dict_source: Learn how to spell.  Play NetHack!

messages.raw_format: Leprechauns hide their gold in a secret room.
messages.full_text: Leprechauns hide their gold in a secret room.
messages.translation: レプラコーンは黄金を秘密の部屋に隠す。
messages.dict_source: Leprechauns hide their gold in a secret room.

messages.raw_format: Let your fingers do the walking on the yulkjhnb keys.
messages.full_text: Let your fingers do the walking on the yulkjhnb keys.
messages.translation: 指でyulkjhnbキーを歩き回らせろ。
messages.dict_source: Let your fingers do the walking on the yulkjhnb keys.

messages.raw_format: Let's face it:  this time you're not going to win.
messages.full_text: Let's face it:  this time you're not going to win.
messages.translation: 現実を見ろ。今回君は勝てそうにない。
messages.dict_source: Let's face it:  this time you're not going to win.

messages.raw_format: Let's have a party, drink a lot of booze.
messages.full_text: Let's have a party, drink a lot of booze.
messages.translation: パーティーを開いて、酒をたっぷり飲もう。
messages.dict_source: Let's have a party, drink a lot of booze.

messages.raw_format: Liquor sellers do not drink; they hate to see you twice.
messages.full_text: Liquor sellers do not drink; they hate to see you twice.
messages.translation: 酒売りは酒を飲まない。彼らは君を二度見る（二日酔いで再来店される）のを嫌うからだ。
messages.dict_source: Liquor sellers do not drink; they hate to see you twice.

messages.raw_format: Lunar eclipse tonight.  May as well quit now!
messages.full_text: Lunar eclipse tonight.  May as well quit now!
messages.translation: 今夜は月食だ。今すぐ（ゲームを）やめたほうがいいかもしれない！
messages.dict_source: Lunar eclipse tonight.  May as well quit now!

messages.raw_format: Meeting your own ghost decreases your luck considerably!
messages.full_text: Meeting your own ghost decreases your luck considerably!
messages.translation: 自分自身の幽霊に会うと、運が著しく低下する！
messages.dict_source: Meeting your own ghost decreases your luck considerably!

messages.raw_format: Money to invest?  Take it to the local branch of the Magic Memory Vault!
messages.full_text: Money to invest?  Take it to the local branch of the Magic Memory Vault!
messages.translation: 投資資金がある？ 地元の「マジック・メモリー・ボールト」支店へ持って行け！
messages.dict_source: Money to invest?  Take it to the local branch of the Magic Memory Vault!

messages.raw_format: Monsters come from nowhere to hit you everywhere.
messages.full_text: Monsters come from nowhere to hit you everywhere.
messages.translation: モンスターはどこからともなく現れ、君のあらゆる場所を攻撃してくる。
messages.dict_source: Monsters come from nowhere to hit you everywhere.

messages.raw_format: Monsters sleep because you are boring, not because they ever get tired.
messages.full_text: Monsters sleep because you are boring, not because they ever get tired.
messages.translation: モンスターが眠るのは君が退屈だからであって、彼らが疲れるからではない。
messages.dict_source: Monsters sleep because you are boring, not because they ever get tired.

messages.raw_format: Most monsters prefer minced meat.  That's why they are hitting you!
messages.full_text: Most monsters prefer minced meat.  That's why they are hitting you!
messages.translation: ほとんどのモンスターは挽肉を好む。だから彼らは君を（挽肉にしようと）叩いているんだ！
messages.dict_source: Most monsters prefer minced meat.  That's why they are hitting you!

messages.raw_format: Most of the bugs in NetHack are on the floor.
messages.full_text: Most of the bugs in NetHack are on the floor.
messages.translation: NetHackのバグの多くは、床の上（虫系モンスター）にいる。
messages.dict_source: Most of the bugs in NetHack are on the floor.

messages.raw_format: Much ado Nothing Happens.
messages.full_text: Much ado Nothing Happens.
messages.translation: 「何も起きない」ことへの、あからさまな大騒ぎ。

messages.raw_format: Multi-player NetHack is a myth.
messages.full_text: Multi-player NetHack is a myth.
messages.translation: マルチプレイヤーNetHackなんてものは神話（迷信）だ。

messages.raw_format: NetHack is addictive.  Too late, you're already hooked.
messages.full_text: NetHack is addictive.  Too late, you're already hooked.
messages.translation: NetHackには中毒性がある。もう遅い、君はすでに虜になっている。
messages.dict_source: NetHack is addictive.  Too late, you're already hooked.

messages.raw_format: Never ask a shopkeeper for a price list.
messages.full_text: Never ask a shopkeeper for a price list.
messages.translation: 店主に価格表を求めてはいけない。
messages.dict_source: Never ask a shopkeeper for a price list.

messages.raw_format: Never burn a tree, unless you like getting whacked with a +5 shovel.
messages.full_text: Never burn a tree, unless you like getting whacked with a +5 shovel.
messages.translation: 木を燃やすな。+5のシャベルで叩き伏せられるのが趣味でない限りはな。
messages.dict_source: Never burn a tree, unless you like getting whacked with a +5 shovel.

messages.raw_format: Never eat with glowing hands!
messages.full_text: Never eat with glowing hands!
messages.translation: 手が光っている間（魔法の影響下など）は、決して食事をするな！

messages.raw_format: Never mind the monsters hitting you:  they just replace the charwomen.
messages.full_text: Never mind the monsters hitting you:  they just replace the charwomen.
messages.translation: モンスターが君を叩くのを気にするな。彼らはただ掃除婦の代わりをしている（君を「片付けて」いる）だけだ。
messages.dict_source: Never mind the monsters hitting you:  they just replace the charwomen.

messages.raw_format: Never play leapfrog with a unicorn.
messages.full_text: Never play leapfrog with a unicorn.
messages.translation: ユニコーンと飛び石遊びをしてはいけない。
messages.dict_source: Never play leapfrog with a unicorn.

messages.raw_format: Never step on a cursed engraving.
messages.full_text: Never step on a cursed engraving.
messages.translation: 呪われた刻銘の上を決して踏むな。
messages.dict_source: Never step on a cursed engraving.

messages.raw_format: Never swim with a camera:  there's nothing to take pictures of.
messages.full_text: Never swim with a camera:  there's nothing to take pictures of.
messages.translation: カメラを持って泳いではいけない。水中には撮るべきものなど何もない。
messages.dict_source: Never swim with a camera:  there's nothing to take pictures of.

messages.raw_format: Never teach your pet rust monster to fetch.
messages.full_text: Never teach your pet rust monster to fetch.
messages.translation: 錆びたモンスターに物を持ってこいとは決して教えるな。
messages.dict_source: Never teach your pet rust monster to fetch.

messages.raw_format: Never trust a random generator in magic fields.
messages.full_text: Never trust a random generator in magic fields.
messages.translation: 魔法の力が働く場所では、乱数発生器を信用してはいけない。
messages.dict_source: Never trust a random generator in magic fields.

messages.raw_format: Never use a wand of death.
messages.full_text: Never use a wand of death.
messages.translation: 死の杖は決して使うな。
messages.dict_source: Never use a wand of death.

messages.raw_format: No level contains two shops.  The maze is no level.  So...
messages.full_text: No level contains two shops.  The maze is no level.  So...
messages.translation: どの階層も二つの店を持つことはない。迷宮（The Maze）は「階層」ではない。つまり....
messages.dict_source: No level contains two shops.  The maze is no level.  So...

messages.raw_format: [cookie] No part of this fortune may be reproduced, stored in a retrieval system, ...
messages.full_text: [cookie] No part of this fortune may be reproduced, stored in a retrieval system, ...

messages.raw_format: Not all rumors are as misleading as this one.
messages.full_text: Not all rumors are as misleading as this one.
messages.translation: すべての噂がこの噂のように紛らわしいわけではない。
messages.dict_source: Not all rumors are as misleading as this one.

messages.raw_format: Nymphs and nurses like beautiful rings.
messages.full_text: Nymphs and nurses like beautiful rings.
messages.translation: ニンフも看護師も美しい指輪を好む。
messages.dict_source: Nymphs and nurses like beautiful rings.

messages.raw_format: Nymphs are blondes.  Are you a gentleman?
messages.full_text: Nymphs are blondes.  Are you a gentleman?
messages.translation: ニンフは金髪だ。君は紳士か？
messages.dict_source: Nymphs are blondes.  Are you a gentleman?

messages.raw_format: Offering a unicorn a worthless piece of glass might prove to be fatal!
messages.full_text: Offering a unicorn a worthless piece of glass might prove to be fatal!
messages.translation: ユニコーンに価値のないガラス片を捧げるのは、致命的な間違いになるかもしれない！
messages.dict_source: Offering a unicorn a worthless piece of glass might prove to be fatal!

messages.raw_format: Old hackers never die:  young ones do.
messages.full_text: Old hackers never die:  young ones do.
messages.translation: 老いたハッカーは死なない：若きハッカーは死ぬ。
messages.dict_source: Old hackers never die:  young ones do.

messages.raw_format: One has to leave shops before closing time.
messages.full_text: One has to leave shops before closing time.
messages.translation: 閉店時間前には店を出なければならない。
messages.dict_source: One has to leave shops before closing time.

messages.raw_format: One homunculus a day keeps the doctor away.
messages.full_text: One homunculus a day keeps the doctor away.
messages.translation: 一日一匹のホムンクルスは医者を遠ざける（健康に良い....わけがないが）。
messages.dict_source: One homunculus a day keeps the doctor away.

messages.raw_format: One level further down somebody is getting killed, right now.
messages.full_text: One level further down somebody is getting killed, right now.
messages.translation: さらに一段階下では、今まさに誰かが殺されている。
messages.dict_source: One level further down somebody is getting killed, right now.

messages.raw_format: Only a wizard can use a magic whistle.
messages.full_text: Only a wizard can use a magic whistle.
messages.translation: 魔法の笛を使いこなせるのは、魔法使い（Wizard）だけだ。
messages.dict_source: Only a wizard can use a magic whistle.

messages.raw_format: Only adventurers of evil alignment think of killing their dog.
messages.full_text: Only adventurers of evil alignment think of killing their dog.
messages.translation: 邪悪な性質の冒険者だけが、飼い犬を殺そうと考える。
messages.dict_source: Only adventurers of evil alignment think of killing their dog.

messages.raw_format: Only chaotic evils kill sleeping monsters.
messages.full_text: Only chaotic evils kill sleeping monsters.
messages.translation: 眠っているモンスターを殺すのは、混沌にして悪（カオティック・イービル）の者だけだ。
messages.dict_source: Only chaotic evils kill sleeping monsters.

messages.raw_format: Only real trappers escape traps.
messages.full_text: Only real trappers escape traps.
messages.translation: 罠から逃れられるのは、本物の罠師（トラッパー）だけだ。

messages.raw_format: Only real wizards can write scrolls.
messages.full_text: Only real wizards can write scrolls.
messages.translation: 真の魔法使いだけが巻物を書ける。
messages.dict_source: Only real wizards can write scrolls.

messages.raw_format: Operation OVERKILL has started now.
messages.full_text: Operation OVERKILL has started now.
messages.translation: オーバーキル作戦、始動。

messages.raw_format: Ouch.  I hate when that happens.
messages.full_text: Ouch.  I hate when that happens.
messages.translation: 痛っ。こういうのは本当に勘弁してほしい。
messages.dict_source: Ouch.  I hate when that happens.

messages.raw_format: PLEASE ignore previous rumor.
messages.full_text: PLEASE ignore previous rumor.
messages.translation: お願いだ、さっきの噂は忘れてくれ。

messages.raw_format: Polymorph into an ettin; meet your opponents face to face to face.
messages.full_text: Polymorph into an ettin; meet your opponents face to face to face.
messages.translation: エティンに変身せよ。敵と真正面から向き合え。
messages.dict_source: Polymorph into an ettin; meet your opponents face to face to face.

messages.raw_format: Praying will frighten demons.
messages.full_text: Praying will frighten demons.
messages.translation: 祈りは悪魔を恐怖させる。

messages.raw_format: Row (3x) that boat gently down the stream, Charon (4x), death is but a dream.
messages.full_text: Row (3x) that boat gently down the stream, Charon (4x), death is but a dream.
messages.translation: 小舟（三度）そっと川を下れ　カロン（四度）よ　死など夢の如し
messages.dict_source: Row (3x) that boat gently down the stream, Charon (4x), death is but a dream.

messages.raw_format: Running is good for your legs.
messages.full_text: Running is good for your legs.
messages.translation: 走ることは脚（または逃げ足）に良い。
messages.dict_source: Running is good for your legs.

messages.raw_format: Screw up your courage!  You've screwed up everything else.
messages.full_text: Screw up your courage!  You've screwed up everything else.
messages.translation: 勇気を奮い立たせろ（Screw up your courage）！ 他のすべてはもう台無し（screwed up）にしたんだから。
messages.dict_source: Screw up your courage!  You've screwed up everything else.

messages.raw_format: Seepage?  Leaky pipes?  Rising damp?  Summon the plumber!
messages.full_text: Seepage?  Leaky pipes?  Rising damp?  Summon the plumber!
messages.translation: 浸水？ 配管漏れ？ 湿気の上昇？ 配管工（Plumber）を呼べ！
messages.dict_source: Seepage?  Leaky pipes?  Rising damp?  Summon the plumber!

messages.raw_format: Segmentation fault (core dumped).
messages.full_text: Segmentation fault (core dumped).
messages.translation: セグメンテーション違反 (コアダンプしました)。

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers are insured by Croesus himself!
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers are insured by Croesus himself!
messages.translation: 店主はクロイソス自らの保険に入っている！
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers are insured by Croesus himself!

messages.raw_format: Shopkeepers sometimes die from old age.
messages.full_text: Shopkeepers sometimes die from old age.
messages.translation: 店主だって時には寿命（老衰）で死ぬこともある。
messages.dict_source: Shopkeepers sometimes die from old age.

messages.raw_format: Some mazes (especially small ones) have no solutions, says man 6 maze.
messages.full_text: Some mazes (especially small ones) have no solutions, says man 6 maze.
messages.translation: ある種の迷路（特に小さなもの）には解法が存在しないこともある、とマニュアルの6章には書いてある。
messages.dict_source: Some mazes (especially small ones) have no solutions, says man 6 maze.

messages.raw_format: Some questions the Sphynx asks just *don't* have any answers.
messages.full_text: Some questions the Sphynx asks just *don't* have any answers.
messages.translation: スフィンクスが出す問いの中には、最初から答えが存在しないものもある。
messages.dict_source: Some questions the Sphynx asks just *don't* have any answers.

messages.raw_format: Sometimes "mu" is the answer.
messages.full_text: Sometimes "mu" is the answer.
messages.translation: 時には「無（mu）」が答えになることもある。

messages.raw_format: [cookie] Sorry, no fortune this time.  Better luck next cookie!
messages.full_text: [cookie] Sorry, no fortune this time.  Better luck next cookie!

messages.raw_format: Spare your scrolls of make-edible until it's really necessary!
messages.full_text: Spare your scrolls of make-edible until it's really necessary!
messages.translation: 「可食化」のスクロールは、本当に必要になるまで温存しておけ！
messages.dict_source: Spare your scrolls of make-edible until it's really necessary!

messages.raw_format: Sticks and stones may break your bones but manes will never hurt you.
messages.full_text: Sticks and stones may break your bones but manes will never hurt you.
messages.translation: 棒や石は骨を折るかもしれないが、たてがみは決して傷つけない。
messages.dict_source: Sticks and stones may break your bones but manes will never hurt you.

messages.raw_format: Stormbringer doesn't steal souls.  People steal souls.
messages.full_text: Stormbringer doesn't steal souls.  People steal souls.
messages.translation: ストームブリンガーが魂を盗むのではない。（それを使う）人間が魂を盗むのだ。
messages.dict_source: Stormbringer doesn't steal souls.  People steal souls.

messages.raw_format: Suddenly, the dungeon will collapse...
messages.full_text: Suddenly, the dungeon will collapse...
messages.translation: 突然、ダンジョンが崩落する....（かもしれない）。

messages.raw_format: Taming a mail daemon may cause a system security violation.
messages.full_text: Taming a mail daemon may cause a system security violation.
messages.translation: メール・デーモンを飼いならすと、システムセキュリティ違反を引き起こす可能性がある。
messages.dict_source: Taming a mail daemon may cause a system security violation.

messages.raw_format: The crowd was so tough, the Stooges won't play the Dungeon anymore, nyuk nyuk.
messages.full_text: The crowd was so tough, the Stooges won't play the Dungeon anymore, nyuk nyuk.
messages.translation: 客層が酷すぎて、三ばか大将（The Stooges）はもうダンジョンでは公演しないそうだ。にゅくにゅく。
messages.dict_source: The crowd was so tough, the Stooges won't play the Dungeon anymore, nyuk nyuk.

messages.raw_format: The leprechauns hide their treasure in a small hidden room.
messages.full_text: The leprechauns hide their treasure in a small hidden room.
messages.translation: レプラコーンは宝物を小さな隠し部屋に隠している。
messages.dict_source: The leprechauns hide their treasure in a small hidden room.

messages.raw_format: The longer the wand the better.
messages.full_text: The longer the wand the better.
messages.translation: 杖（Wand）は長ければ長いほど良い。
messages.dict_source: The longer the wand the better.

messages.raw_format: The magic word is "XYZZY".
messages.full_text: The magic word is "XYZZY".
messages.translation: 魔法の言葉は「XYZZY」だ。

messages.raw_format: The meek shall inherit your bones files.
messages.full_text: The meek shall inherit your bones files.
messages.translation: 柔和な者は汝の骨ファイルを継ぐであろう。
messages.dict_source: The meek shall inherit your bones files.

messages.raw_format: The mines are dark and deep, and I have levels to go before I sleep.
messages.full_text: The mines are dark and deep, and I have levels to go before I sleep.
messages.translation: 鉱山は暗く深い。そして私は眠りにつく前に、まだ進まねばならぬ階層がある。
messages.dict_source: The mines are dark and deep, and I have levels to go before I sleep.

messages.raw_format: The more you use the E word, the better.
messages.full_text: The more you use the E word, the better.
messages.translation: 「E」という言葉を使うほど、良い結果が待っている。
messages.dict_source: The more you use the E word, the better.

messages.raw_format: The use of dynamite is dangerous.
messages.full_text: The use of dynamite is dangerous.
messages.translation: ダイナマイトの使用は危険だ。
messages.dict_source: The use of dynamite is dangerous.

messages.raw_format: There are no worms in the UNIX version.
messages.full_text: There are no worms in the UNIX version.
messages.translation: UNIX版には虫はいない。
messages.dict_source: There are no worms in the UNIX version.

messages.raw_format: There is a trap on this level!
messages.full_text: There is a trap on this level!
messages.translation: この階に罠がある！
messages.dict_source: There is a trap on this level!

messages.raw_format: They say that Demogorgon, Asmodeus, Orcus, Yeenoghu & Juiblex is no law firm.
messages.full_text: They say that Demogorgon, Asmodeus, Orcus, Yeenoghu & Juiblex is no law firm.
messages.translation: デモゴルゴン、アスモデウス、オルクス、イェーノグ、そしてジュイブレクスは、法律事務所ではないという噂だ（悪魔の君主たちを並べただけ）。
messages.dict_source: They say that Demogorgon, Asmodeus, Orcus, Yeenoghu & Juiblex is no law firm.

messages.raw_format: They say that Geryon has an evil twin, beware!
messages.full_text: They say that Geryon has an evil twin, beware!
messages.translation: ゲリュオンには邪悪な双子がいる、警戒せよ！
messages.dict_source: They say that Geryon has an evil twin, beware!

messages.raw_format: They say that Medusa would make a terrible pet.
messages.full_text: They say that Medusa would make a terrible pet.
messages.translation: メデューサをペットにするのは最悪だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that Medusa would make a terrible pet.

messages.raw_format: They say that NetHack bugs are Seldon planned.
messages.full_text: They say that NetHack bugs are Seldon planned.
messages.translation: NetHackのバグはセルドン計画だと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that NetHack bugs are Seldon planned.

messages.raw_format: They say that NetHack comes in 256 flavors.
messages.full_text: They say that NetHack comes in 256 flavors.
messages.translation: NetHackには256種類の味（またはバリエーション）があるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that NetHack comes in 256 flavors.

messages.raw_format: They say that NetHack is just a computer game.
messages.full_text: They say that NetHack is just a computer game.
messages.translation: NetHackはただのコンピューターゲームだと言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that NetHack is just a computer game.

messages.raw_format: They say that NetHack is more than just a computer game.
messages.full_text: They say that NetHack is more than just a computer game.
messages.translation: NetHackは単なるコンピュータゲーム以上の存在だという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that NetHack is more than just a computer game.

messages.raw_format: They say that NetHack is never what it used to be.
messages.full_text: They say that NetHack is never what it used to be.
messages.translation: NetHackは昔とは違うと言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that NetHack is never what it used to be.

messages.raw_format: They say that a baby dragon is too small to hurt or help you.
messages.full_text: They say that a baby dragon is too small to hurt or help you.
messages.translation: ドラゴンの赤ん坊は小さすぎて、君を傷つけることも助けることもできないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a baby dragon is too small to hurt or help you.

messages.raw_format: They say that a black pudding is simply a brown pudding gone bad.
messages.full_text: They say that a black pudding is simply a brown pudding gone bad.
messages.translation: ブラック・プディングは、単にブラウン・プディングが腐ったものだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a black pudding is simply a brown pudding gone bad.

messages.raw_format: They say that a black sheep has 3 bags full of wool.
messages.full_text: They say that a black sheep has 3 bags full of wool.
messages.translation: 黒い羊は三袋分のウール（毛）を蓄えているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a black sheep has 3 bags full of wool.

messages.raw_format: They say that a blank scroll is like a blank check.
messages.full_text: They say that a blank scroll is like a blank check.
messages.translation: 白紙のスクロールは空白の小切手のようなものだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a blank scroll is like a blank check.

messages.raw_format: They say that a cat named Morris has nine lives.
messages.full_text: They say that a cat named Morris has nine lives.
messages.translation: モリスという名の猫は九つの命を持っていると言われている。
messages.dict_source: They say that a cat named Morris has nine lives.

messages.raw_format: They say that a desperate shopper might pay any price in a shop.
messages.full_text: They say that a desperate shopper might pay any price in a shop.
messages.translation: 絶望的な買い物客は店ではどんな値段でも払うという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a desperate shopper might pay any price in a shop.

messages.raw_format: They say that a diamond dog is everybody's best friend.
messages.full_text: They say that a diamond dog is everybody's best friend.
messages.translation: ダイヤモンドドッグは誰にとっても最高の友達だという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a diamond dog is everybody's best friend.

messages.raw_format: They say that a dwarf lord can carry a pick-axe because his armor is light.
messages.full_text: They say that a dwarf lord can carry a pick-axe because his armor is light.
messages.translation: ドワーフの領主は鎧が軽いからつるはしを携えられると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a dwarf lord can carry a pick-axe because his armor is light.

messages.raw_format: They say that a floating eye can defeat Medusa.
messages.full_text: They say that a floating eye can defeat Medusa.
messages.translation: 浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）はメデューサを倒せるという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a floating eye can defeat Medusa.

messages.raw_format: [cookie] They say that a fortune only has 1 line and you can't read between it.
messages.full_text: [cookie] They say that a fortune only has 1 line and you can't read between it.

messages.raw_format: [cookie] They say that a fortune only has 1 line, but you can read between it.
messages.full_text: [cookie] They say that a fortune only has 1 line, but you can read between it.

messages.raw_format: They say that a fountain looks nothing like a regularly erupting geyser.
messages.full_text: They say that a fountain looks nothing like a regularly erupting geyser.
messages.translation: 泉は、定期的に噴出する間欠泉とは似ても似つかないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a fountain looks nothing like a regularly erupting geyser.

messages.raw_format: They say that a gold doubloon is worth more than its weight in gold.
messages.full_text: They say that a gold doubloon is worth more than its weight in gold.
messages.translation: 金貨は金そのものの重さ以上の価値があると言う。
messages.dict_source: They say that a gold doubloon is worth more than its weight in gold.

messages.raw_format: They say that a grid bug won't pay a shopkeeper for zapping you in a shop.
messages.full_text: They say that a grid bug won't pay a shopkeeper for zapping you in a shop.
messages.translation: グリッド・バグは、店内で君を攻撃しても店主に代金を払わないという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a grid bug won't pay a shopkeeper for zapping you in a shop.

messages.raw_format: [cookie] They say that a gypsy could tell your fortune for a price.
messages.full_text: [cookie] They say that a gypsy could tell your fortune for a price.

messages.raw_format: They say that a hacker named Alice once level teleported by using a mirror.
messages.full_text: They say that a hacker named Alice once level teleported by using a mirror.
messages.translation: アリスという名のハッカーが、かつて鏡を使って階層間テレポートをしたという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a hacker named Alice once level teleported by using a mirror.

messages.raw_format: They say that a hacker named David once slew a giant with a sling and a rock.
messages.full_text: They say that a hacker named David once slew a giant with a sling and a rock.
messages.translation: デイヴィッドという名のハッカーが投石器と石で巨人をも倒したという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a hacker named David once slew a giant with a sling and a rock.

messages.raw_format: They say that a hacker named Dorothy once rode a fog cloud to Oz.
messages.full_text: They say that a hacker named Dorothy once rode a fog cloud to Oz.
messages.translation: ドロシーという名のハッカーが、かつて霧の雲に乗ってオズの国へ行ったという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a hacker named Dorothy once rode a fog cloud to Oz.

messages.raw_format: They say that a hacker named Mary once lost a white sheep in the mazes.
messages.full_text: They say that a hacker named Mary once lost a white sheep in the mazes.
messages.translation: メアリーという名のハッカーが、かつて迷宮で白い羊を失ったという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a hacker named Mary once lost a white sheep in the mazes.

messages.raw_format: They say that a helm of brilliance is not to be taken lightly.
messages.full_text: They say that a helm of brilliance is not to be taken lightly.
messages.translation: 輝きの兜は侮るがわきまえないものだという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a helm of brilliance is not to be taken lightly.

messages.raw_format: They say that a hot dog and a hell hound are the same thing.
messages.full_text: They say that a hot dog and a hell hound are the same thing.
messages.translation: ホットドッグとヘルハウンドは同じものだという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a hot dog and a hell hound are the same thing.

messages.raw_format: They say that a lamp named Aladdin's Lamp contains a djinni with 3 wishes.
messages.full_text: They say that a lamp named Aladdin's Lamp contains a djinni with 3 wishes.
messages.translation: 「アラジンのランプ」という名のランプには、三つの願いを叶える魔神が入っているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a lamp named Aladdin's Lamp contains a djinni with 3 wishes.

messages.raw_format: They say that a large dog named Lassie will lead you to the amulet.
messages.full_text: They say that a large dog named Lassie will lead you to the amulet.
messages.translation: ラッシーという名の大きな犬が、お守りに導いてくれるという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a large dog named Lassie will lead you to the amulet.

messages.raw_format: They say that a long sword is not a light sword.
messages.full_text: They say that a long sword is not a light sword.
messages.translation: 長剣は軽剣ではないという。
messages.dict_source: They say that a long sword is not a light sword.

messages.raw_format: They say that a manes won't mince words with you.
messages.full_text: They say that a manes won't mince words with you.
messages.translation: マネ（Manes）は君に対して言葉を濁さない（ストレートに襲ってくる）という噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a manes won't mince words with you.

messages.raw_format: They say that a mind is a terrible thing to waste.
messages.full_text: They say that a mind is a terrible thing to waste.
messages.translation: 「精神（知能）」を無駄にするのはこの上なく恐ろしいことだ（だからマインド・フレイヤーに気をつけろ）という噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a mind is a terrible thing to waste.

messages.raw_format: They say that a plain nymph will only wear a wire ring in one ear.
messages.full_text: They say that a plain nymph will only wear a wire ring in one ear.
messages.translation: 普通のニンフは、片方の耳に針金の指輪（Wire ring）を一つだけつけているという噂だ。
messages.dict_source: They say that a plain nymph will only wear a wire ring in one ear.

messages.raw_format: They say that a plumed hat could be a previously used crested helmet.
messages.full_text: They say that a plumed hat could be a previously used crested helmet.
