messages.translation: 祖国のために死ぬことは、甘美で名誉あることだ（ラテン語：ホラティウス）
messages.dict_source: Dulce et decorum est pro patria mori

messages.raw_format: Et in Arcadia ego
messages.full_text: Et in Arcadia ego
messages.translation: 我はアルカディアにもあり（ラテン語：死は理想郷にも存在する）

messages.raw_format: Fatty and skinny went to bed.  Fatty rolled over and skinny was dead.  Skinny Smith 1983-2000.
messages.full_text: Fatty and skinny went to bed.  Fatty rolled over and skinny was dead.  Skinny Smith 1983-2000.
messages.translation: デブとガリがベッドに入った。デブが寝返りをうったらガリが死んだ。スキニー・スミス 1983-2000。
messages.dict_source: Fatty and skinny went to bed.  Fatty rolled over and skinny was dead.  Skinny Smith 1983-2000.

messages.raw_format: Finally I am becoming stupider no more
messages.full_text: Finally I am becoming stupider no more
messages.translation: ついに、これ以上バカにならずに済む（パウル・エルデシュの墓碑銘『ようやくバカにならなくなった』より）。
messages.dict_source: Finally I am becoming stupider no more

messages.raw_format: Follow me to hell
messages.full_text: Follow me to hell
messages.translation: 地獄までついて来い

messages.raw_format: ...for famous men have the whole earth as their memorial
messages.full_text: ...for famous men have the whole earth as their memorial
messages.translation: ....なぜなら、著名な人々にとっては、全地球そのものが彼らの記念碑なのだから（ペリクレス）
messages.dict_source: ...for famous men have the whole earth as their memorial

messages.raw_format: Game over, man.  Game over.
messages.full_text: Game over, man.  Game over.
messages.translation: ゲームオーバーだ、あいつらお終いだよ。（映画『エイリアン2』より）

messages.raw_format: Go away!  I'm trying to take a nap in here!  Bloody adventurers...
messages.full_text: Go away!  I'm trying to take a nap in here!  Bloody adventurers...
messages.translation: あっちへ行け！ ここで昼寝をしてるんだ！ 忌々しい冒険者どもめ....
messages.dict_source: Go away!  I'm trying to take a nap in here!  Bloody adventurers...

messages.raw_format: Gone fishin'
messages.full_text: Gone fishin'
messages.translation: 釣りに行きました（不在）

messages.raw_format: Good night, sweet prince: And flights of angels sing thee to thy rest!
messages.full_text: Good night, sweet prince: And flights of angels sing thee to thy rest!
messages.translation: おやすみなさい、愛らしい王子様。天使の群れの歌声に包まれて、安らかに休みたまえ！（シェイクスピア『ハムレット』より）
messages.dict_source: Good night, sweet prince: And flights of angels sing thee to thy rest!

messages.raw_format: Go Team Ant!
messages.full_text: Go Team Ant!
messages.translation: ゴー・チーム・アント（蟻軍団）！

messages.raw_format: He farmed his way here
messages.full_text: He farmed his way here
messages.translation: 彼は稼ぎ（農耕）まくってここまで来た

messages.raw_format: Here lies a programmer.  Killed by a fatal error.
messages.full_text: Here lies a programmer.  Killed by a fatal error.
messages.translation: ここにプログラマー眠る。致命的なエラー（Fatal Error）により殺害。
messages.dict_source: Here lies a programmer.  Killed by a fatal error.

messages.raw_format: Here lies Bob - decided to try an acid blob
messages.full_text: Here lies Bob - decided to try an acid blob
messages.translation: ここにボブ眠る。酸の塊（Acid blob）を試してみようとしたのが運の尽き。
messages.dict_source: Here lies Bob - decided to try an acid blob

messages.raw_format: Here lies Dudley, killed by another %&#@#& newt.
messages.full_text: Here lies Dudley, killed by another %&#@#& newt.
messages.translation: ここにダドリー眠る。また例の %&#@#& なイモリに殺された。
messages.dict_source: Here lies Dudley, killed by another %&#@#& newt.

messages.raw_format: Here lies Gregg, choked on an egg
messages.full_text: Here lies Gregg, choked on an egg
messages.translation: ここにグレッグ眠る。卵を喉に詰まらせた。
messages.dict_source: Here lies Gregg, choked on an egg

messages.raw_format: Here lies Lies.  It's True.
messages.full_text: Here lies Lies.  It's True.
messages.translation: ここに「嘘（Lies）」が横たわっている。これは「真実（True）」だ。

messages.raw_format: Here lies The Lady's maid, died of a Vorpal Blade
messages.full_text: Here lies The Lady's maid, died of a Vorpal Blade
messages.translation: ここに貴婦人の侍女眠る。ヴォーパル・ブレイドに切り裂かれた。
messages.dict_source: Here lies The Lady's maid, died of a Vorpal Blade

messages.raw_format: Here lies the left foot of Jack, killed by a land mine.  Let us know if you find any more of him
messages.full_text: Here lies the left foot of Jack, killed by a land mine.  Let us know if you find any more of him
messages.translation: ここにジャックの左足眠る。地雷により殺害。もし彼の他の部分を見つけたら知らせてくれ。
messages.dict_source: Here lies the left foot of Jack, killed by a land mine.  Let us know if you find any more of him

messages.raw_format: He waited too long
messages.full_text: He waited too long
messages.translation: 彼は待ちすぎた

messages.raw_format: I'd rather be sailing
messages.full_text: I'd rather be sailing
messages.translation: 航海に行きたかったな

messages.raw_format: If a man's deeds do not outlive him, of what value is a mark in stone?
messages.full_text: If a man's deeds do not outlive him, of what value is a mark in stone?
messages.translation: 人の業がその人より長く残らないのなら、石の印に何の価値があるだろうか？
messages.dict_source: If a man's deeds do not outlive him, of what value is a mark in stone?

messages.raw_format: I'm gonna make it!
messages.full_text: I'm gonna make it!
messages.translation: やり遂げてみせる！（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: I took both pills!
messages.full_text: I took both pills!
messages.translation: 私は両方のピル（赤い薬と青い薬）を飲んだ！（映画『マトリックス』より）

messages.raw_format: I will survive!
messages.full_text: I will survive!
messages.translation: 私は生き残る！（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: Killed by a black dragon -- This grave is empty
messages.full_text: Killed by a black dragon -- This grave is empty
messages.translation: ブラック・ドラゴンにより殺害 -- （跡形もなく溶かされたため）この墓は空である
messages.dict_source: Killed by a black dragon -- This grave is empty

messages.raw_format: Let me out of here!
messages.full_text: Let me out of here!
messages.translation: ここから出してくれ！

messages.raw_format: Lookin' good, Medusa.
messages.full_text: Lookin' good, Medusa.
messages.translation: いい顔してるぜ、メデューサ。

messages.raw_format: Mrs. Smith, choked on an apple.  She left behind grieving husband, daughter, and granddaughter.
messages.full_text: Mrs. Smith, choked on an apple.  She left behind grieving husband, daughter, and granddaughter.
messages.translation: スミス夫人、リンゴを喉に詰まらせた。悲しみに暮れる夫、娘、そして孫娘を遺して。
messages.dict_source: Mrs. Smith, choked on an apple.  She left behind grieving husband, daughter, and granddaughter.

messages.raw_format: Nobody believed her when she said her feet were killing her
messages.full_text: Nobody believed her when she said her feet were killing her
messages.translation: 彼女が「足が痛くて死にそう」と言ったとき、誰も本気にしなかった（そして本当に死んだ）。
messages.dict_source: Nobody believed her when she said her feet were killing her

messages.raw_format: No!  I don't want to see my damn conduct!
messages.full_text: No!  I don't want to see my damn conduct!
messages.translation: 嫌だ！ 自分のクソみたいな「行い（Conduct：縛りプレイの記録）」なんて見たくない！
messages.dict_source: No!  I don't want to see my damn conduct!

messages.raw_format: One corpse, sans head
messages.full_text: One corpse, sans head
messages.translation: 遺体一つ、頭部無し

messages.raw_format: On the whole, I'd rather be in Minetown
messages.full_text: On the whole, I'd rather be in Minetown
messages.translation: 概して、私は（ここで死ぬより）鉱山街（Minetown）にいたかった。
messages.dict_source: On the whole, I'd rather be in Minetown

messages.raw_format: On vacation
messages.full_text: On vacation
messages.translation: 休暇中（死んでいることの婉曲表現）

messages.raw_format: Oops.
messages.full_text: Oops.
messages.translation: おっと（やっちまった）。

messages.raw_format: Out to Lunch
messages.full_text: Out to Lunch
messages.translation: 昼食中（不在、または気が狂っている）

messages.raw_format: SOLD
messages.full_text: SOLD
messages.translation: 売約済み（墓地が）

messages.raw_format: Someone set us up the bomb!
messages.full_text: Someone set us up the bomb!
messages.translation: 誰かが我々に爆弾を仕掛けた！（『ゼロウィング』パロディ）
messages.dict_source: Someone set us up the bomb!

messages.raw_format: Take my stuff, I don't need it anymore
messages.full_text: Take my stuff, I don't need it anymore
messages.translation: 俺の持ち物を持っていけ、もう必要ないから。
messages.dict_source: Take my stuff, I don't need it anymore

messages.raw_format: Taking a year dead for tax reasons
messages.full_text: Taking a year dead for tax reasons
messages.translation: 節税対策のため、一年の「死」をいただく（『銀河ヒッチハイク・ガイド』パロディ）
messages.dict_source: Taking a year dead for tax reasons

messages.raw_format: The reports of my demise are completely accurate
messages.full_text: The reports of my demise are completely accurate
messages.translation: 私の死についての報告は、完全に正確である（マーク・トウェインの有名な言葉の逆）
messages.dict_source: The reports of my demise are completely accurate

messages.raw_format: (This space for sale)
messages.full_text: (This space for sale)
messages.translation: （ここのスペース売り出し中）

messages.raw_format: This was actually just a pit, but since there was a corpse, we filled it
messages.full_text: This was actually just a pit, but since there was a corpse, we filled it
messages.translation: ここは元々ただの穴だったんだが、遺体があったんで埋めておいたよ
messages.dict_source: This was actually just a pit, but since there was a corpse, we filled it

messages.raw_format: This way to the crypt
messages.full_text: This way to the crypt
messages.translation: 地下聖堂はこちら

messages.raw_format: Tu quoque, Brute?
messages.full_text: Tu quoque, Brute?
messages.translation: ブルータス、お前もか？（ラテン語）

messages.raw_format: VACANCY
messages.full_text: VACANCY
messages.translation: 空室あり

messages.raw_format: Welcome!
messages.full_text: Welcome!
messages.translation: ようこそ！

messages.raw_format: Wish you were here!
messages.full_text: Wish you were here!
messages.translation: あなたがここにいてほしい（ピンク・フロイド『炎〜あなたがここにいてほしい』より）

messages.raw_format: Yea, it got me too
messages.full_text: Yea, it got me too
messages.translation: ああ、俺もやられたよ

messages.raw_format: You should see the other guy
messages.full_text: You should see the other guy
messages.translation: 相手の（ひどい）面も拝んでやるべきだぜ
messages.dict_source: You should see the other guy

messages.raw_format: ...and they made me engrave my own headstone too!
messages.full_text: ...and they made me engrave my own headstone too!
messages.translation: ....それに、自分の墓石を自分で彫らされたんだぜ！
messages.dict_source: ...and they made me engrave my own headstone too!

messages.raw_format: ...but the blood has stopped pumping and I am left to decay...
messages.full_text: ...but the blood has stopped pumping and I am left to decay...
messages.translation: ....だが血の巡りは止まり、私は朽ち果てるがままに取り残されている....
messages.dict_source: ...but the blood has stopped pumping and I am left to decay...

messages.raw_format: <Expletive Deleted>
messages.full_text: <Expletive Deleted>
messages.translation: ＜不適切な表現は削除されました＞

messages.raw_format: A masochist is never satisfied.
messages.full_text: A masochist is never satisfied.
messages.translation: マゾヒストが満足することなど、決してない。

messages.raw_format: Ach, 'twas a wee monster in the loch
messages.full_text: Ach, 'twas a wee monster in the loch
messages.translation: ああ、ありゃあ湖（ネス湖）にいたちっこい怪物（ネッシー）だったよ
messages.dict_source: Ach, 'twas a wee monster in the loch

messages.raw_format: Adapt.  Enjoy.  Survive.
messages.full_text: Adapt.  Enjoy.  Survive.
messages.translation: 順応せよ。楽しめ。生き残れ。

messages.raw_format: Adventure, hah!  Excitement, hah!
messages.full_text: Adventure, hah!  Excitement, hah!
messages.translation: 冒険だと？ ふん！ 興奮だと？ ふん！（スター・ウォーズ『帝国の逆襲』ヨーダの台詞）

messages.raw_format: After all, what are friends for...
messages.full_text: After all, what are friends for...
messages.translation: 結局のところ、友達ってのは何のためにいるんだか....
messages.dict_source: After all, what are friends for...

messages.raw_format: After this, nothing will shock me
messages.full_text: After this, nothing will shock me
messages.translation: これを見た後じゃ、もう何が起きても驚かないよ
messages.dict_source: After this, nothing will shock me

messages.raw_format: After three days, fish and guests stink
messages.full_text: After three days, fish and guests stink
messages.translation: 三日経てば、魚と客は鼻につく（ベンジャミン・フランクリン）
messages.dict_source: After three days, fish and guests stink

messages.raw_format: Age and treachery will always overcome youth and skill
messages.full_text: Age and treachery will always overcome youth and skill
messages.translation: 老獪さと裏切りは、常に若さと技術を凌駕する
messages.dict_source: Age and treachery will always overcome youth and skill

messages.raw_format: Ageing is not so bad.  The real killer is when you stop.
messages.full_text: Ageing is not so bad.  The real killer is when you stop.
messages.translation: 年を取るのはそう悪くない。本当に致命的なのは、止まってしまう（死ぬ）時だ。
messages.dict_source: Ageing is not so bad.  The real killer is when you stop.

messages.raw_format: Ain't I a stinker?
messages.full_text: Ain't I a stinker?
messages.translation: 僕って嫌な奴？（バッグス・バニーの決め台詞）

messages.raw_format: Algernon
messages.full_text: Algernon
messages.translation: アルジャーノン（『アルジャーノンに花束を』より）

messages.raw_format: All else failed...
messages.full_text: All else failed...
messages.translation: 他のすべてが失敗した....

messages.raw_format: All hail RNG
messages.full_text: All hail RNG
messages.translation: 乱数神（RNG）を讃えよ

messages.raw_format: All right, we'll call it a draw!
messages.full_text: All right, we'll call it a draw!
messages.translation: よし、引き分けにしておいてやろう！（モンティ・パイソン『ホーリー・グレイル』黒騎士の台詞）
messages.dict_source: All right, we'll call it a draw!

messages.raw_format: All's well that ends well
messages.full_text: All's well that ends well
messages.translation: 終わりよければすべてよし

messages.raw_format: Alone at last!
messages.full_text: Alone at last!
messages.translation: やっと一人になれた！

messages.raw_format: Always attack a floating eye from behind!
messages.full_text: Always attack a floating eye from behind!
messages.translation: 浮遊する眼（フローティング・アイ）は常に後ろから攻撃しろ！
messages.dict_source: Always attack a floating eye from behind!

messages.raw_format: Am I having fun yet?
messages.full_text: Am I having fun yet?
messages.translation: 私はもう楽しんでいるのか？

messages.raw_format: And I can still crawl, I'm not dead yet!
messages.full_text: And I can still crawl, I'm not dead yet!
messages.translation: まだ這えるぞ、私はまだ死んでいない！（モンティ・パイソン『ホーリー・グレイル』死体回収シーンより）
messages.dict_source: And I can still crawl, I'm not dead yet!

messages.raw_format: And all I wanted was a free lunch
messages.full_text: And all I wanted was a free lunch
messages.translation: 欲しかったのはタダ飯（フリー・ランチ）だけだったのに
messages.dict_source: And all I wanted was a free lunch

messages.raw_format: And all of the signs were right there on your face
messages.full_text: And all of the signs were right there on your face
messages.translation: その兆候はすべて、君の顔に書いてあったんだ
messages.dict_source: And all of the signs were right there on your face

messages.raw_format: And don't give me that innocent look either!
messages.full_text: And don't give me that innocent look either!
messages.translation: そんな潔白そうな顔で見つめるなよ！
messages.dict_source: And don't give me that innocent look either!

messages.raw_format: And everyone died.  Boo hoo hoo.
messages.full_text: And everyone died.  Boo hoo hoo.
messages.translation: そして皆死にました。えーん、えーん。
messages.dict_source: And everyone died.  Boo hoo hoo.

messages.raw_format: And here I go again...
messages.full_text: And here I go again...
messages.translation: そしてまた、私は行くんだ....

messages.raw_format: And nobody cares until somebody famous dies...
messages.full_text: And nobody cares until somebody famous dies...
messages.translation: そして誰か有名な奴が死ぬまで、誰も気に留めないんだ....
messages.dict_source: And nobody cares until somebody famous dies...

messages.raw_format: And so it ends?
messages.full_text: And so it ends?
messages.translation: これで終わりか？

messages.raw_format: And so... it begins.
messages.full_text: And so... it begins.
messages.translation: そして....始まるんだ。

messages.raw_format: And sometimes the bear eats you.
messages.full_text: And sometimes the bear eats you.
messages.translation: 時にはクマに食べられることもある（『ビッグ・リボウスキ』より）
messages.dict_source: And sometimes the bear eats you.

messages.raw_format: And then 'e nailed me 'ead to the floor!
messages.full_text: And then 'e nailed me 'ead to the floor!
messages.translation: そしてあいつ、俺の頭を床に釘付けにしやがったんだ！（モンティ・パイソン風）
messages.dict_source: And then 'e nailed me 'ead to the floor!

messages.raw_format: And they said it couldn't be done!
messages.full_text: And they said it couldn't be done!
messages.translation: そして皆、そんなこと（死ぬこと）ができるはずがないと言ったんだ！
messages.dict_source: And they said it couldn't be done!

messages.raw_format: And what do I look like?  The living?
messages.full_text: And what do I look like?  The living?
messages.translation: 私は何に見える？ 生きている者に見えるか？
messages.dict_source: And what do I look like?  The living?

messages.raw_format: And yes, it was ALL his fault!
messages.full_text: And yes, it was ALL his fault!
messages.translation: そう、すべてはあいつのせいなんだ！
messages.dict_source: And yes, it was ALL his fault!

messages.raw_format: And you said it was pretty here...
messages.full_text: And you said it was pretty here...
messages.translation: ここが綺麗だって、君は言ったじゃないか....
messages.dict_source: And you said it was pretty here...

messages.raw_format: Another lost soul
messages.full_text: Another lost soul
messages.translation: また一人、失われた魂（犠牲者）だ

messages.raw_format: Any day above ground is a good day!
messages.full_text: Any day above ground is a good day!
messages.translation: 地上（墓の外）で過ごせる日は、いつだって最高の日だ！
messages.dict_source: Any day above ground is a good day!

messages.raw_format: Any more of this and I'll die of a stroke before I'm 30.
messages.full_text: Any more of this and I'll die of a stroke before I'm 30.
messages.translation: こんなことが続けば、30歳になる前に卒中で死んでしまうよ。（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Any more of this and I'll die of a stroke before I'm 30.

messages.raw_format: Anybody seen my head?
messages.full_text: Anybody seen my head?
messages.translation: 誰か僕の頭を見なかった？

messages.raw_format: Anyone for deathmatch?
messages.full_text: Anyone for deathmatch?
messages.translation: デスマッチをしたい奴はいるか？

messages.raw_format: Anything for a change.
messages.full_text: Anything for a change.
messages.translation: 変化のためなら何でもする。

messages.raw_format: Anything that kills you makes you ... well, dead
messages.full_text: Anything that kills you makes you ... well, dead
messages.translation: 君を殺すものは何であれ、君を....まあ、「死人」にするんだ。
messages.dict_source: Anything that kills you makes you ... well, dead

messages.raw_format: Anything worth doing is worth overdoing.
messages.full_text: Anything worth doing is worth overdoing.
messages.translation: やる価値のあることなら、やりすぎる価値もある。
messages.dict_source: Anything worth doing is worth overdoing.

messages.raw_format: Are unicorns supposedly peaceful if you're a virgin?  Hah!
messages.full_text: Are unicorns supposedly peaceful if you're a virgin?  Hah!
messages.translation: 処女（童貞）ならユニコーンは大人しいはずだって？ はっ！
messages.dict_source: Are unicorns supposedly peaceful if you're a virgin?  Hah!

messages.raw_format: Are we all being disintegrated, or is it just me?
messages.full_text: Are we all being disintegrated, or is it just me?
messages.translation: みんな分解（Disintegrated）されてるのか、それとも僕だけ？
messages.dict_source: Are we all being disintegrated, or is it just me?

messages.raw_format: At least I'm good at something
messages.full_text: At least I'm good at something
messages.translation: 少なくとも、一つくらいは得意なことがあったんだ（死ぬこと、とか）
messages.dict_source: At least I'm good at something

messages.raw_format: Attempted suicide
messages.full_text: Attempted suicide
messages.translation: 自殺未遂（の結果、死んだ）

messages.raw_format: Auri sacra fames
messages.full_text: Auri sacra fames
messages.translation: 黄金への呪わしき飢え（ラテン語：ウェルギリウス『アエネーイス』より）

messages.raw_format: Auribus teneo lupum
messages.full_text: Auribus teneo lupum
messages.translation: 狼の耳を掴んでいる（ラテン語：進むも退くも地獄、の意）

messages.raw_format: Be prepared
messages.full_text: Be prepared
messages.translation: 備えよ常に（ボーイスカウトのモットー）

messages.raw_format: Beauty survives
messages.full_text: Beauty survives
messages.translation: 美は生き残る

messages.raw_format: Been Here.  Now Gone.  Had a Good Time.
messages.full_text: Been Here.  Now Gone.  Had a Good Time.
messages.translation: ここにいたが、今はもういない。楽しい時間だったよ。
messages.dict_source: Been Here.  Now Gone.  Had a Good Time.

messages.raw_format: Been through Hell, eh?  What did you bring me?
messages.full_text: Been through Hell, eh?  What did you bring me?
messages.translation: 地獄（Hell）を通り抜けてきたのかい？ 私に何を届けてくれたんだ？
messages.dict_source: Been through Hell, eh?  What did you bring me?

messages.raw_format: Beg your pardon, didn't recognize you, I've changed a lot.
messages.full_text: Beg your pardon, didn't recognize you, I've changed a lot.
messages.translation: === TODO === ごめんなさい、あなたを認識できませんでした、私は大きく変わりました。
messages.dict_source: Beg your pardon, didn't recognize you, I've changed a lot.

messages.raw_format: Being dead builds character
messages.full_text: Being dead builds character
messages.translation: 死ぬことは、人格（またはキャラクター）を形成する

messages.raw_format: Beloved daughter, a treasure, buried here.
messages.full_text: Beloved daughter, a treasure, buried here.
messages.translation: 最愛の娘、私たちの宝物、ここに眠る。
messages.dict_source: Beloved daughter, a treasure, buried here.

messages.raw_format: Best friends come and go....  Mine just die.
messages.full_text: Best friends come and go....  Mine just die.
messages.translation: 親友は現れては去っていくもの....私のはただ死ぬだけだがね。
messages.dict_source: Best friends come and go....  Mine just die.

messages.raw_format: Better be dead than a fat slave
messages.full_text: Better be dead than a fat slave
messages.translation: 太った奴隷になるよりは、死んだほうがマシだ
messages.dict_source: Better be dead than a fat slave

messages.raw_format: Better luck next time
messages.full_text: Better luck next time
messages.translation: 次はもっとうまくいくさ（幸運を）

messages.raw_format: Beware of Discordians bearing answers
messages.full_text: Beware of Discordians bearing answers
messages.translation: 答えを持ってくるディスコルディア教徒（Discordians：混乱の信奉者）に注意せよ

messages.raw_format: Beware the ...
messages.full_text: Beware the ...
messages.translation: ....に注意せよ

messages.raw_format: Bloody Hell...
messages.full_text: Bloody Hell...
messages.translation: なんてこった（イギリス英語的な罵倒表現）....

messages.raw_format: Bloody barbarians!
messages.full_text: Bloody barbarians!
messages.translation: 忌々しい野蛮人どもめ！

messages.raw_format: Blown upward out of sight: He sought the leak by candlelight
messages.full_text: Blown upward out of sight: He sought the leak by candlelight
messages.translation: 見えないところまで吹き飛ばされた。彼はロウソクの火で（ガスの）漏れを探していたのだから。
messages.dict_source: Blown upward out of sight: He sought the leak by candlelight

messages.raw_format: Brains... Brains... Fresh human brains...
messages.full_text: Brains... Brains... Fresh human brains...
messages.translation: 脳みそ....脳みそ....新鮮な人間の脳みそを....（ゾンビの台詞）

messages.raw_format: Buried the cat.  Took an hour.  Damn thing kept fighting.
messages.full_text: Buried the cat.  Took an hour.  Damn thing kept fighting.
messages.translation: 猫を埋めてやった。一時間もかかったよ。クソったれ、ずっと暴れやがって。
messages.dict_source: Buried the cat.  Took an hour.  Damn thing kept fighting.

messages.raw_format: But I disarmed the trap!
messages.full_text: But I disarmed the trap!
messages.translation: でも、罠は解除したはずなのに！（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: CONNECT 1964 - NO CARRIER 1994
messages.full_text: CONNECT 1964 - NO CARRIER 1994
messages.translation: 接続 1964 - 通信切断 1994（NO CARRIER：モデムの切断メッセージ）

messages.raw_format: Call me if you need my phone number!
messages.full_text: Call me if you need my phone number!
messages.translation: 電話番号が必要なら呼んでください！
messages.dict_source: Call me if you need my phone number!

messages.raw_format: Can YOU fly?
messages.full_text: Can YOU fly?
messages.translation: 君は飛べるのかい？

messages.raw_format: Can you believe that thing is STILL moving?
messages.full_text: Can you believe that thing is STILL moving?
messages.translation: あれがまだ動いてるなんて信じられるか？
messages.dict_source: Can you believe that thing is STILL moving?

messages.raw_format: Can you come up with some better ending for this?
messages.full_text: Can you come up with some better ending for this?
messages.translation: これのもっとマシな結末を思いついてくれないか？
messages.dict_source: Can you come up with some better ending for this?

messages.raw_format: Can you feel anything when I do this?
messages.full_text: Can you feel anything when I do this?
messages.translation: こうすると、何か感じるかい？
messages.dict_source: Can you feel anything when I do this?

messages.raw_format: Can you give me mouth to mouth, you just took my breath away.
messages.full_text: Can you give me mouth to mouth, you just took my breath away.
messages.translation: 人工呼吸してくれない？　君に息が止まりそうになったんだ。
messages.dict_source: Can you give me mouth to mouth, you just took my breath away.

messages.raw_format: Can't I just have a LITTLE peril?
messages.full_text: Can't I just have a LITTLE peril?
messages.translation: ほんの少しの危険（Peril）も許されないのか？（モンティ・パイソン『ホーリー・グレイル』より）
messages.dict_source: Can't I just have a LITTLE peril?

messages.raw_format: Can't eat, can't sleep, had to bury the husband here.
messages.full_text: Can't eat, can't sleep, had to bury the husband here.
messages.translation: 食べられない、眠れない、ここで夫を埋めなきゃならなかった。
messages.dict_source: Can't eat, can't sleep, had to bury the husband here.

messages.raw_format: Can't you hit me?!
messages.full_text: Can't you hit me?!
messages.translation: 僕に攻撃できないのかい？！

messages.raw_format: Chaos, panic and disorder.  My work here is done.
messages.full_text: Chaos, panic and disorder.  My work here is done.
messages.translation: 混乱、パニック、無秩序。ここでの私の仕事は終わった。
messages.dict_source: Chaos, panic and disorder.  My work here is done.

messages.raw_format: Check enclosed.
messages.full_text: Check enclosed.
messages.translation: 小切手同封。

messages.raw_format: Check this out!  It's my brain!
messages.full_text: Check this out!  It's my brain!
messages.translation: これを見てくれ！ 私の脳みそだぜ！
messages.dict_source: Check this out!  It's my brain!

messages.raw_format: Chivalry is only reasonably dead
messages.full_text: Chivalry is only reasonably dead
messages.translation: 騎士道精神は、まあ妥当に死んでいるだけだ

messages.raw_format: Coffin for sale.  Lifetime guarantee.
messages.full_text: Coffin for sale.  Lifetime guarantee.
messages.translation: 棺桶売り出し中。一生涯保証付き。

messages.raw_format: Come Monday, I'll be all right.
messages.full_text: Come Monday, I'll be all right.
messages.translation: 月曜日になれば、きっと大丈夫さ。
messages.dict_source: Come Monday, I'll be all right.

messages.raw_format: Come and see the violence inherent in the system
messages.full_text: Come and see the violence inherent in the system
messages.translation: システムに内在する暴力を見に来い（モンティ・パイソン『ホーリー・グレイル』より）
messages.dict_source: Come and see the violence inherent in the system

messages.raw_format: Come back here!  I'll bite your bloody knees off!
messages.full_text: Come back here!  I'll bite your bloody knees off!
messages.translation: 戻ってこい！ お前の膝っこぞうを噛みちぎってやる！（モンティ・パイソン、黒騎士の台詞）
messages.dict_source: Come back here!  I'll bite your bloody knees off!

messages.raw_format: Commodore Business Machines, Inc.  Died for our sins.
messages.full_text: Commodore Business Machines, Inc.  Died for our sins.
messages.translation: コモドール・ビジネス・マシンズ社。我らの罪のために死せり（倒産へのメタな言及）。
messages.dict_source: Commodore Business Machines, Inc.  Died for our sins.

messages.raw_format: Complain to one who can help you
messages.full_text: Complain to one who can help you
messages.translation: 助けてくれる人に文句を言え
messages.dict_source: Complain to one who can help you

messages.raw_format: Confess my sins to god?  Which one?
messages.full_text: Confess my sins to god?  Which one?
messages.translation: 神に罪を告白する？ どの神に？
messages.dict_source: Confess my sins to god?  Which one?

messages.raw_format: Confusion will be my epitaph
messages.full_text: Confusion will be my epitaph
messages.translation: 混乱こそが我が墓碑銘（キング・クリムゾン『エピタフ』より）

messages.raw_format: Cooties?  Ain't no cooties on me!
messages.full_text: Cooties?  Ain't no cooties on me!
messages.translation: シラミ（Cooties：子供の嫌がらせ言葉）？ 俺にはそんなもん付いてないぜ！
messages.dict_source: Cooties?  Ain't no cooties on me!

messages.raw_format: Could somebody get this noose off me?
messages.full_text: Could somebody get this noose off me?
messages.translation: 誰か、この首吊り縄を外してくれないか？
messages.dict_source: Could somebody get this noose off me?

messages.raw_format: Could you check again?  My name MUST be there.
messages.full_text: Could you check again?  My name MUST be there.
messages.translation: もう一度確認してくれ。私の名前がそこにあるはずなんだ。
messages.dict_source: Could you check again?  My name MUST be there.

messages.raw_format: Could you please take a breath mint?
messages.full_text: Could you please take a breath mint?
messages.translation: ブレスケアをしてくれませんか？
messages.dict_source: Could you please take a breath mint?

messages.raw_format: Couldn't I be sedated for this?
messages.full_text: Couldn't I be sedated for this?
messages.translation: 麻酔とかしてくれないのか？
messages.dict_source: Couldn't I be sedated for this?

messages.raw_format: Courage is looking at your setbacks with serenity
messages.full_text: Courage is looking at your setbacks with serenity
messages.translation: 勇気とは、挫折を平静に見つめることである
messages.dict_source: Courage is looking at your setbacks with serenity

messages.raw_format: Cover me, I'm going in!
messages.full_text: Cover me, I'm going in!
messages.translation: 援護しろ、突入する！

messages.raw_format: Crash course in brain surgery
messages.full_text: Crash course in brain surgery
messages.translation: 脳外科手術の短期集中コース（物理的に頭を割られたことへの皮肉）

messages.raw_format: Cross my fingers for me.
messages.full_text: Cross my fingers for me.
messages.translation: 私のために幸運を祈ってくれ（指を交差させてくれ）。

messages.raw_format: Curse god and die
messages.full_text: Curse god and die
messages.translation: 神を呪って死ね（『ヨブ記』より）

messages.raw_format: Cut to fit
messages.full_text: Cut to fit
messages.translation: ピッタリ合うようにカット（死体を棺桶に？）

messages.raw_format: De'Ath
messages.full_text: De'Ath
messages.translation: デ・アス（テリー・プラチェット『ディスクワールド』より「死神」の別名）

messages.raw_format: Dead Again?  Pardon me for not getting it right the first time!
messages.full_text: Dead Again?  Pardon me for not getting it right the first time!
messages.translation: また死んだのか？ 最初からうまく（死な）なくて済まなかったな！
messages.dict_source: Dead Again?  Pardon me for not getting it right the first time!

messages.raw_format: Dead and loving every moment!
messages.full_text: Dead and loving every moment!
messages.translation: 死んでいる。そのすべての瞬間が最高だ！

messages.raw_format: Dear wife of mine.  Died of a broken heart, after I took it out of her.
messages.full_text: Dear wife of mine.  Died of a broken heart, after I took it out of her.
messages.translation: 愛する妻。彼女の心臓（Heart）を抜き取ったら、失意（Broken heart）のうちに死んでしまった。
messages.dict_source: Dear wife of mine.  Died of a broken heart, after I took it out of her.

messages.raw_format: Don't tread on me!
messages.full_text: Don't tread on me!
messages.translation: 私を踏みつけるな！（ガズデン・フラッグのモットー）

messages.raw_format: Dragon? What dragon?
messages.full_text: Dragon? What dragon?
messages.translation: ドラゴン？ 何のドラゴンのことだい？（背後にいるドラゴンに気づかず死んだ者のセリフ）

messages.raw_format: Drawn and quartered
messages.full_text: Drawn and quartered
messages.translation: 首吊り・内臓抉り・四つ裂きの刑（中世の極刑）

messages.raw_format: Either I'm dead or my watch has stopped.
messages.full_text: Either I'm dead or my watch has stopped.
messages.translation: 私が死んだか、それとも時計が止まったか、どっちかだ（グルーチョ・マルクスのパロディ）。
messages.dict_source: Either I'm dead or my watch has stopped.

messages.raw_format: Eliza -- Was I really alive, or did I just think I was?
messages.full_text: Eliza -- Was I really alive, or did I just think I was?
messages.translation: イライザ -- 僕は本当に生きていたのか、それともそう思っていただけか？
messages.dict_source: Eliza -- Was I really alive, or did I just think I was?

messages.raw_format: Elvis
messages.full_text: Elvis
messages.translation: エルヴィス（・プレスリー。エルヴィスは死んでいない、という都市伝説への皮肉）

messages.raw_format: Enter not into the path of the wicked
messages.full_text: Enter not into the path of the wicked
messages.translation: 悪しき者の道に入ってはならない
messages.dict_source: Enter not into the path of the wicked

messages.raw_format: Eris?  I don't need Eris
messages.full_text: Eris?  I don't need Eris
messages.translation: エリス（不和の女神）？ そんなもん必要ないぜ

messages.raw_format: Eternal Damnation, Come and stay a long while!
messages.full_text: Eternal Damnation, Come and stay a long while!
messages.translation: 永遠の地獄、さあ来て長く滞在するがいい！
messages.dict_source: Eternal Damnation, Come and stay a long while!

messages.raw_format: Even The Dead pay taxes (and they aren't Grateful).
messages.full_text: Even The Dead pay taxes (and they aren't Grateful).
messages.translation: 死人でさえ税金を払う（そして彼らは「感謝（Grateful）」などしていない。Grateful Deadへの皮肉）。
messages.dict_source: Even The Dead pay taxes (and they aren't Grateful).

messages.raw_format: Even a tomb stone will say good things when you're down!
messages.full_text: Even a tomb stone will say good things when you're down!
messages.translation: 落ち込んでいる時（または埋められた時）は、墓石だって良いことを言ってくれるものさ！
messages.dict_source: Even a tomb stone will say good things when you're down!

messages.raw_format: Ever notice that live is evil backwards?
messages.full_text: Ever notice that live is evil backwards?
messages.translation: 「live（生きる）」の逆が「evil（悪）」だって気づいたことあるか？（回文への言及）
messages.dict_source: Ever notice that live is evil backwards?

messages.raw_format: Every day is starting to look like Monday
messages.full_text: Every day is starting to look like Monday
messages.translation: 毎日が月曜日（憂鬱な日）のように見え始めてきた
messages.dict_source: Every day is starting to look like Monday

messages.raw_format: Every day, in every way, I am getting better and better.
messages.full_text: Every day, in every way, I am getting better and better.
messages.translation: 毎日、あらゆる面で、私はますます良くなっている（エミール・クーエの自己暗示の言葉）。
messages.dict_source: Every day, in every way, I am getting better and better.

messages.raw_format: Every survival kit should include a sense of humor
messages.full_text: Every survival kit should include a sense of humor
messages.translation: どんなサバイバルキットにも、ユーモアのセンスを含めるべきだ
messages.dict_source: Every survival kit should include a sense of humor

messages.raw_format: Evil I did dwell;  lewd did I live
messages.full_text: Evil I did dwell;  lewd did I live
messages.translation: 悪の中に住み、淫らに生きた（回文：Evil I did dwell / lewd I did live）
messages.dict_source: Evil I did dwell;  lewd did I live

messages.raw_format: Ex post fucto
messages.full_text: Ex post fucto
messages.translation: 事後的に（Ex post facto：事後報告、の捩り）

messages.raw_format: Excellent day to have a rotten day.
messages.full_text: Excellent day to have a rotten day.
messages.translation: 最悪な一日を過ごすには最高の一日だ。
messages.dict_source: Excellent day to have a rotten day.

messages.raw_format: Excuse me for not standing up.
messages.full_text: Excuse me for not standing up.
messages.translation: 立ち上がれなくて失礼（ヘミングウェイの墓碑銘として有名な言葉のパロディ）。
messages.dict_source: Excuse me for not standing up.

messages.raw_format: Experience isn't everything.  First, you've got to survive.
messages.full_text: Experience isn't everything.  First, you've got to survive.
messages.translation: 経験がすべてじゃない。まず、生き残らなきゃならん。
messages.dict_source: Experience isn't everything.  First, you've got to survive.

messages.raw_format: First shalt thou pull out the Holy Pin
messages.full_text: First shalt thou pull out the Holy Pin
messages.translation: まず、汝は「聖なるピン」を抜かねばならぬ（モンティ・パイソン『ホーリー・グレイル』聖なる手榴弾の件より）
messages.dict_source: First shalt thou pull out the Holy Pin

messages.raw_format: For a Breath, I Tarry...
messages.full_text: For a Breath, I Tarry...
messages.translation: ひと息つく間、私はとどまる....（ロジャー・ゼラズニイ『伝道の書に捧げる薔薇』収録作より）

messages.raw_format: For recreational use only.
messages.full_text: For recreational use only.
messages.translation: 娯楽用（のみに使用すること）。

messages.raw_format: For sale: One soul, slightly used.  Asking for 3 wishes.
messages.full_text: For sale: One soul, slightly used.  Asking for 3 wishes.
messages.translation: 売り出し中：魂一つ、わずかに使用感あり。三つの「願い（Wishes）」で譲ります。
messages.dict_source: For sale: One soul, slightly used.  Asking for 3 wishes.

messages.raw_format: For some moments in life, there are no words.
messages.full_text: For some moments in life, there are no words.
messages.translation: 人生には、言葉にならない瞬間がある。
messages.dict_source: For some moments in life, there are no words.

messages.raw_format: Forget Disney World, I'm going to Hell!
messages.full_text: Forget Disney World, I'm going to Hell!
messages.translation: ディズニーランドのことは忘れろ、俺は地獄（Hell）へ行くんだ！
messages.dict_source: Forget Disney World, I'm going to Hell!

messages.raw_format: Forget about the dog, Beware of my wife.
messages.full_text: Forget about the dog, Beware of my wife.
messages.translation: 犬のことは気にするな、俺の妻に用心しろ。
messages.dict_source: Forget about the dog, Beware of my wife.

messages.raw_format: Funeral - Real fun.
messages.full_text: Funeral - Real fun.
messages.translation: 葬式（Funeral） -- それは本当の「楽しみ（Fun）」だ。

messages.raw_format: Gawd, it's depressing in here, isn't it?
messages.full_text: Gawd, it's depressing in here, isn't it?
messages.translation: ああ、ここは本当に陰気だな。そう思わないか？
messages.dict_source: Gawd, it's depressing in here, isn't it?

messages.raw_format: Genuine Exploding Gravestone.  (c)Acme Gravestones Inc.
messages.full_text: Genuine Exploding Gravestone.  (c)Acme Gravestones Inc.
messages.translation: 本物！ 爆発する墓石。 (c)アクメ墓石株式会社（ACME社パロディ）

messages.raw_format: Get back here!  I'm not finished yet...
messages.full_text: Get back here!  I'm not finished yet...
messages.translation: 戻ってこい！ まだ終わってないぞ....
messages.dict_source: Get back here!  I'm not finished yet...

messages.raw_format: Go ahead, I dare you to!
messages.full_text: Go ahead, I dare you to!
messages.translation: やってみろ、できるもんならな！
messages.dict_source: Go ahead, I dare you to!

messages.raw_format: Go ahead, it's either you or him.
messages.full_text: Go ahead, it's either you or him.
messages.translation: やるがいい、君か彼か、どっちかだ。
messages.dict_source: Go ahead, it's either you or him.

messages.raw_format: Goldilocks -- This casket is just right
messages.full_text: Goldilocks -- This casket is just right
messages.translation: ゴルディロックス -- この棺桶はちょうどいい大きさだ（童話『3びきのくま』より）。
messages.dict_source: Goldilocks -- This casket is just right

messages.raw_format: Gone But Not Forgotten
messages.full_text: Gone But Not Forgotten
messages.translation: 去りぬ、だが忘れ去られはしない

messages.raw_format: Gone Underground For Good
messages.full_text: Gone Underground For Good
messages.translation: 永遠に地下（あの世）へ行ってしまった

messages.raw_format: Gone away owin' more than he could pay.
messages.full_text: Gone away owin' more than he could pay.
messages.translation: 支払える以上の借金を残して、あいつは逝っちまった。
messages.dict_source: Gone away owin' more than he could pay.

messages.raw_format: Gone, but not forgiven
messages.full_text: Gone, but not forgiven
messages.translation: 消え失せた。だが許されてはいない。

messages.raw_format: Got a life.  Didn't know what to do with it.
messages.full_text: Got a life.  Didn't know what to do with it.
messages.translation: 命（または人生）を手に入れたが、どう扱えばいいか分からなかった。
messages.dict_source: Got a life.  Didn't know what to do with it.

messages.raw_format: Grave?  But I was cremated!
messages.full_text: Grave?  But I was cremated!
messages.translation: 墓だと？ 俺は火葬されたはずなのに！

messages.raw_format: Greetings from Hell - Wish you were here.
messages.full_text: Greetings from Hell - Wish you were here.
messages.translation: 地獄より愛を込めて -- 君もここにいればいいのに。
messages.dict_source: Greetings from Hell - Wish you were here.

messages.raw_format: HELP! It's dark in here....  Oh, my eyes are closed - sorry
messages.full_text: HELP! It's dark in here....  Oh, my eyes are closed - sorry
messages.translation: 助けて！ ここは真っ暗だ....。あ、目が閉じてただけだった。ごめん。
messages.dict_source: HELP! It's dark in here....  Oh, my eyes are closed - sorry

messages.raw_format: Ha! I NEVER pay income tax!
messages.full_text: Ha! I NEVER pay income tax!
messages.translation: はっ！ 俺は所得税なんて一度も払ったことがないぜ！
messages.dict_source: Ha! I NEVER pay income tax!

messages.raw_format: Have you come to raise the dead?
messages.full_text: Have you come to raise the dead?
messages.translation: 死人を蘇らせに来たのかい？
messages.dict_source: Have you come to raise the dead?

messages.raw_format: Having a good time can be deadly.
messages.full_text: Having a good time can be deadly.
messages.translation: 楽しむことは、命取りになることもある。
messages.dict_source: Having a good time can be deadly.

messages.raw_format: Having a great time.  Where am I exactly??
messages.full_text: Having a great time.  Where am I exactly??
messages.translation: 最高の気分だ。で、ここは一体どこなんだ？？
messages.dict_source: Having a great time.  Where am I exactly??

messages.raw_format: He died of the flux.
messages.full_text: He died of the flux.
messages.translation: 彼は赤痢（Flux）で死んだ。

messages.raw_format: He died today....  May we rest in peace!
messages.full_text: He died today....  May we rest in peace!
messages.translation: 彼は今日死んだ....（我々も）安らかに眠れますように！
messages.dict_source: He died today....  May we rest in peace!

messages.raw_format: He got the upside, I got the downside.
messages.full_text: He got the upside, I got the downside.
messages.translation: 彼は上側（地上）を手に入れ、俺は下側（地下）を手に入れた。
messages.dict_source: He got the upside, I got the downside.

messages.raw_format: He lost his face when he was beheaded.
messages.full_text: He lost his face when he was beheaded.
messages.translation: 彼は斬首されたとき、面目（Face）を失った。
messages.dict_source: He lost his face when he was beheaded.

messages.raw_format: He missed me first.
messages.full_text: He missed me first.
messages.translation: 先に外したのはあいつの方だぜ。

messages.raw_format: He's not dead, he just smells that way.
messages.full_text: He's not dead, he just smells that way.
messages.translation: あいつは死んでない、ただそういう臭いがするだけだ（フランク・ザッパの言葉より）。
messages.dict_source: He's not dead, he just smells that way.

messages.raw_format: Help! I've fallen and I can't get up!
messages.full_text: Help! I've fallen and I can't get up!
messages.translation: 助けて！ 転んじゃって起き上がれないんだ！（LifeCall社のCM有名フレーズ）
messages.dict_source: Help! I've fallen and I can't get up!

messages.raw_format: Help, I can't wake up!
messages.full_text: Help, I can't wake up!
messages.translation: 助けて、起きられないんだ！

messages.raw_format: Here lies Pinocchio
messages.full_text: Here lies Pinocchio
messages.translation: ここにピノキオ眠る（墓石から鼻が突き出ているのか？）

messages.raw_format: Here lies the body of John Round.  Lost at sea and never found.
messages.full_text: Here lies the body of John Round.  Lost at sea and never found.
messages.translation: ここにジョン・ラウンドの遺体眠る。海で失われ、ついに見つかることはなかった。
messages.dict_source: Here lies the body of John Round.  Lost at sea and never found.

messages.raw_format: Here there be dragons
messages.full_text: Here there be dragons
messages.translation: この先にドラゴンあり（古地図の「未知の領域」の警告）

messages.raw_format: Hey, I didn't write this stuff!
messages.full_text: Hey, I didn't write this stuff!
messages.translation: おい、これを書いたのは俺じゃないぞ！
messages.dict_source: Hey, I didn't write this stuff!

messages.raw_format: Hodie mihi, cras tibi
messages.full_text: Hodie mihi, cras tibi
messages.translation: 今日は我、明日は汝（ラテン語：今日は私が死んでいるが、明日は君の番だ）

messages.raw_format: Hold my calls
messages.full_text: Hold my calls
messages.translation: 電話（面会）はすべて断ってくれ

messages.raw_format: Home Sweet Hell
messages.full_text: Home Sweet Hell
messages.translation: 地獄こそ我が家

messages.raw_format: Humpty Dumpty, a Bad Egg.  He was pushed off the wall.
messages.full_text: Humpty Dumpty, a Bad Egg.  He was pushed off the wall.
messages.translation: ハンプティ・ダンプティ、嫌な卵め。あいつは壁から突き落とされたんだ。
messages.dict_source: Humpty Dumpty, a Bad Egg.  He was pushed off the wall.

messages.raw_format: I KNEW this would happen if I lived long enough.
messages.full_text: I KNEW this would happen if I lived long enough.
messages.translation: 長生きさえしてれば、いつかこうなることは分かってたんだ。
messages.dict_source: I KNEW this would happen if I lived long enough.

messages.raw_format: I TOLD you I was sick!
messages.full_text: I TOLD you I was sick!
messages.translation: だから具合が悪いって言っただろ！（スパイク・ミリガンの墓碑銘として有名）
messages.dict_source: I TOLD you I was sick!

messages.raw_format: I ain't broke but I am badly bent.
messages.full_text: I ain't broke but I am badly bent.
messages.translation: 壊れちゃいないが、ひどく曲がっちまった。
messages.dict_source: I ain't broke but I am badly bent.

messages.raw_format: I ain't old.  I'm chronologically advantaged.
messages.full_text: I ain't old.  I'm chronologically advantaged.
messages.translation: 俺は年寄りじゃない。時間的に（経験が）豊かなだけだ。
messages.dict_source: I ain't old.  I'm chronologically advantaged.

messages.raw_format: I am NOT a vampire.  I just like to bite..nibble, really!
messages.full_text: I am NOT a vampire.  I just like to bite..nibble, really!
messages.translation: 吸血鬼じゃないんだ。ただ、噛む（というか、ちょっとかじるだけ）が好きなだけで！
messages.dict_source: I am NOT a vampire.  I just like to bite..nibble, really!

messages.raw_format: I am here.  Wish you were fine.
messages.full_text: I am here.  Wish you were fine.
messages.translation: 私はここにいる。君が元気でありますように。
messages.dict_source: I am here.  Wish you were fine.

messages.raw_format: I am not dead yet, but watch for further reports.
messages.full_text: I am not dead yet, but watch for further reports.
messages.translation: 私はまだ死んでいない。だが続報を待て。
messages.dict_source: I am not dead yet, but watch for further reports.

messages.raw_format: I believe them bones are me.
messages.full_text: I believe them bones are me.
messages.translation: あの骨は、私なのだと思う。
messages.dict_source: I believe them bones are me.

messages.raw_format: I broke his brain.
messages.full_text: I broke his brain.
messages.translation: あいつの脳みそ（または精神）をぶっ壊してやった。

messages.raw_format: I can feel it.  My mind.  It's going.  I can feel it.
messages.full_text: I can feel it.  My mind.  It's going.  I can feel it.
messages.translation: 感じるぞ。僕の意識が....消えていく。確かに、感じるんだ....。（『2001年宇宙の旅』HAL 9000の台詞）
messages.dict_source: I can feel it.  My mind.  It's going.  I can feel it.

messages.raw_format: I can't go to Hell.  They're afraid I'm gonna take over!
messages.full_text: I can't go to Hell.  They're afraid I'm gonna take over!
messages.translation: 地獄には行けない。私が乗っ取るのを彼らが恐れているからな！
messages.dict_source: I can't go to Hell.  They're afraid I'm gonna take over!

messages.raw_format: I can't go to hell, they don't want me.
messages.full_text: I can't go to hell, they don't want me.
messages.translation: 地獄には行けないんだ、向こうが俺を拒否してるんでね。
messages.dict_source: I can't go to hell, they don't want me.

messages.raw_format: I didn't believe in reincarnation the last time, either.
messages.full_text: I didn't believe in reincarnation the last time, either.
messages.translation: 前世でも、転生なんて信じてなかったよ。
messages.dict_source: I didn't believe in reincarnation the last time, either.

messages.raw_format: I didn't mean it when I said 'Bite me'
messages.full_text: I didn't mean it when I said 'Bite me'
messages.translation: 「（嫌なことがあった時に）噛んでくれ（Bite me）」って言ったのは本気じゃなかったんだ！
messages.dict_source: I didn't mean it when I said 'Bite me'

messages.raw_format: I died laughing
messages.full_text: I died laughing
messages.translation: 笑い死にした（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: I disbelieved in reincarnation in my last life, too.
messages.full_text: I disbelieved in reincarnation in my last life, too.
messages.translation: 前世でも、あいにく転生は否定派だったんでね。
messages.dict_source: I disbelieved in reincarnation in my last life, too.

messages.raw_format: I hacked myself to death
messages.full_text: I hacked myself to death
messages.translation: 自分を（NetHackして、あるいは叩き切って）死に追いやった

messages.raw_format: I have all the time in the world
messages.full_text: I have all the time in the world
messages.translation: 時間はたっぷりある（もう死んでいるんだから）
messages.dict_source: I have all the time in the world

messages.raw_format: I have reached Mine's End
messages.full_text: I have reached Mine's End
messages.translation: === TODO === マインズエンドに到着しました

messages.raw_format: I knew I'd find a use for this gravestone!
messages.full_text: I knew I'd find a use for this gravestone!
messages.translation: いつかこの墓石を役立てる日が来るって分かってたよ！
messages.dict_source: I knew I'd find a use for this gravestone!

messages.raw_format: I know my mind.  And it's around here someplace.
messages.full_text: I know my mind.  And it's around here someplace.
messages.translation: 自分の正気（Mind）のありかは分かってる。この辺のどこかにあるはずだ。
messages.dict_source: I know my mind.  And it's around here someplace.

messages.raw_format: I lied!  I'll never be alright!
messages.full_text: I lied!  I'll never be alright!
messages.translation: 嘘をついた！ 私は決して「大丈夫（Alright）」にはならない！
messages.dict_source: I lied!  I'll never be alright!

messages.raw_format: I like it better in the dark.
messages.full_text: I like it better in the dark.
messages.translation: 暗闇の方が落ち着くんだ。
messages.dict_source: I like it better in the dark.

messages.raw_format: I like to be here when I can.
messages.full_text: I like to be here when I can.
messages.translation: できるだけここにいたいものだ。
messages.dict_source: I like to be here when I can.

messages.raw_format: I may rise but I refuse to shine.
messages.full_text: I may rise but I refuse to shine.
messages.translation: （蘇生して）起き上がることはあっても、輝く（Shine：元気よく振る舞う）のはお断りだ。
messages.dict_source: I may rise but I refuse to shine.

messages.raw_format: I never get any either.
messages.full_text: I never get any either.
messages.translation: 俺も何も手に入らなかったよ。

messages.raw_format: I said hit HIM with the fireball, not me!
messages.full_text: I said hit HIM with the fireball, not me!
messages.translation: あいつにファイアボールをぶつけろって言ったんだ、俺じゃなくて！
messages.dict_source: I said hit HIM with the fireball, not me!

messages.raw_format: I told you I would never say goodbye.
messages.full_text: I told you I would never say goodbye.
messages.translation: 決してさよならは言わないって、約束しただろう。
messages.dict_source: I told you I would never say goodbye.

messages.raw_format: I used to be amusing.  Now I'm just disgusting.
messages.full_text: I used to be amusing.  Now I'm just disgusting.
messages.translation: 昔は面白がられたもんだが、今じゃただの気味悪い（死体）だな。
messages.dict_source: I used to be amusing.  Now I'm just disgusting.

messages.raw_format: I used up all my sick days, so now I'm calling in dead.
messages.full_text: I used up all my sick days, so now I'm calling in dead.
messages.translation: 病欠（Sick days）を使い果たしたから、死欠（Calling in dead）することにしたよ。
messages.dict_source: I used up all my sick days, so now I'm calling in dead.

messages.raw_format: I was killed by <illegible scrawl>
messages.full_text: I was killed by <illegible scrawl>
messages.translation: 私は <判読不能な走り書き> によって殺された

messages.raw_format: I was somebody.  Who, is no business of yours.
messages.full_text: I was somebody.  Who, is no business of yours.
messages.translation: 私は「誰か」だった。それが誰かは、君には関係のないことだ。
messages.dict_source: I was somebody.  Who, is no business of yours.

messages.raw_format: I will not go quietly.
messages.full_text: I will not go quietly.
messages.translation: 私はおとなしく逝きはしない。

messages.raw_format: I'd give you a piece of my mind... but I can't find it.
messages.full_text: I'd give you a piece of my mind... but I can't find it.
messages.translation: 君に私の考え（または脳みそ）を分けてやりたいが....どこにあるか分からんのだ。
messages.dict_source: I'd give you a piece of my mind... but I can't find it.

messages.raw_format: I'd rather be breathing
messages.full_text: I'd rather be breathing
messages.translation: 息をしていられた方がマシだったな

messages.raw_format: I'll be back!
messages.full_text: I'll be back!
messages.translation: また戻ってくるぜ！（アイル・ビー・バック）

messages.raw_format: I'll be mellow when I'm dead.  For now, let's PARTY!
messages.full_text: I'll be mellow when I'm dead.  For now, let's PARTY!
messages.translation: 死んだらおとなしくしててやる。だが今はパーティーだぜ！（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: I'll be mellow when I'm dead.  For now, let's PARTY!

messages.raw_format: I'm doing this only for tax purposes.
messages.full_text: I'm doing this only for tax purposes.
messages.translation: これは単に節税対策のためにやってるんだ（死んだふりをしている？）
messages.dict_source: I'm doing this only for tax purposes.

messages.raw_format: I'm not afraid of Death!  What's he gonna do? Kill me?
messages.full_text: I'm not afraid of Death!  What's he gonna do? Kill me?
messages.translation: 死神なんて怖くないね！ あいつに何ができる？ 俺を殺すとでもいうのか？（と言って死んだ：スティーヴン・ライトのジョーク）
messages.dict_source: I'm not afraid of Death!  What's he gonna do? Kill me?

messages.raw_format: I'm not getting enough money, so I'm not going to engrave anything useful here.
messages.full_text: I'm not getting enough money, so I'm not going to engrave anything useful here.
messages.translation: 十分な金をもらってないから、ここには役に立つことは一切彫らないぞ。
messages.dict_source: I'm not getting enough money, so I'm not going to engrave anything useful here.

messages.raw_format: I'm not saying anything.
messages.full_text: I'm not saying anything.
messages.translation: 私は何も言っていない。

messages.raw_format: I'm weeth stupeed --->
messages.full_text: I'm weeth stupeed --->
messages.translation: バカはこっち --->（I'm with stupid：隣の人をバカにするTシャツ等のフレーズ）

messages.raw_format: If you thought you had problems...
messages.full_text: If you thought you had problems...
messages.translation: もし君が、自分には問題があると思っているなら....（私の死体を見ろ、の意）
messages.dict_source: If you thought you had problems...

messages.raw_format: Ignorance kills daily.
messages.full_text: Ignorance kills daily.
messages.translation: 無知は日々、命を奪う。

messages.raw_format: Ignore me... I'm just here for my looks!
messages.full_text: Ignore me... I'm just here for my looks!
messages.translation: 私のことは無視してくれ....見た目だけでここにいるんだから！（墓の装飾の一部だ、という皮肉）
messages.dict_source: Ignore me... I'm just here for my looks!

messages.raw_format: Ilene Toofar -- Fell off a cliff
messages.full_text: Ilene Toofar -- Fell off a cliff
messages.translation: アイリーン・トゥーファー（I lean too far：身を乗り出しすぎた） -- 崖から転落。
messages.dict_source: Ilene Toofar -- Fell off a cliff

messages.raw_format: Is that all?
messages.full_text: Is that all?
messages.translation: それでおしまい？

messages.raw_format: Is there life before Death?
messages.full_text: Is there life before Death?
messages.translation: 死ぬ前の「生」は存在するのか？（Is there life after death? の逆転）

messages.raw_format: Is this a joke, or a grave matter?
messages.full_text: Is this a joke, or a grave matter?
messages.translation: これはジョークか、それとも「墓（Grave：重大な）」の問題か？
messages.dict_source: Is this a joke, or a grave matter?

messages.raw_format: It happens sometimes.  People just explode.
messages.full_text: It happens sometimes.  People just explode.
messages.translation: たまにあることさ。人間が突然爆発するなんて。
messages.dict_source: It happens sometimes.  People just explode.

messages.raw_format: It must be Thursday.  I never could get the hang of Thursdays.
messages.full_text: It must be Thursday.  I never could get the hang of Thursdays.
messages.translation: 今日は木曜日に違いない。木曜日はどうも苦手だ。（『銀河ヒッチハイク・ガイド』アーサー・デントの台詞）
messages.dict_source: It must be Thursday.  I never could get the hang of Thursdays.

messages.raw_format: It wasn't a fair fight
messages.full_text: It wasn't a fair fight
messages.translation: 公平な戦いじゃなかった

messages.raw_format: It wasn't so easy.
messages.full_text: It wasn't so easy.
messages.translation: そんなに簡単じゃなかったよ。

messages.raw_format: It's Loot, Pillage and THEN Burn...
messages.full_text: It's Loot, Pillage and THEN Burn...
messages.translation: 略奪、略取、そして「それから」火を放つんだ....（順番が大事、という皮肉）
messages.dict_source: It's Loot, Pillage and THEN Burn...

messages.raw_format: Just doing my job here
messages.full_text: Just doing my job here
messages.translation: 私はここで自分の仕事（＝死体になること）をしてるだけだ

messages.raw_format: Killed by diarrhea of mouth and constipation of brain.
messages.full_text: Killed by diarrhea of mouth and constipation of brain.
messages.translation: 多弁という下痢と、思考停止という便秘によって死亡。
messages.dict_source: Killed by diarrhea of mouth and constipation of brain.

messages.raw_format: Let her RIP
messages.full_text: Let her RIP
messages.translation: 彼女を安らかに眠らせてやれ（R.I.P.：安らかに眠れ）

messages.raw_format: Let it be; I am dead.
messages.full_text: Let it be; I am dead.
messages.translation: なすがままに（Let it be）。私は死んだんだ。
messages.dict_source: Let it be; I am dead.

messages.raw_format: Let's play Hide the Corpse
messages.full_text: Let's play Hide the Corpse
messages.translation: 「死体隠し」遊びをしようぜ

messages.raw_format: Life is NOT a dream
messages.full_text: Life is NOT a dream
messages.translation: 人生は夢などではない

messages.raw_format: Madge Ination -- It wasn't all in my head
messages.full_text: Madge Ination -- It wasn't all in my head
messages.translation: マッジ・イネーション（Imagination：想像力） -- すべてが妄想だったわけじゃない。
messages.dict_source: Madge Ination -- It wasn't all in my head

messages.raw_format: Meet me in Heaven
messages.full_text: Meet me in Heaven
messages.translation: 天国で会おう

messages.raw_format: Move on, there's nothing to see here.
messages.full_text: Move on, there's nothing to see here.
messages.translation: さあ行った行った。ここには見るべきものなんて何もないぞ。
messages.dict_source: Move on, there's nothing to see here.

messages.raw_format: Mr. Flintstone -- Yabba-dabba-done
messages.full_text: Mr. Flintstone -- Yabba-dabba-done
messages.translation: フリントストーン氏 -- ヤバ・ダバ・おしまい（Yabba-dabba-dooのパロディ）

messages.raw_format: My heart is not in this
messages.full_text: My heart is not in this
messages.translation: 私の心はここ（この死体）にはない
messages.dict_source: My heart is not in this

messages.raw_format: No one ever died from it
messages.full_text: No one ever died from it
messages.translation: それで死んだ奴なんて一人もいない（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: No one ever died from it

messages.raw_format: No, you want room 12A, next door.
messages.full_text: No, you want room 12A, next door.
messages.translation: いいえ、お探しの部屋は隣の12A号室です。
messages.dict_source: No, you want room 12A, next door.

messages.raw_format: Nope.  No trap on that chest.  I swear.
messages.full_text: Nope.  No trap on that chest.  I swear.
messages.translation: いいや。その宝箱に罠なんてない。誓ってもいい。（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Nope.  No trap on that chest.  I swear.

messages.raw_format: Not again!
messages.full_text: Not again!
messages.translation: またかよ！（『銀河ヒッチハイク・ガイド』ペチュニアの鉢植え）

messages.raw_format: Not every soil can bear all things
messages.full_text: Not every soil can bear all things
messages.translation: すべての土壌があらゆるものを育める（耐えられる）わけではない。
messages.dict_source: Not every soil can bear all things

messages.raw_format: Now I have a life
messages.full_text: Now I have a life
messages.translation: これでようやく（死後の）人生が手に入った

messages.raw_format: Now I lay thee down to sleep... wanna join me?
messages.full_text: Now I lay thee down to sleep... wanna join me?
messages.translation: 汝を眠り（死）につかせよう....君も一緒にどうだい？
messages.dict_source: Now I lay thee down to sleep... wanna join me?

messages.raw_format: OK, here is a question: Where ARE your tanlines?
messages.full_text: OK, here is a question: Where ARE your tanlines?
messages.translation: よし、質問だ。君の「日焼け跡」はどこにあるんだい？
messages.dict_source: OK, here is a question: Where ARE your tanlines?

messages.raw_format: Obesa Cantavit
messages.full_text: Obesa Cantavit
messages.translation: 肥満女性が歌った（ラテン語：全てが終わった、の意。オペラが肥満女性のソプラノで終わることから）

messages.raw_format: Oh! An untimely death.
messages.full_text: Oh! An untimely death.
messages.translation: おお！ 早すぎる死だ。

messages.raw_format: Oh, by the way, how was my funeral?
messages.full_text: Oh, by the way, how was my funeral?
messages.translation: ああ、ところで、私の葬式はどうだった？
messages.dict_source: Oh, by the way, how was my funeral?

messages.raw_format: "Oh, honey... I missed you!" she said, and fired again.
messages.full_text: "Oh, honey... I missed you!" she said, and fired again.
messages.translation: 「ああ、あなた....外れちゃった（会いたかった）わ！」彼女はそう言って、もう一発撃った。
messages.dict_source: "Oh, honey... I missed you!" she said, and fired again.

messages.raw_format: Ok, so the light does go off.  Now let me out of here.
messages.full_text: Ok, so the light does go off.  Now let me out of here.
messages.translation: よし、明かりは確かに消えるんだな。さあ、ここから出してくれ。
messages.dict_source: Ok, so the light does go off.  Now let me out of here.

messages.raw_format: One stone brain
messages.full_text: One stone brain
messages.translation: 石でできた脳みそ（または、一つだけの墓石脳）

messages.raw_format: Ooh! Somebody STOP me!
messages.full_text: Ooh! Somebody STOP me!
messages.translation: おお！ 誰か私を止めてくれ！（『マスク』のジム・キャリーの台詞）

messages.raw_format: Oops!
messages.full_text: Oops!
messages.translation: おっと！

messages.raw_format: Out for the night.  Leave a message.
messages.full_text: Out for the night.  Leave a message.
messages.translation: 今夜は外出中。メッセージを残しておいてくれ。
messages.dict_source: Out for the night.  Leave a message.

messages.raw_format: Ow!  Do that again!
messages.full_text: Ow!  Do that again!
messages.translation: 痛い！ もう一度やってくれ！

messages.raw_format: Pardon my dust.
messages.full_text: Pardon my dust.
messages.translation: 私の「塵（遺骨）」を許してくれ（ドロシー・パーカーの墓碑銘として有名なジョーク）。

messages.raw_format: Part of me still works.
messages.full_text: Part of me still works.
messages.translation: 私の一部はまだ動いているぞ。

messages.raw_format: Please, not in front of those orcs!
messages.full_text: Please, not in front of those orcs!
messages.translation: お願いだ、あのオークたちの前ではやめてくれ！
messages.dict_source: Please, not in front of those orcs!

messages.raw_format: Prepare to meet me in Heaven
messages.full_text: Prepare to meet me in Heaven
messages.translation: 天国で私と会う準備をしておけ
messages.dict_source: Prepare to meet me in Heaven

messages.raw_format: R2D2 -- Rest, Tin Piece
messages.full_text: R2D2 -- Rest, Tin Piece
messages.translation: R2D2 -- 安らかに眠れ、錫の塊（Rest In Peace, Tin Piece：R.I.P.のパロディ）

messages.raw_format: Relax.  Nothing ever happens on the first level.
messages.full_text: Relax.  Nothing ever happens on the first level.
messages.translation: 落ち着け。1階（First level）では何も起きやしないさ。（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Relax.  Nothing ever happens on the first level.

messages.raw_format: Res omnia mea culpa est
messages.full_text: Res omnia mea culpa est
messages.translation: すべては私の責任である（ラテン語：私の過失、の意）

messages.raw_format: Rest In Pieces
messages.full_text: Rest In Pieces
messages.translation: バラバラになって眠れ

messages.raw_format: Rest, rest, perturbed spirit.
messages.full_text: Rest, rest, perturbed spirit.
messages.translation: 安らかに、安らかに眠れ、かき乱された霊魂よ。（シェイクスピア『ハムレット』より）

messages.raw_format: Rip Torn
messages.full_text: Rip Torn
messages.translation: リップ・トーン（俳優の名前だが、RIPとTORN：引き裂かれた、のダブルミーニング）

messages.raw_format: She always said her feet were killing her but nobody believed her.
messages.full_text: She always said her feet were killing her but nobody believed her.
messages.translation: 彼女はいつも「足が痛くて死にそう」と言っていたが、誰も信じなかった。
messages.dict_source: She always said her feet were killing her but nobody believed her.

messages.raw_format: She died of a chest cold.
messages.full_text: She died of a chest cold.
messages.translation: 彼女は「胸（Chest：または宝箱）」の風邪で死んだ。
messages.dict_source: She died of a chest cold.

messages.raw_format: So let it be written, so let it be done!
messages.full_text: So let it be written, so let it be done!
messages.translation: かくして記され、かくして成されん！（映画『十戒』よりユル・ブリンナーの台詞）
messages.dict_source: So let it be written, so let it be done!

messages.raw_format: So then I says, How do I know you're the real angel of death?
messages.full_text: So then I says, How do I know you're the real angel of death?
messages.translation: それで俺は言ったんだ。「あんたが本物の死神だって、どうやって証明するんだい？」ってね。
messages.dict_source: So then I says, How do I know you're the real angel of death?

messages.raw_format: Some patients insist on dying.
messages.full_text: Some patients insist on dying.
messages.translation: 死ぬことを頑なに主張する患者もいるものだ。

messages.raw_format: Some people have it dead easy, don't they?
messages.full_text: Some people have it dead easy, don't they?
messages.translation: 死ぬほど簡単な（Dead easy）人生を送る奴らもいるよな？
messages.dict_source: Some people have it dead easy, don't they?

messages.raw_format: Some things are better left buried.
messages.full_text: Some things are better left buried.
messages.translation: 埋めたままにしておいた方がいいものもある。
messages.dict_source: Some things are better left buried.

messages.raw_format: Sure, trust me, I'm a lawyer...
messages.full_text: Sure, trust me, I'm a lawyer...
messages.translation: ああ、任せてくれ。俺は弁護士だぜ....（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Sure, trust me, I'm a lawyer...

messages.raw_format: Thank God I wore my corset, because I think my sides have split.
messages.full_text: Thank God I wore my corset, because I think my sides have split.
messages.translation: コルセットをしていて良かった。脇腹が（笑いすぎて）裂けちまったみたいだからね。
messages.dict_source: Thank God I wore my corset, because I think my sides have split.

messages.raw_format: That is all
messages.full_text: That is all
messages.translation: 以上である。

messages.raw_format: The Gods DO have a sense of humor: I'm living proof!
messages.full_text: The Gods DO have a sense of humor: I'm living proof!
messages.translation: 神々には確かにユーモアのセンスがある。私がその生きた証拠だ！（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: The Gods DO have a sense of humor: I'm living proof!

messages.raw_format: The frog's dead.  He Kermitted suicide.
messages.full_text: The frog's dead.  He Kermitted suicide.
messages.translation: カエルが死んだ。カーミット自殺（Committed suicide とカエルのカーミットの洒落）をしたんだ。
messages.dict_source: The frog's dead.  He Kermitted suicide.

messages.raw_format: This dungeon is a pushover
messages.full_text: This dungeon is a pushover
messages.translation: このダンジョンなんて楽勝だぜ（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: This elevator doesn't go to Heaven
messages.full_text: This elevator doesn't go to Heaven
messages.translation: このエレベーターは天国（Heaven）には行かない
messages.dict_source: This elevator doesn't go to Heaven

messages.raw_format: This gravestone is shareware.  To register, please send me 10 zorkmids
messages.full_text: This gravestone is shareware.  To register, please send me 10 zorkmids
messages.translation: この墓石はシェアウェアです。ユーザー登録には10ゾークミッド送ってください。
messages.dict_source: This gravestone is shareware.  To register, please send me 10 zorkmids

messages.raw_format: This gravestone provided by The Yendorian Grave Services Inc.
messages.full_text: This gravestone provided by The Yendorian Grave Services Inc.
messages.translation: この墓石はイェンダー墓葬サービス株式会社によって提供されました。
messages.dict_source: This gravestone provided by The Yendorian Grave Services Inc.

messages.raw_format: This is not an important part of my life.
messages.full_text: This is not an important part of my life.
messages.translation: これは私の人生の重要な部分ではない（すでに死んでいるから）。
messages.dict_source: This is not an important part of my life.

messages.raw_format: This one's on me.
messages.full_text: This one's on me.
messages.translation: 今回は俺の奢りだ（または、俺の責任だ）

messages.raw_format: This side up
messages.full_text: This side up
messages.translation: こちらを上に（荷物の取扱注意のパロディ）

messages.raw_format: Tim Burr -- Smashed by a tree
messages.full_text: Tim Burr -- Smashed by a tree
messages.translation: ティム・バー（Timber：材木、伐採時の掛け声） -- 木に潰されて死亡。
messages.dict_source: Tim Burr -- Smashed by a tree

messages.raw_format: Tone it down a bit, I'm trying to get some rest here.
messages.full_text: Tone it down a bit, I'm trying to get some rest here.
messages.translation: もう少し静かにしてくれ、ここで休もうとしてるんだから。
messages.dict_source: Tone it down a bit, I'm trying to get some rest here.

messages.raw_format: Virtually Alive
messages.full_text: Virtually Alive
messages.translation: 仮想的に（Virtually）生存中

messages.raw_format: We Will Meet Again.
messages.full_text: We Will Meet Again.
messages.translation: また会いましょう。

messages.raw_format: Weep not, he is at rest
messages.full_text: Weep not, he is at rest
messages.translation: 嘆くなかれ、彼は安らぎの中にあり
messages.dict_source: Weep not, he is at rest

messages.raw_format: Welcome to Dante's.  What level please?
messages.full_text: Welcome to Dante's.  What level please?
messages.translation: ダンテの世界へようこそ。何階をご希望ですか？（『神曲』地獄編の九つの階層への言及）
messages.dict_source: Welcome to Dante's.  What level please?

messages.raw_format: Well, at least they listened to my sermon...
messages.full_text: Well, at least they listened to my sermon...
messages.translation: まあ、少なくとも奴らは俺の説教を聴いてくれたよ....（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Well, at least they listened to my sermon...

messages.raw_format: Went to be an angel.
messages.full_text: Went to be an angel.
messages.translation: 天使になるために逝った。

messages.raw_format: What are you doing over there?
messages.full_text: What are you doing over there?
messages.translation: そこで何をしてるんだい？
messages.dict_source: What are you doing over there?

messages.raw_format: What are you smiling at?
messages.full_text: What are you smiling at?
messages.translation: 何を笑ってるんだ？

messages.raw_format: What can you say, Death's got appeal...!
messages.full_text: What can you say, Death's got appeal...!
messages.translation: 何と言えばいいか、死もなかなか魅力的だよ....！
messages.dict_source: What can you say, Death's got appeal...!

messages.raw_format: What health care?
messages.full_text: What health care?
messages.translation: 医療体制がどうしたって？（そんなものはない、の意）

messages.raw_format: What pit?
messages.full_text: What pit?
messages.translation: 落とし穴が何だって？（気づかずに落ちて死んだ？）

messages.raw_format: When the gods want to punish you, they answer your prayers.
messages.full_text: When the gods want to punish you, they answer your prayers.
messages.translation: 神々があなたを罰したいとき、彼らはあなたの祈りに答える。
messages.dict_source: When the gods want to punish you, they answer your prayers.

messages.raw_format: Where e'er you be let your wind go free.  Keeping it in was the death of me!
messages.full_text: Where e'er you be let your wind go free.  Keeping it in was the death of me!
messages.translation: どこにいようと屁を我慢するな。溜め込んだのが俺の命取りだった！（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Where e'er you be let your wind go free.  Keeping it in was the death of me!

messages.raw_format: Where's my refund?
messages.full_text: Where's my refund?
messages.translation: 俺の返金（Refund）はどこだ？

messages.raw_format: Will let you know for sure in a day or two...
messages.full_text: Will let you know for sure in a day or two...
messages.translation: 一日か二日したら、確かなことを教えてやるよ....
messages.dict_source: Will let you know for sure in a day or two...

messages.raw_format: Wizards are wimps
messages.full_text: Wizards are wimps
messages.translation: 魔法使いなんて弱虫だ（と言って死んだ戦士の言葉？）

messages.raw_format: Worms at work, do not disturb!
messages.full_text: Worms at work, do not disturb!
messages.translation: 虫たちが作業中、邪魔しないでください！（墓の中の死体が分解されていることへの皮肉）
messages.dict_source: Worms at work, do not disturb!

messages.raw_format: Would you mind moving a bit?  I'm short of breath down here.
messages.full_text: Would you mind moving a bit?  I'm short of breath down here.
messages.translation: 少し退いてくれないか？ ここは息が詰まるんだ。
messages.dict_source: Would you mind moving a bit?  I'm short of breath down here.

messages.raw_format: Would you quit being evil over my shoulder?
messages.full_text: Would you quit being evil over my shoulder?
messages.translation: 私の肩越しに悪事を働くのはやめてくれないか？
messages.dict_source: Would you quit being evil over my shoulder?

messages.raw_format: Ya really had me going baby, but now I'm gone.
messages.full_text: Ya really had me going baby, but now I'm gone.
messages.translation: 本当に俺を騙したなベイビー、でももう俺は去ったんだ。
messages.dict_source: Ya really had me going baby, but now I'm gone.

messages.raw_format: Yes Dear, just a few more minutes...
messages.full_text: Yes Dear, just a few more minutes...
messages.translation: 分かったよお前、あと数分だけ待ってくれ....（と言って死んだ）
messages.dict_source: Yes Dear, just a few more minutes...

messages.raw_format: You said it wasn't poisonous!
messages.full_text: You said it wasn't poisonous!
messages.translation: 毒じゃないって言ったじゃないか！（と言って死んだ）

messages.raw_format: You set my heart aflame.  You gave me heartburn.
messages.full_text: You set my heart aflame.  You gave me heartburn.
messages.translation: 君は私の心を燃え上がらせた。そして胸焼け（Heartburn）をくれたんだ。
messages.dict_source: You set my heart aflame.  You gave me heartburn.
